# Abaqus INTERACTION Module API Reference

# Interaction[¶](#interaction "Permalink to this heading")

A specific type of interaction object and a specific type of interaction state object are designed for each type of interaction. An interaction object stores the non-propagating data of an interaction as well as a number of instances of the corresponding interaction state object, each of which stores the propagating data of the interaction in a single step. Instances of the interaction state object are created and deleted internally by its corresponding interaction object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    mdb.models[name]
    ```

    Note

"Permalink to this definition")
    :   This method creates an AcousticImpedance object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].AcousticImpedance
        ```

        Note

        Check [AcousticImpedance on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-acousticimpedanceitnpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.AcousticImpedance-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.AcousticImpedance.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the repository key.

            createStepName[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.AcousticImpedance.createStepName "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the step in which the AcousticImpedance object is
                created.

            surface[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.AcousticImpedance.surface "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Region object specifying the acoustic boundary surface.

            definition=`abaqusConstants.TABULAR`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.AcousticImpedance.definition "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of acoustic impedance to be defined. Possible
                values are TABULAR and NONREFLECTING. The default value is TABULAR.

            interactionProperty=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.AcousticImpedance.interactionProperty "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the AcousticImpedanceProp object associated with this interaction.

            nonreflectingType=`abaqusConstants.PLANE`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.AcousticImpedance.nonreflectingType "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of nonreflecting geometry to be defined. Possible
                values are PLANE, IMPROVED, CIRCULAR, SPHERICAL, ELLIPTICAL, and PROLATE. The default
                value is PLANE.This argument is valid only when **definition** = NONREFLECTING.

            radius=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.AcousticImpedance.radius "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the radius of the circle or sphere defining the boundary surface. The
                default value is 1.0.This argument is valid only when **definition** = NONREFLECTING, and
                **nonreflectingType** = CIRCULAR or SPHERICAL.

            semimajorAxis=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.AcousticImpedance.semimajorAxis "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the semimajor axis length of the ellipse or prolate spheroid defining
                the boundary surface. The default value is 1.0.This argument is valid only when
                **definition** = NONREFLECTING, and **nonreflectingType** = ELLIPTICAL or PROLATE.

            eccentricity=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.AcousticImpedance.eccentricity "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the eccentricity of the ellipse or prolate spheroid defining the
                boundary surface. The default value is 0.0.This argument is valid only when
                **definition** = NONREFLECTING, and **nonreflectingType** = ELLIPTICAL or PROLATE.

            centerCoordinates=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.AcousticImpedance.centerCoordinates "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of three Floats specifying the X, Y, and Z coordinates of the center of the
                ellipse or prolate spheroid defining the boundary surface. The default value is (0, 0,
                0).This argument is valid only when **definition** = NONREFLECTING, and
                **nonreflectingType** = ELLIPTICAL or PROLATE.

            directionCosine=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.AcousticImpedance.directionCosine "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of three Floats specifying the X, Y, and Z components of the direction cosine
                of the major axis of the ellipse or prolate spheroid defining the boundary surface. The
                default value is (0, 0, 1).This argument is valid only when **definition** = NONREFLECTING,
                and **nonreflectingType** = ELLIPTICAL or PROLATE.

        Returns:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.AcousticImpedance-returns "Permalink to this headline")
        :   An AcousticImpedance object.

        Return type:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.AcousticImpedance-return-type "Permalink to this headline")
        :   [`AcousticImpedance`](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.AcousticImpedance "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.AcousticImpedance (Python class) — Bases: Interaction")

        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ActuatorSensor.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the repository key.

            createStepName[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ActuatorSensor.createStepName "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the step in which the actuator/sensor interaction is
                created. **createStepName** must be set to ‘Initial’.

            point[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ActuatorSensor.point "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Region object specifying the point at which the constraint is applied.

            interactionProperty[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ActuatorSensor.interactionProperty "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the ActuatorSensorProp object associated with this interaction.

            noCoordComponents[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ActuatorSensor.noCoordComponents "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of coordinate components supplied to the user subroutine
                (UEL).

            unsymm[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ActuatorSensor.unsymm "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the element matrices are symmetric (ON) or unsymmetric
                (OFF). The default value is OFF.

            noSolutionDepVar[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ActuatorSensor.noSolutionDepVar "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of solution-dependent variables. The default value is 0.

            solutionDepVars[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ActuatorSensor.solutionDepVars "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of Floats specifying the initial values of the solution-dependent variables.

"Permalink to this definition")
    :   This method creates a CavityRadiation object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].CavityRadiation
        ```

        Note

        Check [CavityRadiation on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-cavityradiationitnpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the repository key.

            createStepName[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.createStepName "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the step in which the cavity radiation interaction
                should be created.

            surfaces[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.surfaces "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A RegionArray object specifying the surfaces for which radiation viewfactor control is
                being specified.

            surfaceEmissivities=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.surfaceEmissivities "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of Strings specifying the names of the Cavity Radiation properties containing
                the surface emissivity data. One name per specified surface. The emissivity data is
                ignored when **surfaceReflection** = OFF.

            ambientTemp=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.ambientTemp "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the reference ambient temperature value, θ0θ0. Specifying a
                value indicates an open cavity. The default value is None.

            blocking=`abaqusConstants.BLOCKING_ALL`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.blocking "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the blocking checks to be performed in the viewfactor
                calculations. Possible values are BLOCKING\_ALL, NO\_BLOCKING, and PARTIAL\_BLOCKING. The
                default value is BLOCKING\_ALL.

            blockingSurfaces=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.blockingSurfaces "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A RegionArray object specifying the surfaces that provide blocking inside the cavity.
                This argument applies only when **blocking** = PARTIAL\_BLOCKING.

            rangeOfView=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.rangeOfView "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the maximum distance between surface facets at which
                viewfactors are calculated. More distant facets are deemed too far apart to exchange
                significant amounts of heat through radiation effects, and the viewfactors between these
                facets are assumed to be zero. If **rangeOfView** = None, there is no upper limit. The
                default value is None.

            surfaceReflection=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.surfaceReflection "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether heat reflections are to be included in the cavity radiation
                calculations. The default value is ON.

            viewfactorAccurTol=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.viewfactorAccurTol "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the acceptable tolerance for the viewfactor calculations. The default
                value is 0.05.

            minInfinitesimalRatio=`64`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.minInfinitesimalRatio "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the facet area ratio above which the infinitesimal-to-finite area
                approximation is used for viewfactor calculations. The default value is 64.0.

            numPointsPerEdge=`3`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.numPointsPerEdge "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of Gauss integration points to be used along each edge when
                the numerical integration of contour integrals is used for viewfactor calculations. One
                to five integration points are allowed. The default value is 3.

            minLumpedAreaDS=`5`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.minLumpedAreaDS "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the nondimensional distance-square value above which the lumped area
                approximation is used for viewfactor calculations. The default value is 5.0.

            cyclicSymmetry=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.cyclicSymmetry "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether cyclic symmetry will be applied. This argument cannot be
                specified for axisymmetric models. The default value is OFF.

            cyclicImages=`2`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.cyclicImages "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of cyclically similar images that compose the cavity formed
                as a result of this symmetry. This argument applies only when **cyclicSymmetry** = ON. The
                default value is 2.

            cyclicRotPt=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.cyclicRotPt "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A ModelDot object specifying the rotation axis point. This argument applies only when
                **cyclicSymmetry** = ON.

            cyclicRotEndPt=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.cyclicRotEndPt "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A ModelDot object specifying the rotation axis end point. This argument applies only for
                three-dimensional models, and only when **cyclicSymmetry** = ON.

            cyclicSymPt=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.cyclicSymPt "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A ModelDot object specifying the symmetry axis end point. This argument applies only
                when **cyclicSymmetry** = ON.

            periodicSymmetries=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.periodicSymmetries "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of periodic symmetries that will be applied. The default
                value is 0.

            periodicImages\_1=`2`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.periodicImages_1 "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of repetitions used in the numerical calculation of the
                cavity viewfactors resulting from the first periodic symmetry. The result of this
                symmetry is a cavity composed of the cavity surface defined in the model plus twice the
                value of **periodicImages\_1**. This argument applies only when **periodicSymmetries** is
                greater than zero. The default value is 2.

            periodicImages\_2=`2`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.periodicImages_2 "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of repetitions used in the numerical calculation of the
                cavity viewfactors resulting from the second periodic symmetry. The result of this
                symmetry is a cavity composed of the cavity surface defined in the model plus twice the
                value of **periodicImages\_2**. This argument applies only when **periodicSymmetries** is
                greater than one. The default value is 2.

            periodicImages\_3=`2`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.periodicImages_3 "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of repetitions used in the numerical calculation of the
                cavity viewfactors resulting from the third periodic symmetry. The result of this
                symmetry is a cavity composed of the cavity surface defined in the model plus twice the
                value of **periodicImages\_3**. This argument applies only when **periodicSymmetries** = 3.
                The default value is 2.

            periodicSymAxis\_1=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.periodicSymAxis_1 "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A straight Edge, a Datum object representing a datum axis, or an ElementEdge object
                indicating the first line of symmetry in two-dimensional models. This argument applies
                only for 2D models, and when **periodicSymmetries** is greater than zero.

            periodicSymAxis\_2=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.periodicSymAxis_2 "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A straight Edge, a Datum object representing a datum axis, or an ElementEdge object
                indicating the second line of symmetry in two-dimensional models. This argument applies
                only for two-dimensional models, and when **periodicSymmetries** = 2.

            periodicSymPlane\_1=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.periodicSymPlane_1 "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A planar Face, an ElementFace, or a Datum object representing a datum plane; indicating
                the first plane of symmetry in three-dimensional models. This argument applies only for
                three-dimensional models, and when **periodicSymmetries** is greater than zero.

            periodicSymPlane\_2=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.periodicSymPlane_2 "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A planar Face, an ElementFace, or a Datum object representing a datum plane; indicating
                the second plane of symmetry in three-dimensional models. This argument applies only for
                three-dimensional models, and when **periodicSymmetries** is greater than one.

            periodicSymPlane\_3=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.periodicSymPlane_3 "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A planar Face, an ElementFace, or a Datum object representing a datum plane; indicating
                the third plane of symmetry in three-dimensional models. This argument applies only for
                three-dimensional models, and when **periodicSymmetries** = 3.

            periodicDistance\_1=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.periodicDistance_1 "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the two points of the vector that describes
                the periodic distance for the first periodic symmetry. Each point is defined by a tuple
                of three coordinates indicating its position. This argument applies only when
                **periodicSymmetries** is greater than zero. The default value is an empty sequence.

            periodicDistance\_2=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.periodicDistance_2 "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the two points of the vector that describes
                the periodic distance for the second periodic symmetry. Each point is defined by a tuple
                of three coordinates indicating its position. This argument applies only when
                **periodicSymmetries** is greater than one. The default value is an empty sequence.

            periodicDistance\_3=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.periodicDistance_3 "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the two points of the vector that describes
                the periodic distance for the third periodic symmetry. Each point is defined by a tuple
                of three coordinates indicating its position. This argument applies only when
                **periodicSymmetries** = 3. The default value is an empty sequence.

            periodicSymZ=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.periodicSymZ "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the Z value indicating the symmetry reference line in
                axisymmetric models. This argument applies only for axisymmetric models, and when
                **periodicSymmetries** = 1. The default value is None.

            periodicDistZ=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.periodicDistZ "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the Z value indicating the periodic distance in axisymmetric
                models. This argument applies only for axisymmetric models, and when
                **periodicSymmetries** = 1. The default value is None.

            reflectionSymmetries=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.reflectionSymmetries "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of reflection symmetries will be applied. The default value
                is 0.

            reflectionSymAxis\_1=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.reflectionSymAxis_1 "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A straight Edge, a Datum object representing a datum axis, or an ElementEdge object
                indicating the first line of symmetry in two-dimensional models. This argument applies
                only for two-dimensional models, and when **reflectionSymmetries** is greater than zero.

            reflectionSymAxis\_2=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.reflectionSymAxis_2 "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A straight Edge, a Datum object representing a datum axis, or an ElementEdge object
                indicating the second line of symmetry in two-dimensional models. This argument applies
                only for two-dimensional models, and when **reflectionSymmetries** = 2.

            reflectionSymPlane\_1=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.reflectionSymPlane_1 "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A planar Face, an ElementFace, or a Datum object representing a datum plane; indicating
                the first plane of symmetry in three-dimensional models. This argument applies only for
                three-dimensional models, and when **reflectionSymmetries** is greater than zero.

            reflectionSymPlane\_2=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.reflectionSymPlane_2 "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A planar Face, an ElementFace, or a Datum object representing a datum plane; indicating
                the second plane of symmetry in three-dimensional models. This argument applies only for
                three-dimensional models, and when **reflectionSymmetries** is greater than one.

            reflectionSymPlane\_3=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.reflectionSymPlane_3 "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A planar Face, an ElementFace, or a Datum object representing a datum plane; indicating
                the third plane of symmetry in three-dimensional models. This argument applies only for
                three-dimensional models, and when **reflectionSymmetries** = 3.

            reflectionSymZ=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.reflectionSymZ "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the Z value indicating the symmetry reference line in
                axisymmetric models. This argument applies only for axisymmetric models, and when
                **reflectionSymmetries** = 1. The default value is None.

        Returns:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation-returns "Permalink to this headline")
        :   A CavityRadiation object.

        Return type:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation-return-type "Permalink to this headline")
        :   [`CavityRadiation`](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation (Python class) — Bases: Interaction")

    :   This method creates a ConcentratedFilmCondition object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].ConcentratedFilmCondition
        ```

        Note

        Check [ConcentratedFilmCondition on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-concentratedfilmconditionitnpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ConcentratedFilmCondition-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ConcentratedFilmCondition.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the repository key.

            createStepName[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ConcentratedFilmCondition.createStepName "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the step in which the ConcentratedFilmCondition object
                is created.

            region[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ConcentratedFilmCondition.region "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Region object specifying the region to which the concentrated film condition
                interaction is applied. The interaction is applied to each node in the region.

            definition[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ConcentratedFilmCondition.definition "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying how the concentrated film condition is defined. Possible
                values are EMBEDDED\_COEFF, PROPERTY\_REF, USER\_SUB, and FIELD.

            nodalArea=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ConcentratedFilmCondition.nodalArea "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the area associated with the node where the concentrated film
                condition is applied. The default value is 1.0.

            explicitRegionType=`abaqusConstants.LAGRANGIAN`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ConcentratedFilmCondition.explicitRegionType "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying how the concentrated film condition is applied to the
                boundary of an adaptive mesh domain. Possible values are LAGRANGIAN, SLIDING, and
                EULERIAN. The default value is LAGRANGIAN. This argument applies only during an
                Abaqus/Explicit analysis.

            interactionProperty=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ConcentratedFilmCondition.interactionProperty "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the FilmConditionProp object associated with this
                interaction. The **interactionProperty** argument applies only when
                **definition** = PROPERTY\_REF. The default value is an empty string.

            field=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ConcentratedFilmCondition.field "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the AnalyticalField object associated with this
                interaction. The **field** argument applies only when **definition** = FIELD. The default
                value is an empty string.

            sinkTemperature=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ConcentratedFilmCondition.sinkTemperature "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the reference sink temperature, θ0θ0. The default value is 0.0.

            sinkAmplitude=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ConcentratedFilmCondition.sinkAmplitude "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the Amplitude object that gives the variation of the
                sink temperature, θ0θ0, with time. The default value is an empty string. Note: Use None in
                an Abaqus/Standard analysis to specify that the reference sink temperature is applied
                immediately at the beginning of the step or linearly over the step. Use None in an
                Abaqus/Explicit analysis to specify that the reference sink temperature is applied
                throughout the step.

            filmCoeff=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ConcentratedFilmCondition.filmCoeff "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the reference film coefficient value, hh. The **filmCoeff** argument
                applies when **definition** = EMBEDDED\_COEFF, **definition** = USER\_SUB, or **definition** = FIELD.
                The default value is 0.0.

            filmCoeffAmplitude=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ConcentratedFilmCondition.filmCoeffAmplitude "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the Amplitude object that gives the variation of the
                film coefficient, hh, with time. The default value is an empty string. Note: Use None in
                an Abaqus/Standard analysis to specify that the reference film coefficient is applied
                immediately at the beginning of the step or linearly over the step. Use None in an
                Abaqus/Explicit analysis to specify that the reference film coefficient is applied
                throughout the step.

            sinkFieldName=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ConcentratedFilmCondition.sinkFieldName "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the AnalyticalField or DiscreteField object associated
                with the sink temperature. The **sinkFieldName** argument applies only when
                **sinkDistributionType** = ANALYTICAL\_FIELD or **sinkDistributionType** = DISCRETE\_FIELD. The
                default value is an empty string.

            sinkDistributionType=`abaqusConstants.UNIFORM`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ConcentratedFilmCondition.sinkDistributionType "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying how the sink temperature is distributed. Possible values
                are UNIFORM, ANALYTICAL\_FIELD, and DISCRETE\_FIELD. The default value is UNIFORM.

    :   This method creates a ConcentratedRadiationToAmbient object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].ConcentratedRadiationToAmbient
        ```

        Note

        Check [ConcentratedRadiationToAmbient on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-concentratedradiationtoambientitnpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ConcentratedRadiationToAmbient-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ConcentratedRadiationToAmbient.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the repository key.

            createStepName[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ConcentratedRadiationToAmbient.createStepName "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the step in which the ConcentratedRadiationToAmbient
                object is created.

            region[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ConcentratedRadiationToAmbient.region "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Region object specifying the region to which the concentrated radiation interaction is
                applied. The interaction is applied to each node in the region.

            ambientTemperature[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ConcentratedRadiationToAmbient.ambientTemperature "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the reference ambient temperature, θ0θ0.

            ambientTemperatureAmp[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ConcentratedRadiationToAmbient.ambientTemperatureAmp "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the Amplitude object that gives the variation of the
                ambient temperature with time. Note: Use None in an Abaqus/Standard analysis to specify
                that the reference ambient temperature is applied immediately at the beginning of the
                step or linearly over the step. Use None in an Abaqus/Explicit analysis to specify that
                the reference ambient temperature is applied throughout the step.

            emissivity[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ConcentratedRadiationToAmbient.emissivity "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the emissivity, ϵϵ.

            nodalArea=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ConcentratedRadiationToAmbient.nodalArea "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the area associated with the node where the concentrated radiation
                interaction is applied. The default value is 1.0.

            explicitRegionType=`abaqusConstants.LAGRANGIAN`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ConcentratedRadiationToAmbient.explicitRegionType "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying how the concentrated radiation is applied to the boundary
                of an adaptive mesh domain. Possible values are LAGRANGIAN, SLIDING, and EULERIAN. The
                default value is LAGRANGIAN. Note: *explicitRegionType* applies only during an
                Abaqus/Explicit analysis.

            field=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ConcentratedRadiationToAmbient.field "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the AnalyticalField object associated with this
                interaction. The **field** argument applies only when **distributionType** = ANALYTICAL\_FIELD.
                The default value is an empty string.

            distributionType=`abaqusConstants.UNIFORM`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ConcentratedRadiationToAmbient.distributionType "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying how the radiation is defined. Possible values are UNIFORM
                and ANALYTICAL\_FIELD. The default value is UNIFORM.

"Permalink to this definition")
    :   This method creates a ContactExp object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].ContactExp
        ```

        Note

        Check [ContactExp on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-contactexpitnpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ContactExp-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ContactExp.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the repository key.

            createStepName[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ContactExp.createStepName "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the step in which this contact interaction is created.

            useAllstar : [`Union`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html#typing.Union "(in Python v3.13)")[[`AbaqusBoolean`](../../kernel/utility.html#abaqus.UtilityAndView.abaqusConstants.AbaqusBoolean "abaqus.UtilityAndView.AbaqusBoolean.AbaqusBoolean (Python class)"), [`bool`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool "(in Python v3.13)")], default: `0`
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the contacting surface pair consists of all exterior faces,
                shell edges, beam segments, analytical rigid surfaces, and, when applicable, Eulerian
                material surfaces.

            globalSmoothing : [`Union`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html#typing.Union "(in Python v3.13)")[[`AbaqusBoolean`](../../kernel/utility.html#abaqus.UtilityAndView.abaqusConstants.AbaqusBoolean "abaqus.UtilityAndView.AbaqusBoolean.AbaqusBoolean (Python class)"), [`bool`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool "(in Python v3.13)")], default: `1`
            :   A Boolean specifying whether surface smoothing (geometric correction) is automatically
                applied to all eligible surfaces. The default value is ON.

            includedPairs : [`Optional`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html#typing.Optional "(in Python v3.13)")[[`RegionPairs`](#abaqus.Interaction.RegionPairs.RegionPairs "abaqus.Interaction.RegionPairs.RegionPairs (Python class) — Bases: object")], default: `None`
            :   A RegionPairs object specifying the domain pairs included in contact.

            excludedPairs : [`Optional`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html#typing.Optional "(in Python v3.13)")[[`RegionPairs`](#abaqus.Interaction.RegionPairs.RegionPairs "abaqus.Interaction.RegionPairs.RegionPairs (Python class) — Bases: object")], default: `None`
            :   A RegionPairs object specifying the domain pairs excluded from contact.

            contactPropertyAssignments : [`Optional`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html#typing.Optional "(in Python v3.13)")[[`ContactPropertyAssignment`](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactPropertyAssignment "abaqus.Interaction.ContactPropertyAssignment.ContactPropertyAssignment (Python class)")], default: `None`
            :   A ContactPropertyAssignment object specifying the contact property assignments in the
                contact domain.

            surfaceThicknessAssignments : [`Optional`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html#typing.Optional "(in Python v3.13)")[[`SurfaceThicknessAssignment`](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceThicknessAssignment.SurfaceThicknessAssignment "abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceThicknessAssignment.SurfaceThicknessAssignment (Python class) — Bases: object")], default: `None`
            :   A SurfaceThicknessAssignment object specifying the surface thickness assignments in the
                contact domain.

            surfaceOffsetAssignments : [`Optional`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html#typing.Optional "(in Python v3.13)")[[`SurfaceOffsetAssignment`](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceOffsetAssignment.SurfaceOffsetAssignment "abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceOffsetAssignment.SurfaceOffsetAssignment (Python class) — Bases: object")], default: `None`
            :   A SurfaceOffsetAssignment object specifying the surface offset fraction assignments in
                the contact domain.

            surfaceFeatureAssignments : [`Optional`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html#typing.Optional "(in Python v3.13)")[[`SurfaceFeatureAssignment`](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.SurfaceFeatureAssignment "abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.SurfaceFeatureAssignment (Python class) — Bases: object")], default: `None`
            :   A SurfaceFeatureAssignment object specifying the surface feature angle assignments in
                the contact domain.

            smoothingAssignments : [`Optional`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html#typing.Optional "(in Python v3.13)")[[`SmoothingAssignment`](#abaqus.Interaction.SmoothingAssignment.SmoothingAssignment "abaqus.Interaction.SmoothingAssignment.SmoothingAssignment (Python class) — Bases: object")], default: `None`
            :   A SmoothingAssignment object specifying the surface smoothing assignments in the contact
                domain.

            surfaceCrushTriggerAssignments : [`SurfaceCrushTriggerAssignment`](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceCrushTriggerAssignment.SurfaceCrushTriggerAssignment "abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceCrushTriggerAssignment.SurfaceCrushTriggerAssignment (Python class) — Bases: object"), default: `<abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceCrushTriggerAssignment.SurfaceCrushTriggerAssignment object at 0x7f850c5e3350>`
            :   A SurfaceCrushTriggerAssignment object specifying the surface crush trigger assignments
                in the contact domain.

                New in version 2021: The `surfaceCrushTriggerAssignments` argument was added.

            surfaceFrictionAssignments : [`SurfaceFrictionAssignment`](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFrictionAssignment.SurfaceFrictionAssignment "abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFrictionAssignment.SurfaceFrictionAssignment (Python class) — Bases: object"), default: `<abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFrictionAssignment.SurfaceFrictionAssignment object at 0x7f850c5e3690>`
            :   A SurfaceFrictionAssignment object specifying the surface friction assignments in the
                contact domain.

                New in version 2021: The `surfaceFrictionAssignments` argument was added.

            mainSecondaryAssignments : [`Optional`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html#typing.Optional "(in Python v3.13)")[[`MainSecondaryAssignment`](#abaqus.Interaction.MainSecondaryAssignment.MainSecondaryAssignment "abaqus.Interaction.MainSecondaryAssignment.MainSecondaryAssignment (Python class) — Bases: object")], default: `None`
            :   A MainSecondaryAssignment object specifying the main-secondary assignments in the
                contact domain.

                Changed in version 2022: The argument `masterSlaveAssignments` was renamed to `mainSecondaryAssignments`.

            polarityAssignments : [`PolarityAssignments`](#abaqus.Interaction.PolarityAssignments.PolarityAssignments "abaqus.Interaction.PolarityAssignments.PolarityAssignments (Python class) — Bases: object"), default: `<abaqus.Interaction.PolarityAssignments.PolarityAssignments object at 0x7f850c5e3090>`
            :   A PolarityAssignments object specifying the polarity assignments in the contact domain.

                New in version 2020: The `polarityAssignments` argument was added.

            :   A RegionPairs object specifying the domain pairs excluded from contact.

            :   A SurfaceBeamSmoothingAssignment object specifying the surface beam smoothing

            :   A SurfaceVertexCriteriaAssignment object specifying the surface vertex criteria
                assignments in the contact domain.

                New in version 2021: The `surfaceVertexCriteriaAssignments` argument was added.

            :   A sequence of tuples of SlidingFormulationAssignment specifying the sliding formulation assignments. Each tuple contains
                two entries:

                * A region object or the SymbolicConstant GLOBAL specifying the surface to which the

                  first surface. Possible values of the SymbolicConstant are NONE and SMALL\_SLIDING.

                New in version 2021: The `slidingFormulationAssignments` argument was added.

            :   A MainSecondaryAssignment object specifying the main-secondary assignments in the

            :   A SmoothingAssignment object specifying the surface smoothing assignments in the contact

    :   This method creates a CyclicSymmetry object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].CyclicSymmetry
        ```

        Note

        Check [CyclicSymmetry on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-cyclicsymmetryitnpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the repository key.

            createStepName[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.createStepName "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the step in which the cyclic symmetry interaction should
                be created.

            main[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.main "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Region object specifying the main surface.

                Changed in version 2022: The argument `master` was renamed to `main`.

            secondary[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.secondary "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Region object specifying the secondary surface.

                Changed in version 2022: The argument `slave` was renamed to `secondary`.

            repetitiveSectors[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.repetitiveSectors "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the total number of sectors in the cyclic symmetric model.

            axisPoint1[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.axisPoint1 "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Region object specifying the first point of the axis of symmetry. The region should
                contain exactly one mesh node, vertex, interesting point, reference point, or datum
                point. In a two-dimensional model **axisPoint1** is the only point used to define the axis
                of symmetry.

            axisPoint2[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.axisPoint2 "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Region object specifying the second point of the axis of symmetry. The region should
                contain exactly one mesh node, vertex, interesting point, reference point, or datum
                point. This point is ignored in a two-dimensional model.

            extractedNodalDiameter=`abaqusConstants.ALL_NODAL_DIAMETER`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.extractedNodalDiameter "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether Abaqus should extract all possible nodal diameters
                or the nodal diameters between the user-specified values for **lowestNodalDiameter** and
                **highestNodalDiameter**. Possible values are ALL\_NODAL\_DIAMETER and
                SPECIFIED\_NODAL\_DIAMETER. The default value is ALL\_NODAL\_DIAMETER.

            lowestNodalDiameter=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.lowestNodalDiameter "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the lowest nodal diameter to be used in the eigenfrequency analysis.
                The default value is 0.

            highestNodalDiameter=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.highestNodalDiameter "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the highest nodal diameter to be used in the eigenfrequency analysis.
                This argument value should be less than or equal to the half of the total number of
                sectors (as specified in the **repetitiveSectors** parameter). The default value is 0.

            excitationNodalDiameter=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.excitationNodalDiameter "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the nodal diameter for which the modal-based steady-state dynamic
                analysis will be performed. This value should be greater than or equal to the lowest
                nodal diameter (specified in the **lowestNodalDiameter** parameter), and less than or
                equal to the highest nodal diameter (specified in the **highestNodalDiameter** parameter).
                The default value is 0.

            adjustTie=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.adjustTie "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether or not to adjust the secondary surface of the cyclic
                symmetry to tie it to the main surface. The default value is ON.

            positionTolerance=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.positionTolerance "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the position tolerance. The\*positionTolerance\* argument applies only
                when **positionToleranceMethod** = SPECIFY\_TOLERANCE. The default value is 0.0.

            positionToleranceMethod=`abaqusConstants.COMPUTED_TOLERANCE`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.positionToleranceMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the method used to determine the position tolerance.
                Possible values are COMPUTED\_TOLERANCE and SPECIFY\_TOLERANCE. The default value is
                COMPUTED\_TOLERANCE.

        Returns:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry-returns "Permalink to this headline")
        :   A CyclicSymmetry object.

        Return type:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry-return-type "Permalink to this headline")
        :   [`CyclicSymmetry`](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry (Python class) — Bases: Interaction")

            :   A Region object specifying the name of the surface to which the film condition
                interaction is applied.

            definition[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.FilmCondition.definition "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying how the film condition is defined. Possible values are
                EMBEDDED\_COEFF, PROPERTY\_REF, USER\_SUB, and FIELD.

            interactionProperty=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.FilmCondition.interactionProperty "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the FilmConditionProp object associated with this
                interaction. The **interactionProperty** argument applies only when
                **definition** = PROPERTY\_REF. The default value is an empty string.

            sinkTemperature=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.FilmCondition.sinkTemperature "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the reference sink temperature, θ0θ0. The default value is 0.0.

            sinkAmplitude=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.FilmCondition.sinkAmplitude "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the Amplitude object that gives the variation of the
                sink temperature, θ0θ0, with time. The default value is an empty string. Note: Use empty
                string in an Abaqus/Standard analysis to specify that the reference sink temperature is
                applied immediately at the beginning of the step or linearly over the step. Use empty
                string in an Abaqus/Explicit analysis to specify that the reference sink temperature is
                applied throughout the step.

            filmCoeff=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.FilmCondition.filmCoeff "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the reference film coefficient value, hh. The **filmCoeff** argument
                applies when **definition** = EMBEDDED\_COEFF, **definition** = USER\_SUB, or **definition** = FIELD.
                The default value is 0.0.

            filmCoeffAmplitude=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.FilmCondition.filmCoeffAmplitude "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the Amplitude object that gives the variation of the
                film coefficient, hh, with time. The default value is an empty string. Note: Use empty
                string in an Abaqus/Standard analysis to specify that the reference film coefficient is
                applied immediately at the beginning of the step or linearly over the step. Use empty
                string in an Abaqus/Explicit analysis to specify that the reference film coefficient is
                applied throughout the step.

            field=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.FilmCondition.field "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the AnalyticalField object associated with this
                interaction. The **field** argument applies only when **definition** = FIELD. The default
                value is an empty string.

            sinkFieldName=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.FilmCondition.sinkFieldName "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the AnalyticalField or DiscreteField object associated
                with the sink temperature. The **sinkFieldName** argument applies only when
                **sinkDistributionType** = ANALYTICAL\_FIELD or **sinkDistributionType** = DISCRETE\_FIELD. The
                default value is an empty string.

            sinkDistributionType=`abaqusConstants.UNIFORM`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.FilmCondition.sinkDistributionType "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying how the sink temperature is distributed. Possible values
                are UNIFORM, ANALYTICAL\_FIELD, and DISCRETE\_FIELD. The default value is UNIFORM.

"Permalink to this definition")
    :   This method creates an IncidentWave object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].IncidentWave
        ```

        Note

        Check [IncidentWave on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-incidentwaveitnpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.IncidentWave-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.IncidentWave.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the repository key.

            createStepName[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.IncidentWave.createStepName "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the step in which the IncidentWave object is created.

            sourcePoint[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.IncidentWave.sourcePoint "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Region object specifying the incident wave source point.

            standoffPoint[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.IncidentWave.standoffPoint "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Region object specifying the incident wave standoff point.This argument is not valid
                when **definition** = CONWEP.

            surface[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.IncidentWave.surface "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Region object specifying the surface defining the incident wave interaction. In
                problems involving fluid/surface boundaries, both the fluid surface and the solid
                surface comprising the boundary must have an incident wave interaction specified.

            interactionProperty[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.IncidentWave.interactionProperty "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the IncidentWaveProperty object associated with this interaction.

            definition=`abaqusConstants.PRESSURE`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.IncidentWave.definition "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of incident wave to be defined. The value must be
                PRESSURE for linear perturbation steps. An Explicit step is required when the value is
                set to CONWEP. Possible values are PRESSURE, ACCELERATION, UNDEX, and CONWEP. The
                default value is PRESSURE.

            amplitude=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.IncidentWave.amplitude "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the Amplitude object that defines the fluid pressure
                time history at the standoff point, if **definition** = PRESSURE. If
                **definition** = ACCELERATION, then this string specifies the name of the Amplitude object
                that defines the fluid particle acceleration time history at the standoff point. This
                member can be specified only if **definition** = PRESSURE or ACCELERATION. The default value
                is an empty string.

            imaginaryAmplitude=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.IncidentWave.imaginaryAmplitude "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the Amplitude object that defines the imaginary
                component of the fluid pressure time history at the standoff point. This member is
                applicable only for linear perturbation steps and if **definition** = PRESSURE. The default
                value is an empty string.

            surfaceNormal=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.IncidentWave.surfaceNormal "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of three Floats specifying the X, Y, and Z components of the direction cosine
                of the fluid surface normal.This argument is valid only when **definition** = UNDEX.

            initialDepth=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.IncidentWave.initialDepth "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the initial depth of the UNDEX bubble. The default value is
                None.This argument is valid only when **definition** = UNDEX.

            referenceMagnitude=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.IncidentWave.referenceMagnitude "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the reference magnitude.This argument is not valid when
                **definition** = CONWEP.

            detonationTime=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.IncidentWave.detonationTime "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the time of detonation, given in total time.This argument is valid
                only when **definition** = CONWEP.

            magnitudeFactor=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.IncidentWave.magnitudeFactor "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the magnitude scale factor. The default value is 1.0.This argument is
                valid only when **definition** = CONWEP.

        Returns:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.IncidentWave-returns "Permalink to this headline")
        :   An IncidentWave object.

        Return type:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.IncidentWave-return-type "Permalink to this headline")
        :   [`IncidentWave`](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.IncidentWave "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.IncidentWave (Python class) — Bases: Interaction")

    :   This method creates a ModelChange object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].ModelChange
        ```

        Note

        Check [ModelChange on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-modelchangeitnpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ModelChange-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ModelChange.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the repository key.

            createStepName[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ModelChange.createStepName "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the step in which the ModelChange object is created.

            isRestart=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ModelChange.isRestart "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether this interaction is being used solely to indicate that
                model change may be required in a subsequent restart analysis (either for elements or
                contact pairs). The default value is OFF.

            regionType=`abaqusConstants.GEOMETRY`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ModelChange.regionType "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the region selection type. This argument is valid only
                when **isRestart** = False. Possible values are GEOMETRY, SKINS, STRINGERS, and ELEMENTS.
                The default value is GEOMETRY.

            region=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ModelChange.region "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Region object specifying the elements to be removed or reactivated. This argument is
                valid only when **isRestart** = False.

            activeInStep=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ModelChange.activeInStep "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether elements are being removed or reactivated. This argument is
                valid only when **isRestart** = False. The default value is OFF.

            includeStrain=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.ModelChange.includeStrain "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether stress/displacement elements are reactivated with strain.
                This argument is valid only when **isRestart** = False and when **activeInStep** = True. The
                default value is OFF.

            :   A String specifying the repository key.

            :   A String specifying the name of the step in which the PressurePenetration object is
                created.

            :   A String specifying the name of the Surface-to-surface contact (Standard) interaction.

            :   A RegionArray object specifying the points on the main surface that are exposed to the
                fluid.

            secondaryPoints[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.PressurePenetration.secondaryPoints "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A RegionArray object specifying the points on the secondary surface that are exposed to
                the fluid.

            :   A tuple of Floats specifying the fluid pressure magnitude. For steady state dynamic
                analyses, a tuple of Complexes specifying the fluid pressure magnitude.

            criticalPressure[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.PressurePenetration.criticalPressure "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A tuple of Floats specifying the critical contact pressure below which fluid penetration
                starts to occur.

            :   A String or the SymbolicConstant UNSET specifying the name of the amplitude reference.
                UNSET should be used if the load has no amplitude reference. The default value is UNSET.
                You should provide the **amplitude** argument only if it is valid for the specified step.

            penetrationTime=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.PressurePenetration.penetrationTime "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the fraction of the current step time over which the fluid pressure
                on newly penetrated contact surface segments is ramped up to the current magnitude. The
                default value is 0.001.

                interaction. The **field** argument applies only when **distributionType** = ANALYTICAL\_FIELD.

                the cavity radiation approximation. Possible values are AMBIENT and CAVITY. The default

            :   A Float specifying the reference ambient temperature, θ0θ0. This argument applies only
                when **radiationType** = AMBIENT. The default value is 0.0.

            :   A String specifying the name of the Amplitude object that gives the variation of the
                ambient temperature with time. Note: Use None in an Abaqus/Standard analysis to specify
                that the reference ambient temperature is applied immediately at the beginning of the
                step or linearly over the step. Use None in an Abaqus/Explicit analysis to specify that
                the reference ambient temperature is applied throughout the step. This argument applies
                only when **radiationType** = AMBIENT.

            :   A Boolean specifying whether shell/membrane element thickness is considered. The default

                0.5. The default value is 0.2.

            secondary[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.secondary "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Region object specifying the secondary surface.

                Changed in version 2022: The argument `slave` was renamed to `secondary`.

            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the contact formulation. Possible values are FINITE and

            :   A String specifying the name of the ContactProperty object associated with this
                interaction.

            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the mechanical constraint formulation. Possible values are
                KINEMATIC and PENALTY. The default value is KINEMATIC.

            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the weighting for node-to-face contact. Possible values
                are DEFAULT and SPECIFIED. The default value is DEFAULT.

            :   A Float specifying the weighting factor for the contact surfaces when

            :   A SymbolicConstant or a Float specifying the initial clearance at regions of contact.
                Possible values are OMIT and COMPUTED. The default value is OMIT.

            :   None or a sequence of Floats specifying the half thread angle used for bolt clearance.
