"Permalink to this definition")
    :   This method creates a SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd
        ```

        Note

        Check [SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-surfacetosurfacecontactstditnpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the repository key.

            createStepName[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.createStepName "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the step in which the SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd object
                is created.

            main[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.main "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Region object specifying the name of the main surface.

                Changed in version 2022: The `master` argument was renamed to `main`.

            secondary[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.secondary "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Region object specifying the name of the secondary surface.

                Changed in version 2022: The `slave` argument was renamed to `secondary`.

            sliding[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.sliding "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the contact formulation. Possible values are FINITE and
                SMALL.

            interactionProperty[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.interactionProperty "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the ContactProperty object associated with this
                interaction.

            interferenceType=`abaqusConstants.NONE`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.interferenceType "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of time-dependent allowable interference for
                contact pairs and contact elements. Possible values are:

                * NONE, specifying no allowable contact interference.
                * SHRINK\_FIT.
                * UNIFORM.

                The default value is NONE.

            overclosure=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.overclosure "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum overclosure distance allowed. This argument applies only
                when **interferenceType** = UNIFORM. The default value is 0.0.

            interferenceDirectionType=`abaqusConstants.COMPUTED`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.interferenceDirectionType "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the method used to determine the interference direction.
                Possible values are COMPUTED and DIRECTION\_COSINE. The default value is COMPUTED.

            direction=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.direction "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of three Floats specifying the following:

                * XX-direction cosine of the interference direction vector.
                * YY-direction cosine of the interference direction vector.
                * ZZ-direction cosine of the interference direction vector.

                This argument is required only when **interferenceDirectionType** = DIRECTION\_COSINE.

            amplitude=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.amplitude "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the amplitude curve that defines the magnitude of the
                prescribed interference during the step. Use None to specify that the prescribed
                interference is applied immediately at the beginning of the step and ramped down to zero
                linearly over the step.

            smooth=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.smooth "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the degree of smoothing used for deformable or rigid main surfaces
                involved when **enforcement** = NODE\_TO\_SURFACE. The value given must lie between 0.0 and
                0.5. The default value is 0.2.

            hcrit=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.hcrit "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the distance by which a secondary node must penetrate the main
                surface before Abaqus/Standard abandons the current increment and tries again with a
                smaller increment. The default value is 0.0.

            extensionZone=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.extensionZone "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying a fraction of the end segment or facet edge length by which the main
                surface is to be extended to avoid numerical round-off errors associated with contact
                modeling. The value given must lie between 0.0 and 0.2. The default value is 0.1.

            adjustMethod=`abaqusConstants.NONE`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.adjustMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the adjust method. Possible values are NONE, OVERCLOSED,
                TOLERANCE, and SET. The default value is NONE.

            adjustTolerance=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.adjustTolerance "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the adjust tolerance. The default value is 0.0.

            adjustSet=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.adjustSet "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Region object specifying the Set object to which the adjustment is to be applied.

            enforcement=`abaqusConstants.SURFACE_TO_SURFACE`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.enforcement "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the discretization method. Possible values are
                NODE\_TO\_SURFACE and SURFACE\_TO\_SURFACE. The default value is SURFACE\_TO\_SURFACE.

            thickness=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.thickness "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether shell/membrane element thickness is considered. The default
                value is ON.This argument is not valid when **sliding** = FINITE and
                **enforcement** = NODE\_TO\_SURFACE.

            contactControls=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.contactControls "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the ContactControl object associated with this
                interaction. The empty string indicates that the default contact controls will be used.
                The default value is an empty string.

            tied=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.tied "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the surfaces are to be “tied” together for the duration of
                the simulation. The default value is OFF.

            initialClearance=`abaqusConstants.OMIT`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.initialClearance "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant or a Float specifying the initial clearance at regions of contact.
                Possible values are OMIT and COMPUTED. The default value is OMIT.

            halfThreadAngle=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.halfThreadAngle "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a sequence of Floats specifying the half thread angle used for bolt clearance.
                The default value is None.

            pitch=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.pitch "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a sequence of Floats specifying the pitch used for bolt clearance. The default
                value is None.

            majorBoltDiameter=`abaqusConstants.COMPUTED`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.majorBoltDiameter "Permalink to this definition")
            :   The SymbolicConstant COMPUTED or a Float specifying the major diameter of the bolt used
                for bolt clearance. The default value is COMPUTED.

            meanBoltDiameter=`abaqusConstants.COMPUTED`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.meanBoltDiameter "Permalink to this definition")
            :   The SymbolicConstant COMPUTED or a Float specifying the mean diameter of the bolt used
                for bolt clearance. The default value is COMPUTED.

            datumAxis=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.datumAxis "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A DatumAxis object specifying the orientation of the bolt hole when specifying bolt
                clearance.

            useReverseDatumAxis=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.useReverseDatumAxis "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to reverse the bolt clearance direction given by the datum
                axis. The default value is OFF.

            clearanceRegion=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.clearanceRegion "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Region object specifying the contact region for which clearance is specified.

            surfaceSmoothing=`abaqusConstants.NONE`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.surfaceSmoothing "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether to use surface smoothing for geometric surfaces in
                SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd interactions. Possible values are AUTOMATIC and NONE. The
                default value is NONE.

            bondingSet=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.bondingSet "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Region object specifying the secondary node sub-set for bonding, used only when the
                contact property CohesiveBehavior option specifies use.

            handedness=`abaqusConstants.RIGHT`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.handedness "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the bolt handedness formulation. Possible values are RIGHT
                and LEFT. The default value is RIGHT.

                New in version 2019: The `normalAdjustment` argument was added.

            normalAdjustment=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.normalAdjustment "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the bolt normal adjustment formulation for all secondary
                nodes. Possible values are UNIFORM AXIAL COMPONENT and LOCATION DEPENDENT. The default
                value is UNIFORM AXIAL COMPONENT.

                New in version 2019: The `normalAdjustment` argument was added.

        Returns:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd-returns "Permalink to this headline")
        :   A SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd object.

        Return type:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd-return-type "Permalink to this headline")
        :   [`SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd`](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd (Python method) — This method creates a SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd object.")

"Permalink to this definition")
    :   This method creates an WearProperty object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].WearProperty
        ```

        New in version 2025: The `WearProperty` method was added.

        Note

        Check [WearProperty on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-wearpropertyitnpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.WearProperty-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.WearProperty.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the interaction property repository key.

            fricCoefDependency=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.WearProperty.fricCoefDependency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the Archard’s wear equation depends explicitly on the friction coefficient.
                The default value is OFF.

            unitlessWearCoefDependency=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.WearProperty.unitlessWearCoefDependency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the wear coefficient is dimensionless. The default value is OFF.

            referenceStress=`0.0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.WearProperty.referenceStress "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the value of the reference stress. This parameter is required if
                unitlessWearCoefDependency is ON.

            surfaceWearDistanceDependency=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.WearProperty.surfaceWearDistanceDependency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the wear coefficient is dependent on the wear distance. The default value is
                OFF.

            temperatureDependency=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.WearProperty.temperatureDependency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the wear coefficient is dependent on the surface temperature. The default
                value is OFF.

            contactPressureDependency=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.WearProperty.contactPressureDependency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the wear coefficient is dependent on the contact pressure. The default value
                is OFF.

            dependencies=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.WearProperty.dependencies "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of field variable dependencies. The default value is 0.

        Returns:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.WearProperty-returns "Permalink to this headline")
        :   A WearProperty object.

        Return type:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.WearProperty-return-type "Permalink to this headline")
        :   [`WearProperty`](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.WearProperty "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.WearProperty (Python method) — This method creates an WearProperty object.")

    XFEMCrackGrowth(*[name](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.XFEMCrackGrowth.name "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.XFEMCrackGrowth.name (Python parameter) — A String specifying the repository key.")*, *[createStepName](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.XFEMCrackGrowth.createStepName "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.XFEMCrackGrowth.createStepName (Python parameter) — A String specifying the name of the step in which the XFEMCrackGrowth object is created.")*, *[crackName](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.XFEMCrackGrowth.crackName "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.XFEMCrackGrowth.crackName (Python parameter) — A String specifying the XFEMCrack object associated with this interaction.")*, *[allowGrowth](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.XFEMCrackGrowth.allowGrowth "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.XFEMCrackGrowth.allowGrowth (Python parameter) — A Boolean specifying whether the crack is allowed to grow (propagate) during this analysis step.")=`1`*)[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L2463-L2492)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.XFEMCrackGrowth "Permalink to this definition")
    :   This method creates an XFEMCrackGrowth object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].XFEMCrackGrowth
        ```

        Note

        Check [XFEMCrackGrowth on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-xfemcrackgrowthitnpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.XFEMCrackGrowth-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.XFEMCrackGrowth.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the repository key.

            createStepName[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.XFEMCrackGrowth.createStepName "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the step in which the XFEMCrackGrowth object is created.

            crackName[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.XFEMCrackGrowth.crackName "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the XFEMCrack object associated with this interaction.

    :   This method uses contact detection to create SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd, SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp,
        and Tie objects.

        Note

        Check [InteractionModel.contactDetection on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-modelitnpyc.htm?contextscope=all#simaker-modelcontactdetectionpyc).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.contactDetection-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.contactDetection.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the prefix used to generate repository keys. The default value is
                “CP-”

            createStepName=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.contactDetection.createStepName "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the step in which the SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd,
                SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp, and Tie objects are created. The default value is “Initial.”

            searchDomain=`abaqusConstants.MODEL`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.contactDetection.searchDomain "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant MODEL or a sequence of Strings specifying the names of instances to
                search. MODEL indicates the whole model is searched. The default value is MODEL.

            defaultType=`abaqusConstants.CONTACT`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.contactDetection.defaultType "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the default type of object to create. Possible values are
                CONTACT, CONTACT\_STANDARD, CONTACT\_EXPLICIT, and TIE. If CONTACT is used, the behavior
                is determined by the type of Step in the model. If an ExplicitDynamicsStep or
                TempDisplacementDynamicsStep exists, then SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp is created by
                default. Otherwise SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd is created by default. The default value
                is CONTACT.

            interactionProperty=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.contactDetection.interactionProperty "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the ContactProperty object associated with any
                interactions created.

            separationTolerance=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.contactDetection.separationTolerance "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum separation for considering two surfaces to be candidates
                for contact, where separation is the maximum distance between the points of closest
                approach on the two surfaces. The default value is a function of the model.

            extendByAngle=`20`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.contactDetection.extendByAngle "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the angle for extending surface definitions to include
                adjacent faces. The default value is 20.

            mergeWithinAngle=`20`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.contactDetection.mergeWithinAngle "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the angle for merging adjacent contact pairs that lie within
                the angle. The default value is 20.

            searchSingleInstances=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.contactDetection.searchSingleInstances "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to include surface pairs within a single instance. The
                default value is OFF.

            nameEachSurfaceFound=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.contactDetection.nameEachSurfaceFound "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to assign a name to each surface found. The default value
                is ON.

            createUnionOfMainSurfaces=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.contactDetection.createUnionOfMainSurfaces "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to create a surface that is the union of all main surfaces
                found. The default value is OFF.

                Changed in version 2022: The argument `createUnionOfMasterSurfaces` was renamed to `createUnionOfMainSurfaces`.

            createUnionOfSecondarySurfaces=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.contactDetection.createUnionOfSecondarySurfaces "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to create a surface that is the union of all secondary
                surfaces found. The default value is OFF.

                Changed in version 2022: The argument `createUnionOfSlaveSurfaces` was renamed to `createUnionOfSecondarySurfaces`.

            createUnionOfMainSecondarySurfaces=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.contactDetection.createUnionOfMainSecondarySurfaces "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to create a surface that is the union of all main and
                secondary surfaces found. The default value is OFF.

                Changed in version 2022: The argument `createUnionOfMasterSlaveSurfaces` was renamed to `createUnionOfMainSecondarySurfaces`.

            includePlanar=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.contactDetection.includePlanar "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to include planar geometry. The default value is ON.

            includeCylindricalSphericalToric=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.contactDetection.includeCylindricalSphericalToric "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to include cylindrical, spherical, and toric geometry. The
                default value is ON.

            includeSplineBased=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.contactDetection.includeSplineBased "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to include spline-based geometry. The default value is ON.

            includeMeshSolid=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.contactDetection.includeMeshSolid "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to include solid mesh entities. The default value is ON.

            includeMeshShell=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.contactDetection.includeMeshShell "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to include shell mesh entities. The default value is ON.

            includeMeshMembrane=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.contactDetection.includeMeshMembrane "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to include mesh membrane entities. The default value is
                OFF.

            includeOverclosed=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.contactDetection.includeOverclosed "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to include overclosed pairs. The default value is ON.

            includeNonOverlapping=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.contactDetection.includeNonOverlapping "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to include opposing geometry surfaces that do not overlap.
                The default value is OFF.

            meshedGeometrySearchTechnique=`abaqusConstants.USE_GEOMETRY`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.contactDetection.meshedGeometrySearchTechnique "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant USE\_GEOMETRY or USE\_MESH specifying whether to locate pairs in meshed
                geometry using the geometric entities or mesh entities. The default value is
                USE\_GEOMETRY.

            useShellThickness=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.contactDetection.useShellThickness "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to account for shell thickness and offset during contact
                detection. The default value is ON.

            surfaceSmoothing=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.contactDetection.surfaceSmoothing "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether to use surface smoothing for geometric surfaces in
                SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd interactions. Possible values are NONE and AUTOMATIC. The
                default value isAUTOMATIC.

        Return type:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.contactDetection-return-type "Permalink to this headline")
        :   `None.`

    getSurfaceSeparation()[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L229-L246)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.getSurfaceSeparation "Permalink to this definition")
    :   This method returns a list of all possible contacts that can be created using the ContactDetection
        method.

        Returns:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.getSurfaceSeparation-returns "Permalink to this headline")
        :   Tuple of tuples, where each tuple holds information, to be used in contact creation as
            follows:

            * A string specifying the name of the main surface used in contact.
            * A string specifying the name of the secondary surface used in contact.
            * A float specifying the separation distance between the main surface and the secondary
              surface.
            * A boolean specifying whether or not contact surfaces are overclosed.

        Return type:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InteractionModel.getSurfaceSeparation-return-type "Permalink to this headline")
        :   `tuple[tuple[str`, [`str`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str "(in Python v3.13)"), [`float`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#float "(in Python v3.13)"), `bool]]`

"Permalink to this definition")
    :   This method creates an ExpContactControl object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].ExpContactControl
        ```

        Note

        Check [ExpContactControl on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-expcontactcontrolpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.InteractionContactControlModel.ExpContactControl-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.InteractionContactControlModel.ExpContactControl.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the contact controls repository key.

            globTrkChoice=`abaqusConstants.DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.InteractionContactControlModel.ExpContactControl.globTrkChoice "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether or not the default value will be used for the
                maximum number of increments between global contact searches. Possible values are
                DEFAULT and SPECIFY. The default value is DEFAULT.

            globTrkInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.InteractionContactControlModel.ExpContactControl.globTrkInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the maximum number of increments between global contact searches. The
                **globTrkInc** argument applies only when **globTrkChoice** = SPECIFY. The default value is
                100 for surface-to-surface contact and 4 for self-contact.

            fastLocalTrk=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.InteractionContactControlModel.ExpContactControl.fastLocalTrk "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to use the more computationally efficient local tracking
                method. The default value is ON.

            scalePenalty=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.InteractionContactControlModel.ExpContactControl.scalePenalty "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the factor by which Abaqus/Explicit will scale the default penalty
                stiffness to obtain the stiffnesses used for the penalty contact pairs. The default
                value is 1.0.

            warpCheckPeriod=`20`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.InteractionContactControlModel.ExpContactControl.warpCheckPeriod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of increments between checks for highly warped facets on
                main surfaces. The default value is 20.

            warpCutoff=`20`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.InteractionContactControlModel.ExpContactControl.warpCutoff "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the out-of-plane warping angle (in degrees), at which a facet will be
                considered to be highly warped. The default value is 20.0.

        Returns:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.InteractionContactControlModel.ExpContactControl-returns "Permalink to this headline")
        :   An ExpContactControl object.

        Return type:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.InteractionContactControlModel.ExpContactControl-return-type "Permalink to this headline")
        :   [`ExpContactControl`](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.ExpContactControl "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.ExpContactControl (Python class) — Bases: ContactControl")

"Permalink to this definition")
    :   This method creates an StdContactControl object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].StdContactControl
        ```

        Note

        Check [StdContactControl on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-stdcontactcontrolpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.InteractionContactControlModel.StdContactControl-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.InteractionContactControlModel.StdContactControl.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the contact controls repository key.

            stiffnessScaleFactor=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.InteractionContactControlModel.StdContactControl.stiffnessScaleFactor "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the factor by which Abaqus/Standard will scale the default penalty
                stiffness to obtain the stiffnesses used for the contact pairs. Only contact
                interactions defined with augmented Lagrangian surface behavior will be affected by this
                argument. The default value is 1.0.

            penetrationTolChoice=`abaqusConstants.RELATIVE`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.InteractionContactControlModel.StdContactControl.penetrationTolChoice "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether the allowable penetration is an absolute value or
                a value relative to the characteristic contact surface face dimension. Only contact
                interactions defined with augmented Lagrangian surface behavior will be affected by this
                argument. Possible values are RELATIVE and ABSOLUTE. The default value is RELATIVE.

            relativePenetrationTolerance=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.InteractionContactControlModel.StdContactControl.relativePenetrationTolerance "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the ratio of the allowable penetration to the characteristic contact
                surface face dimension. The float values represent percentages (e.g.: 0.001=0.1%). Only
                contact interactions defined with augmented Lagrangian surface behavior will be affected
                by this argument. The default value is 10⁻³.The **relativePenetrationTolerance** argument
                applies only when **penetrationTolChoice** = RELATIVE. The **relativePenetrationTolerance**
                and **absolutePenetrationTolerance** arguments are mutually exclusive.

            absolutePenetrationTolerance=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.InteractionContactControlModel.StdContactControl.absolutePenetrationTolerance "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the allowable penetration. Only contact interactions defined
                with augmented Lagrangian surface behavior will be affected by this argument. The
                **absolutePenetrationTolerance** argument applies only when
                **penetrationTolChoice** = ABSOLUTE. The **relativePenetrationTolerance** and
                **absolutePenetrationTolerance** arguments are mutually exclusive. The default value is
                None.

            frictionOnset=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.InteractionContactControlModel.StdContactControl.frictionOnset "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying when the application of friction occurs. Possible values
                are:

                * IMMEDIATE, specifying the friction is included in the increment when contact occurs.
                * DELAYED, specifying the application of friction is delayed until the increment after
                  contact occurs.

            automaticTolerances=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.InteractionContactControlModel.StdContactControl.automaticTolerances "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether Abaqus/Standard should automatically compute an overclosure
                tolerance and a separation tolerance to prevent chattering in contact. The default value
                is OFF.The **automaticTolerances** argument cannot be used with the **maxchp**, **perrmx**,
                and **uerrmx** arguments.

            maxchp=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.InteractionContactControlModel.StdContactControl.maxchp "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the maximum number of points that are permitted to violate contact
                conditions in any increment. The default value is 0.Either the **perrmx** or the **uerrmx**
                argument must be specified in conjunction with the **maxchp** argument.

            perrmx=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.InteractionContactControlModel.StdContactControl.perrmx "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum value of tensile stress (tensile force in GAP- or
                ITT-type contact elements) allowed to be transmitted at a contact point. The default
                value is 0.0.The **perrmx** argument must be specified in conjunction with the **maxchp**
                argument.

            uerrmx=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.InteractionContactControlModel.StdContactControl.uerrmx "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum overclosure distance allowed at a secondary node that is
                considered to be open. The default value is 0.0.The **uerrmx** argument must be specified
                in conjunction with the **maxchp** argument.

                Changed in version 2022: Slave node was changed to secondary node.

            stabilizeChoice=`abaqusConstants.NONE`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.InteractionContactControlModel.StdContactControl.stabilizeChoice "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether or not viscous damping will be specified, and if
                so, how it will be specified. Possible values are NONE, AUTOMATIC, and COEFFICIENT. The
                default value is NONE.

            dampFactor=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.InteractionContactControlModel.StdContactControl.dampFactor "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the value of the damping factor. This value is multiplied by the
                calculated damping coefficient. The default value is 1.0.This argument is only valid
                when **stabilizeChoice** = AUTOMATIC.

            dampCoef=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.InteractionContactControlModel.StdContactControl.dampCoef "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the damping coefficient. The default value is 0.0.This argument is
                only valid when **stabilizeChoice** = COEFFICIENT.

            tangFraction=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.InteractionContactControlModel.StdContactControl.tangFraction "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the tangential stabilization as a fraction of the normal
                stabilization (damping). The default value is 1.0.This argument is valid only if
                **stabilizeChoice** = AUTOMATIC or COEFFICIENT.

            eosFraction=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.InteractionContactControlModel.StdContactControl.eosFraction "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the fraction of the damping that remains at the end of the step. The
                default value is 0.0.This argument is valid only if **stabilizeChoice** = AUTOMATIC or
                COEFFICIENT.

            zeroDampingChoice=`abaqusConstants.COMPUTE`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.InteractionContactControlModel.StdContactControl.zeroDampingChoice "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying how the zero-damping clearance will be specified. Possible
                values are COMPUTE and SPECIFY. The default value is COMPUTE.This argument is valid only
                if **stabilizeChoice** = AUTOMATIC or COEFFICIENT.

            zeroDamping=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.InteractionContactControlModel.StdContactControl.zeroDamping "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the clearance at which damping becomes zero. This argument is
                valid only when **zeroDampingChoice** = SPECIFY. This argument is valid only if
                **stabilizeChoice** = AUTOMATIC or COEFFICIENT. The default value is None.

            enforceWithLagrangeMultipliers=`abaqusConstants.DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.InteractionContactControlModel.StdContactControl.enforceWithLagrangeMultipliers "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether to enforce the contact constraints with Lagrange
                multipliers. Possible values are DEFAULT, ENFORCEMENT\_OFF, and ENFORCEMENT\_ON. The
                default value is DEFAULT.

        Returns:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactControlModel.InteractionContactControlModel.StdContactControl-returns "Permalink to this headline")

"Permalink to this definition")
    :   This method creates an ExpInitialization object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].ExpInitialization
        ```

        Note

        Check [ExpInitialization on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-expinitializationpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactInitializationModel.InteractionContactInitializationModel.ExpInitialization-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactInitializationModel.InteractionContactInitializationModel.ExpInitialization.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the contact initialization repository key.

            overclosureType=`abaqusConstants.ADJUST`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactInitializationModel.InteractionContactInitializationModel.ExpInitialization.overclosureType "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of overclosure to be defined. Possible values are
                ADJUST, INTERFERENCE, and CLEARANCE. The default value is ADJUST.

            interferenceDistance=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactInitializationModel.InteractionContactInitializationModel.ExpInitialization.interferenceDistance "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the interference distance. This argument is valid only when
                **overclosureType** = INTERFERENCE. The default value is None.

            clearanceDistance=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactInitializationModel.InteractionContactInitializationModel.ExpInitialization.clearanceDistance "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the initial clearance distance. This argument is valid only
                when **overclosureType** = CLEARANCE and must be specified in that case. The default value
                is None.

            openingTolerance=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactInitializationModel.InteractionContactInitializationModel.ExpInitialization.openingTolerance "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the distance tolerance within which initial openings will
                undergo strain-free adjustments. This argument is not valid when
                **overclosureType** = INTERFERENCE unless a value has been specified for
                **interferenceDistance**. The default value is None.

            overclosureTolerance=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactInitializationModel.InteractionContactInitializationModel.ExpInitialization.overclosureTolerance "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the distance tolerance within which initial overclosures will
                undergo strain-free adjustments. The default value is None.

            adjustNodalCoords=`True`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactInitializationModel.InteractionContactInitializationModel.ExpInitialization.adjustNodalCoords "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to resolve clearances/overclosures by adjusting the nodal
                coordinates without creating strain in the model. **adjustNodalCoords** = True can be used
                only for clearances/overclosures defined in the first step of an analysis. The default
                value is True.

            secondaryNodesetName=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactInitializationModel.InteractionContactInitializationModel.ExpInitialization.secondaryNodesetName "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the node set containing the secondary nodes to be
                included in the initial clearance specification. This argument is not valid when
                **overclosureType** = INTERFERENCE and if **openingTolerance** or **overclosureTolerance** is
                specified. The default value is None.

                Changed in version 2022: The argument `slaveNodesetName` was renamed to `secondaryNodesetName`.

            stepFraction=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactInitializationModel.InteractionContactInitializationModel.ExpInitialization.stepFraction "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the fraction of the step time (between 0.0 and 1.0) in which the
                interference fit has to be solved. The default value is 1.0. This argument is valid only
                when **overclosureType** = INTERFERENCE.

        :   An ExpInitialization object.

    :   This method creates a StdInitialization object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].StdInitialization
        ```

        New in version 2020: The `ExpInitialization` method was added.

        Note

        Check [StdInitialization on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-stdinitializationpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactInitializationModel.InteractionContactInitializationModel.StdInitialization-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactInitializationModel.InteractionContactInitializationModel.StdInitialization.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the contact initialization repository key.

            overclosureType=`abaqusConstants.ADJUST`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactInitializationModel.InteractionContactInitializationModel.StdInitialization.overclosureType "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of overclosure to be defined. Possible values are
                ADJUST, INTERFERENCE, and CLEARANCE. The default value is ADJUST.

            interferenceDistance=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactInitializationModel.InteractionContactInitializationModel.StdInitialization.interferenceDistance "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the interference distance. This argument is valid only when
                **overclosureType** = INTERFERENCE. The default value is None.

            clearanceDistance=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactInitializationModel.InteractionContactInitializationModel.StdInitialization.clearanceDistance "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the initial clearance distance. This argument is valid only
                when **overclosureType** = CLEARANCE, and must be specified in that case. The default value
                is None.

            openingTolerance=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactInitializationModel.InteractionContactInitializationModel.StdInitialization.openingTolerance "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the distance tolerance within which initial openings will
                undergo strain-free adjustments. This argument is not valid when
                **overclosureType** = INTERFERENCE unless a value has been specified for
                **interferenceDistance**. The default value is None.

            overclosureTolerance=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactInitializationModel.InteractionContactInitializationModel.StdInitialization.overclosureTolerance "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the distance tolerance within which initial overclosures will
                undergo strain-free adjustments.. The default value is None.

    :   This method creates a StdStabilization object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].StdStabilization
        ```

        Note

        Check [StdStabilization on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-stdstabilizationpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactStabilizationModel.InteractionContactStabilizationModel.StdStabilization-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactStabilizationModel.InteractionContactStabilizationModel.StdStabilization.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the contact stabilization repository key.

            zeroDistance=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactStabilizationModel.InteractionContactStabilizationModel.StdStabilization.zeroDistance "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the clearance distance at which the stabilization becomes
                zero. The default value is None.

            reductionFactor=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactStabilizationModel.InteractionContactStabilizationModel.StdStabilization.reductionFactor "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the factor by which the analysis will reduce the contact
                stabilization coefficient per increment. The default value is 0.1.

            scaleFactor=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactStabilizationModel.InteractionContactStabilizationModel.StdStabilization.scaleFactor "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the factor by which the analysis will scale the contact stabilization
                coefficient. The default value is 1.0.

            tangentialFactor=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactStabilizationModel.InteractionContactStabilizationModel.StdStabilization.tangentialFactor "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the factor that scales the contact stabilization coefficient in the
                tangential direction. The default value is 0.0.

            amplitude=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactStabilizationModel.InteractionContactStabilizationModel.StdStabilization.amplitude "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the Amplitude object that defines a time-dependent scale
                factor for contact stabilization over the step. The default value is an empty string.

            reset=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactStabilizationModel.InteractionContactStabilizationModel.StdStabilization.reset "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to cancel carryover effects from contact stabilization
                specifications involving nondefault amplitudes that appeared in previous steps. The
                default value is OFF.

    AcousticImpedanceProp(*[name](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.AcousticImpedanceProp.name "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.AcousticImpedanceProp.name (Python parameter) — A String specifying the interaction property repository key.")*, *[tableType](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.AcousticImpedanceProp.tableType "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.AcousticImpedanceProp.tableType (Python parameter) — A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of tabular data to be defined.")*, *[table](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.AcousticImpedanceProp.table "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.AcousticImpedanceProp.table (Python parameter) — A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying acoustic impedance properties.If tableType = IMPEDANCE, each sequence of the table data specifies:The real part of the complex impedance.The imaginary part of the complex impedance.Frequency, if the data depend on frequency.If tableType = ADMITTANCE, each sequence of the table data specifies:The real part of the complex admittance.The imaginary part of the complex admittance.Frequency, if the data depend on frequency.")*, *[frequencyDependency](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.AcousticImpedanceProp.frequencyDependency "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.AcousticImpedanceProp.frequencyDependency (Python parameter) — A Boolean specifying whether the table data depend on frequency.")=`0`*)[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionPropertyModel.py#L32-L73)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.AcousticImpedanceProp "Permalink to this definition")
    :   This method creates an AcousticImpedanceProp object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].AcousticImpedanceProp
        ```

        Note

        Check [AcousticImpedanceProp on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-acousticimpedanceproppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.AcousticImpedanceProp-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.AcousticImpedanceProp.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the interaction property repository key.

            tableType[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.AcousticImpedanceProp.tableType "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of tabular data to be defined. Possible values
                are IMPEDANCE and ADMITTANCE.

            table[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.AcousticImpedanceProp.table "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying acoustic impedance properties.If
                **tableType** = IMPEDANCE, each sequence of the table data specifies:The real part of the
                complex impedance.The imaginary part of the complex impedance.Frequency, if the data
                depend on frequency.If **tableType** = ADMITTANCE, each sequence of the table data
                specifies:The real part of the complex admittance.The imaginary part of the complex
                admittance.Frequency, if the data depend on frequency.

            frequencyDependency=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.AcousticImpedanceProp.frequencyDependency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the **table** data depend on frequency. The default value is
                OFF.

        Returns:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.AcousticImpedanceProp-returns "Permalink to this headline")
        :   An AcousticImpedanceProp object.

        Return type:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.AcousticImpedanceProp-return-type "Permalink to this headline")
        :   [`AcousticImpedanceProp`](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.AcousticImpedanceProp "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.AcousticImpedanceProp (Python class) — Bases: ContactProperty")

"Permalink to this definition")
    :   This method creates a FluidCavityProperty object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].FluidCavityProperty
        ```

        Note

        Check [FluidCavityProperty on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-fluidcavitypropertypyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the interaction property repository key.

            definition=`abaqusConstants.HYDRAULIC`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.definition "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of fluid cavity property to be defined. Possible
                values are HYDRAULIC and PNEUMATIC. The default value is HYDRAULIC.

            fluidDensity=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.fluidDensity "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the reference fluid density. This argument is applicable only
                when **definition** = HYDRAULIC, and is required in that case. The default value is None.

            molecularWeight=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.molecularWeight "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the molecular weight of the ideal gas species. This argument
                is applicable only when **definition** = PNEUMATIC, and is required in that case. The
                default value is None.

            useExpansion=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.useExpansion "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether thermal expansion coefficients will be defined. This
                argument is applicable only when **definition** = HYDRAULIC. The default value is OFF.

            expansionTempDep=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.expansionTempDep "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the thermal fluid expansion data will have temperature
                dependency. This argument is applicable only when **definition** = HYDRAULIC and when
                **useExpansion** = True. The default value is OFF.

            expansionDependencies=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.expansionDependencies "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of field variable dependencies in the thermal fluid
                expansion data. This argument is applicable only when **definition** = HYDRAULIC and when
                **useExpansion** = True. The default value is 0.

            referenceTemperature=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.referenceTemperature "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the reference temperature for the coefficient of thermal expansion.
                This argument is applicable only when **definition** = HYDRAULIC, when **useExpansion** = True,
                and when either **expansionTempDep** = True or when **expansionDependencies** is greater than
                0. The default value is 0.0.

            expansionTable=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.expansionTable "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the thermal expansion coefficients. This
                argument is applicable only when **definition** = HYDRAULIC and when **useExpansion** = True.
                Each sequence contains the following data:

                * The mean coefficient of thermal expansion.
                * Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
                * Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
                * Value of the second field variable.
                * Etc.

            useBulkModulus=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.useBulkModulus "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether fluid bulk modulus values will be defined. This argument is
                applicable only when **definition** = HYDRAULIC. The default value is OFF.

            bulkModulusTempDep=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.bulkModulusTempDep "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the fluid bulk modulus data will have temperature
                dependency. This argument is applicable only when **definition** = HYDRAULIC and when
                **useBulkModulus** = True. The default value is OFF.

            bulkModulusDependencies=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.bulkModulusDependencies "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of field variable dependencies in the fluid bulk modulus
                data. This argument is applicable only when **definition** = HYDRAULIC and when
                **useBulkModulus** = True. The default value is 0.

            bulkModulusTable=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.bulkModulusTable "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the fluid bulk modulus values. This
                argument is applicable only when **definition** = HYDRAULIC and when **useBulkModulus** = True.
                Each sequence contains the following data:

                * The fluid bulk modulus.
                * Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
                * Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
                * Value of the second field variable.
                * Etc.

            useCapacity=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.useCapacity "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether molar heat capacity values will be defined. This argument
                is applicable only when **definition** = PNEUMATIC. The default value is OFF.

            capacityType=`abaqusConstants.POLYNOMIAL`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.capacityType "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the method to define the molar heat capacity. Possible
                values are POLYNOMIAL and TABULAR. The default value is POLYNOMIAL.

            capacityTempDep=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.capacityTempDep "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the molar heat capacity data will have temperature
                dependency. This argument is applicable only when **definition** = PNEUMATIC, when
                **useCapacity** = True, and when **capacityType** = TABULAR. The default value is OFF.

            capacityDependencies=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.capacityDependencies "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of field variable dependencies in the molar heat capacity
                data. This argument is applicable only when **definition** = PNEUMATIC, when
                **useCapacity** = True, and when **capacityType** = TABULAR. The default value is 0.

            capacityTable=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.capacityTable "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the molar heat capacity values in the form
                of a polynomial expression. This argument is applicable only when
                **definition** = PNEUMATIC, when **useCapacity** = True, and when **capacityType** = POLYNOMIAL. In
                this form, only one sequence is specified and that sequence contains the following data:

                * The first molar heat capacity coefficient.
                * The second molar heat capacity coefficient.
                * The third molar heat capacity coefficient.
                * The fourth molar heat capacity coefficient.
                * The fifth molar heat capacity coefficient.

                Alternatively, the sequence data may specify the molar heat capacity values at constant
                pressure for an ideal gas species. This argument is applicable only when
                **definition** = PNEUMATIC, when **useCapacity** = True, and when **capacityType** = TABULAR. Each
                sequence contains the following data:

                * The molar heat capacity at constant pressure.
                * Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
                * Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
                * Value of the second field variable.
                * Etc.

        Returns:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty-returns "Permalink to this headline")
        :   A FluidCavityProperty object.

        Return type:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty-return-type "Permalink to this headline")
        :   [`FluidCavityProperty`](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty (Python class) — Bases: ContactProperty")

    FluidExchangeProperty(*[name](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidExchangeProperty.name "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidExchangeProperty.name (Python parameter) — A String specifying the interaction property repository key.")*, *[dataTable](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidExchangeProperty.dataTable "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidExchangeProperty.dataTable (Python parameter) — A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the viscous and hydrodynamic resistance coefficients when definition = BULK_VISCOSITY.")*, *[definition](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidExchangeProperty.definition "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidExchangeProperty.definition (Python parameter) — A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of fluid exchange property to be defined. Possible values are BULK_VISCOSITY, MASS_FLUX, MASS_RATE_LEAK, VOL_FLUX, and VOL_RATE_LEAK.")=`abaqusConstants.BULK_VISCOSITY`*, *[pressureDependency](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidExchangeProperty.pressureDependency "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidExchangeProperty.pressureDependency (Python parameter) — A Boolean specifying whether the data will have pressure dependency.")=`0`*, *[temperatureDependency](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidExchangeProperty.temperatureDependency "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidExchangeProperty.temperatureDependency (Python parameter) — A Boolean specifying whether the data will have temperature dependency.")=`0`*, *[fieldDependencies](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidExchangeProperty.fieldDependencies "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidExchangeProperty.fieldDependencies (Python parameter) — An Int specifying the number of field variable dependencies in the data.")=`0`*)[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionPropertyModel.py#L363-L467)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidExchangeProperty "Permalink to this definition")
    :   This method creates a FluidExchangeProperty object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].FluidExchangeProperty
        ```

        Note

        Check [FluidExchangeProperty on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-fluidexchangepropertypyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidExchangeProperty-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidExchangeProperty.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the interaction property repository key.

            dataTable[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidExchangeProperty.dataTable "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the viscous and hydrodynamic resistance
                coefficients when **definition** = BULK\_VISCOSITY. Each sequence contains the following
                data:

                * The viscous resistance coefficient.
                * The hydrodynamic resistance coefficient.
                * The average absolute pressure, if the data depend on pressure.
                * The average temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
                * The value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
                * The value of the second field variable.
                * Etc.

                Alternatively, the sequence data may specify the mass flow rate. This is applicable only
                when **definition** = MASS\_FLUX. In this form, only one sequence is specified and that
                sequence contains the following data:

                * The mass flow rate per unit area.

                Alternatively, the sequence data may specify the mass rate leakage. This is applicable
                only when **definition** = MASS\_RATE\_LEAK. Each sequence contains the following data:

                * The absolute value of the mass flow rate per unit area. (The first tabular value
                  entered must always be zero.)
                * The absolute value of the pressure difference. (The first tabular value entered must
                  always be zero.)
                * The average absolute pressure, if the data depend on pressure.
                * The average temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
                * The value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
                * The value of the second field variable.
                * Etc.

                Alternatively, the sequence data may specify the volume flow rate. This is applicable
                only when **definition** = VOL\_FLUX. In this form, only one sequence is specified and that
                sequence contains the following data:

                * The volumetric flow rate per unit area.

                Alternatively, the sequence data may specify the volume rate leakage. This is applicable
                only when **definition** = VOL\_RATE\_LEAK. Each sequence contains the following data:

                * The absolute value of the volumetric flow rate per unit area. (The first tabular value
                  entered must always be zero.)
                * The absolute value of the pressure difference. (The first tabular value entered must
                  always be zero.)
                * The average absolute pressure, if the data depend on pressure.
                * The average temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
                * The value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
                * The value of the second field variable.
                * Etc.

            definition=`abaqusConstants.BULK_VISCOSITY`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidExchangeProperty.definition "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of fluid exchange property to be defined.
                Possible values are BULK\_VISCOSITY, MASS\_FLUX, MASS\_RATE\_LEAK, VOL\_FLUX, and
                VOL\_RATE\_LEAK. The default value is BULK\_VISCOSITY.

            pressureDependency=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidExchangeProperty.pressureDependency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the data will have pressure dependency. This argument is
                applicable only when **definition** = BULK\_VISCOSITY, or when **definition** = MASS\_RATE\_LEAK,
                or when **definition** = VOL\_RATE\_LEAK. The default value is OFF.

            temperatureDependency=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidExchangeProperty.temperatureDependency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the data will have temperature dependency. This argument is
                applicable only when **definition** = BULK\_VISCOSITY, or when **definition** = MASS\_RATE\_LEAK,
                or when **definition** = VOL\_RATE\_LEAK. The default value is OFF.

            fieldDependencies=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidExchangeProperty.fieldDependencies "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of field variable dependencies in the data. This argument
                is applicable only when **definition** = BULK\_VISCOSITY, or when
                **definition** = MASS\_RATE\_LEAK, or when **definition** = VOL\_RATE\_LEAK. The default value is 0.

        Returns:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidExchangeProperty-returns "Permalink to this headline")
        :   A FluidExchangeProperty object.
