    :   This method creates a FluidInflatorProperty object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].FluidInflatorProperty
        ```

        New in version 2019: The `FluidInflatorProperty` method was added.

        Note

        Check [FluidInflatorProperty on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-fluidinflatorpropertypyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidInflatorProperty-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidInflatorProperty.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the interaction property repository key.

            definition[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidInflatorProperty.definition "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Symbolic constant specifying the method used for modeling the flow characteristics of
                inflators. The default value is **definition** = DUAL PRESSURE. The possible values are DUAL
                PRESSURE, PRESSURE AND MASS, TANK TEST, and TEMPERATURE AND MASS.

            effectiveArea[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidInflatorProperty.effectiveArea "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the total inflator orifice area. This argument is applicable only if
                **definition** = DUAL PRESSURE or **definition** = PRESSURE AND MASS.

            tankVolume[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidInflatorProperty.tankVolume "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the tank volume. This argument is applicable only if
                **definition** = DUAL PRESSURE or **definition** = TANK TEST.

            dischargeCoefficient=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidInflatorProperty.dischargeCoefficient "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the discharge coefficient. This argument is applicable only if
                **definition** = DUAL PRESSURE or **definition** = PRESSURE AND MASS.

            dataTable=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidInflatorProperty.dataTable "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the items described in the “Table data”
                section below.

            numFluids=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidInflatorProperty.numFluids "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of gas species used for this inflator.

            mixtureType=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidInflatorProperty.mixtureType "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Symbolic constant specifying whether to use mass fraction or the molar fraction for a
                mixture of ideal gases. The default value is MASS FRACTION. The possible values are MASS
                FRACTION or MOLAR FRACTION.

            inflationTime=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidInflatorProperty.inflationTime "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the inflation time.

            fluidbehaviorName=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidInflatorProperty.fluidbehaviorName "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Strings specifying fluid behavior names.

            massFraction=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidInflatorProperty.massFraction "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the mass fraction or the molar fraction
                corresponding to entered fluid behavior.

        Returns:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidInflatorProperty-returns "Permalink to this headline")
        :   A FluidInflatorProperty object.

    :   This method creates an IncidentWaveProperty object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].IncidentWaveProperty
        ```

        Note

        Check [IncidentWaveProperty on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-incidentwavepropertypyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the interaction property repository key.

            definition=`abaqusConstants.PLANAR`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.definition "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of wave to be defined. Possible values are
                PLANAR, SPHERICAL, DIFFUSE, AIR\_BLAST, and SURFACE\_BLAST. The default value is PLANAR.

            propagationModel=`abaqusConstants.ACOUSTIC`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.propagationModel "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the spherical propagation model. Possible values are
                ACOUSTIC, UNDEX\_CHARGE, and GENERALIZED\_DECAY. The default value is ACOUSTIC.This
                argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL.

            soundSpeed=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.soundSpeed "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the speed of sound in the fluid.This argument is not valid when
                **definition** = AIR\_BLAST or when **definition** = SURFACE\_BLAST.

            fluidDensity=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.fluidDensity "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the fluid mass density.This argument is not valid when
                **definition** = AIR\_BLAST or when **definition** = SURFACE\_BLAST.

            specificHeatRatio=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.specificHeatRatio "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the ratio of specific heats for gas. The default value is
                None.This argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL and
                **propagationModel** = UNDEX\_CHARGE.

            gravity=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.gravity "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the acceleration due to gravity. The default value is
                None.This argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL and
                **propagationModel** = UNDEX\_CHARGE.

            atmosphericPressure=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.atmosphericPressure "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the atmospheric pressure. The default value is None.This
                argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL and **propagationModel** = UNDEX\_CHARGE.

            dragCoefficient=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.dragCoefficient "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the fluid drag coefficient. The default value is None.This
                argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL and **propagationModel** = UNDEX\_CHARGE.

            dragExponent=`2`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.dragExponent "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the fluid drag exponent. The default value is 2.0.This argument is
                valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL and **propagationModel** = UNDEX\_CHARGE.

            waveEffects=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.waveEffects "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether or not to include wave effects in the fluid and gas. The
                default value is ON.This argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL and
                **propagationModel** = UNDEX\_CHARGE.

            chargeDensity=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.chargeDensity "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the density of the charge material. The default value is
                None.This argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL and
                **propagationModel** = UNDEX\_CHARGE.

            chargeMass=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.chargeMass "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the mass of the charge material. The default value is
                None.This argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL and
                **propagationModel** = UNDEX\_CHARGE.

            constantK1=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.constantK1 "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the charge material constant K. The default value is
                None.This argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL and
                **propagationModel** = UNDEX\_CHARGE.

            constantK2=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.constantK2 "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the charge material constant k. The default value is
                None.This argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL and
                **propagationModel** = UNDEX\_CHARGE.

            constantA=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.constantA "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the charge material constant A. The default value is
                None.This argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL and
                **propagationModel** = UNDEX\_CHARGE.

            constantB=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.constantB "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the charge material constant B. The default value is
                None.This argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL and
                **propagationModel** = UNDEX\_CHARGE.

            constantKc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.constantKc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the charge material constant Kc. The default value is
                None.This argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL and
                **propagationModel** = UNDEX\_CHARGE.

            duration=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.duration "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the time duration for the bubble simulation. The default
                value is None.This argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL and
                **propagationModel** = UNDEX\_CHARGE.

            maximumSteps=`1500`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.maximumSteps "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the maximum number of time steps for the bubble simulation. The
                default value is 1500.This argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL and
                **propagationModel** = UNDEX\_CHARGE.

            relativeStepControl=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.relativeStepControl "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the relative step size control parameter. The default value is
                1x10⁻¹¹.This argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL and
                **propagationModel** = UNDEX\_CHARGE.

            absoluteStepControl=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.absoluteStepControl "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the absolute step size control parameter. The default value is
                1x10⁻¹¹.This argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL and
                **propagationModel** = UNDEX\_CHARGE.

            stepControlExponent=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.stepControlExponent "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the step size control exponent. The default value is 0.2.This
                argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL and **propagationModel** = UNDEX\_CHARGE.

            genDecayA=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.genDecayA "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the constant A associated with the generalized decay propagation
                model. The default value is 0.0.This argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL
                and **propagationModel** = GENERALIZED\_DECAY.

            genDecayB=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.genDecayB "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the constant B associated with the generalized decay propagation
                model. The default value is 0.0.This argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL
                and **propagationModel** = GENERALIZED\_DECAY.

            genDecayC=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.genDecayC "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the constant C associated with the generalized decay propagation
                model. The default value is 0.0.This argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL
                and **propagationModel** = GENERALIZED\_DECAY.

            seedNumber=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.seedNumber "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the seed number (N) for the diffuse source calculation. N2 sources
                will be used in the simulation.This argument is valid only when **definition** = DIFFUSE.

            massTNT=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.massTNT "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the equivalent mass of TNT, in any preferred mass unit.This argument
                is valid only when **definition** = AIR\_BLAST or **definition** = SURFACE\_BLAST.

            massFactor=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.massFactor "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the multiplication factor to convert from the preferred mass unit to
                kilograms. The default value is 1.0.This argument is valid only when
                **definition** = AIR\_BLAST or **definition** = SURFACE\_BLAST.

            lengthFactor=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.lengthFactor "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the multiplication factor to convert from the analysis length unit to
                meters. The default value is 1.0.This argument is valid only when **definition** = AIR\_BLAST
                or **definition** = SURFACE\_BLAST.

            timeFactor=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.timeFactor "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the multiplication factor to convert from the analysis time unit to
                seconds. The default value is 1.0.This argument is valid only when
                **definition** = AIR\_BLAST or **definition** = SURFACE\_BLAST.

            pressureFactor=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.pressureFactor "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the multiplication factor to convert from the analysis pressure unit
                to pascals. The default value is 1.0.This argument is valid only when
                **definition** = AIR\_BLAST or **definition** = SURFACE\_BLAST.

:   Bases: [`Interaction`](#abaqus.Interaction.XFEMCrackGrowth.Interaction "abaqus.Interaction.Interaction.Interaction (Python class)")

    The AcousticImpedance object defines surface impedance information or nonreflecting boundaries for
    acoustic and coupled acoustic-structural analyses. The AcousticImpedance object is derived from the
    Interaction object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactions[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * SIMPEDANCE

    Note

    Check [AcousticImpedance on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-acousticimpedancepyc.htm?contextscope=all).

*class* Interaction[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/XFEMCrackGrowth.py#L6-L85)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.XFEMCrackGrowth.Interaction "Permalink to this definition")
:   Bases: [`object`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#object "(in Python v3.13)")

    The Interaction object is the abstract base type for other Interaction objects. The Interaction object
    has no explicit constructor. Each of the Interaction objects has the.

    following methods:
    - deactivate
    - move
    - reset
    - resume
    - suppress
    - delete
    The methods are described below.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactions[name]
    ```

    Note

    Check [Interaction on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-interactionpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

:   Bases: [`ContactProperty`](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty "abaqus.Interaction.ContactProperty.ContactProperty (Python class)")

    The AcousticImpedanceProp object is an interaction property that defines the properties referred to by an
    AcousticImpedance object. The AcousticImpedanceProp object is derived from the InteractionProperty object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactionProperties[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * IMPEDANCE PROPERTY

    Note

    Check [AcousticImpedanceProp on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-acousticimpedanceproppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    :   A Boolean specifying whether the **table** data depend on frequency. The default value is

            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the values defining the damage initiation.

            criterion=`abaqusConstants.MAX_STRESS`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.Damage.criterion "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of data used to define the initiation of damage.
                Possible values are MAX\_STRESS, MAX\_SEPARATION, QUAD\_TRACTION, and QUAD\_SEPARATION. The
                default value is MAX\_STRESS.

            initTempDep=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.Damage.initTempDep "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the initiation data depend on temperature. The default
                value is OFF.

            initDependencies=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.Damage.initDependencies "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of initiation data field variables. The default value is 0.

            useEvolution=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.Damage.useEvolution "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether evolution data will be defined. The default value is OFF.

            evolutionType=`abaqusConstants.DISPLACEMENT`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.Damage.evolutionType "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of data used to define the evolution of damage.
                This argument is valid only when **useEvolution** = ON. Possible values are DISPLACEMENT and
                ENERGY. The default value is DISPLACEMENT.

            softening=`abaqusConstants.LINEAR`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.Damage.softening "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of data used to define the evolution softening
                response. This argument is valid only when **useEvolution** = ON. The TABULAR value can be
                used only when **evolutionType** = DISPLACEMENT. Possible values are LINEAR, EXPONENTIAL,
                and TABULAR. The default value is LINEAR.

            useMixedMode=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.Damage.useMixedMode "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether evolution data be defined using dependent behavior modes.
                This argument is valid only when **useEvolution** = ON. The default value is OFF.

            mixedModeType=`abaqusConstants.TABULAR`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.Damage.mixedModeType "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the mode mix fracture criterion. This argument is valid
                only when **useEvolution** = ON and when **useMixedMode** = ON. The POWER\_LAW and BK values can
                be used only when **evolutionType** = ENERGY. Possible values are TABULAR, POWER\_LAW, and
                BK. The default value is TABULAR.

            modeMixRatio=`abaqusConstants.ENERGY`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.Damage.modeMixRatio "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the mode mix ratio type. This argument is valid only when
                **useEvolution** = ON and when **useMixedMode** = ON. The TRACTION value can be used only when
                **mixedModeType** = TABULAR. Possible values are ENERGY and TRACTION. The default value is
                ENERGY.

            exponent=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.Damage.exponent "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the exponent in the power-law or BK criterion that defines
                the variation of fracture energy with mode mix. This argument is valid only when

            evolTempDep=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.Damage.evolTempDep "Permalink to this definition")

            evolDependencies=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.Damage.evolDependencies "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of evolution data field variables. This argument is valid

            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the values defining the damage evolution.

            useStabilization=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.Damage.useStabilization "Permalink to this definition")

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.GeometricProperties-parameters "Permalink to this headline")

            :   None or a Float specifying the thickness of an interfacial layer between the contacting

                None.

            trackingThickness=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.GeometricProperties.trackingThickness "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the thickness that determines the contacting surfaces to be
                tracked. The input value for this parameter cannot be negative. An internal default
                value is used if a zero value is input or if the parameter is omitted.

            dependentVariables=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.GeometricProperties.dependentVariables "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of state-dependent variables. The default value is 0. This
                argument is applicable only if **modelType** = MODELTYPE\_USER or
                **modelType** = MODELTYPE\_USER\_INTERACTION.

            numProperties=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.GeometricProperties.numProperties "Permalink to this definition")

                argument is applicable only if **modelType** = MODELTYPE\_USER or
                **modelType** = MODELTYPE\_USER\_INTERACTION.

            useUnsymmetricEqunProcedure=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.GeometricProperties.useUnsymmetricEqunProcedure "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to use unsymmetric equation solution procedures. This
                argument is applicable only if **modelType** = MODELTYPE\_USER or
                **modelType** = MODELTYPE\_USER\_INTERACTION.

            modelType=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.GeometricProperties.modelType "Permalink to this definition")

    :   This method creates a NormalBehavior object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].ContactProperty
        ```

        Note

        Check [NormalBehavior on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-normalbehaviorpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.NormalBehavior-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   contactStiffness=`abaqusConstants.DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.NormalBehavior.contactStiffness "Permalink to this definition")
            :   The SymbolicConstant DEFAULT or a Float specifying the contact stiffness. This argument
                is valid for **pressureOverclosure** = LINEAR. This argument is also valid for
                **pressureOverclosure** = HARD when **constraintEnforcementMethod** = AUGMENTED\_LAGRANGE or
                PENALTY. A value of DEFAULT is valid only when the later conditions are met. A value of
                zero is equivalent to specifying DEFAULT. The default value is DEFAULT.

            pressureOverclosure=`abaqusConstants.HARD`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.NormalBehavior.pressureOverclosure "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the pressure-overclosure relationship to be used. Possible
                values are HARD, EXPONENTIAL, LINEAR, TABULAR, and SCALE\_FACTOR. The default value is
                HARD.

            allowSeparation=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.NormalBehavior.allowSeparation "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to allow separation after contact. The default value is ON.

            maxStiffness=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.NormalBehavior.maxStiffness "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the maximum stiffness. If **maxStiffness** = None, there is no
                upper limit. The default value is None.

            table=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.NormalBehavior.table "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the normal behavior properties. This
                argument is valid only for **pressureOverclosure** = EXPONENTIAL or TABULAR. The items in
                the table data are described below.

            constraintEnforcementMethod=`abaqusConstants.DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.NormalBehavior.constraintEnforcementMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the method for enforcement of the contact constraint.
                Possible values are DEFAULT, AUGMENTED\_LAGRANGE, PENALTY, and DIRECT. The default value
                is DEFAULT.

            overclosureFactor=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.NormalBehavior.overclosureFactor "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the overclosure measure (used to delineate the segments of the
                pressure-overclosure curve) as a percentage of the minimum element size in the contact
                region. The default value is 0.0.

            overclosureMeasure=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.NormalBehavior.overclosureMeasure "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the overclosure measure (used to delineate the segments of the
                pressure-overclosure curve) directly. The default value is 0.0.

            contactStiffnessScaleFactor=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.NormalBehavior.contactStiffnessScaleFactor "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying scale factor for the penalty stiffness or the geometric scaling of
                the “base” stiffness. The default value is 1.0.

            initialStiffnessScaleFactor=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.NormalBehavior.initialStiffnessScaleFactor "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying an additional scale factor for the “base” default contact stiffness.
                The default value is 1.0.

            clearanceAtZeroContactPressure=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.NormalBehavior.clearanceAtZeroContactPressure "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the clearance at which the contact pressure is zero. The default
                value is 0.0.

            stiffnessBehavior=`abaqusConstants.LINEAR`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.NormalBehavior.stiffnessBehavior "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of penalty stiffness to be defined. This argument
                is valid only when **constraintEnforcementMethod** = PENALTY. Possible values are LINEAR and
                NONLINEAR. The default value is LINEAR.

            stiffnessRatio=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.NormalBehavior.stiffnessRatio "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the ratio of the initial stiffness divided by the final stiffness.
                This argument is valid only when **stiffnessBehavior** = NONLINEAR. Possible values are 0 ≤
                **stiffnessRatio** < 1. The default value is 0.01.

            upperQuadraticFactor=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.NormalBehavior.upperQuadraticFactor "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the ratio of the overclosure at the maximum stiffness divided by the
                characteristic facet length. This argument is valid only when
                **stiffnessBehavior** = NONLINEAR. The default value is 0.03.

            lowerQuadraticRatio=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.NormalBehavior.lowerQuadraticRatio "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the ratio of the overclosure at the initial stiffness divided by the
                overclosure at the maximum stiffness, both relative to the clearance at which the
                contact pressure is zero. This argument is valid only when
                **stiffnessBehavior** = NONLINEAR. Possible values are 0 ≤ **stiffnessRatio** < 1. The
                default value is 0.33333.

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.TangentialBehavior-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   formulation=`abaqusConstants.FRICTIONLESS`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.TangentialBehavior.formulation "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the friction formulation. Possible values are
                FRICTIONLESS, PENALTY, EXPONENTIAL\_DECAY, ROUGH, LAGRANGE, and USER\_DEFINED. The default
                value is FRICTIONLESS.

            directionality=`abaqusConstants.ISOTROPIC`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.TangentialBehavior.directionality "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the directionality of the friction. Possible values are
                ISOTROPIC and ANISOTROPIC. The default value is ISOTROPIC.

            slipRateDependency=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.TangentialBehavior.slipRateDependency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the data depend on slip rate. The default value is OFF.

            pressureDependency=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.TangentialBehavior.pressureDependency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the data depend on contact pressure. The default value is
                OFF.

            temperatureDependency=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.TangentialBehavior.temperatureDependency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the data depend on temperature. The default value is OFF.

            dependencies=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.TangentialBehavior.dependencies "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of field variables. The default value is 0.

            exponentialDecayDefinition=`abaqusConstants.COEFFICIENTS`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.TangentialBehavior.exponentialDecayDefinition "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the exponential decay definition. Possible values are
                COEFFICIENTS and TEST\_DATA. The default value is COEFFICIENTS.

            table=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.TangentialBehavior.table "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying tangential behavior. The items in the table
                data are described below.

            shearStressLimit=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.TangentialBehavior.shearStressLimit "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the shear stress limit. If **shearStressLimit** = None, there is
                no upper limit. The default value is None.

            maximumElasticSlip=`abaqusConstants.FRACTION`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.TangentialBehavior.maximumElasticSlip "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying what the maximum elastic slip will be. Possible values are
                FRACTION and ABSOLUTE\_DISTANCE. The default value is FRACTION.

            fraction=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.TangentialBehavior.fraction "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the fraction of a characteristic surface dimension. The default value
                is 0.0.

            absoluteDistance=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.TangentialBehavior.absoluteDistance "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the absolute distance. The default value is 0.0.

            elasticSlipStiffness=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.TangentialBehavior.elasticSlipStiffness "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the elastic slip stiffness. If **elasticSlipStiffness** = None,
                there is no upper limit. The default value is None.

            nStateDependentVars=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.TangentialBehavior.nStateDependentVars "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of state-dependent variables. The default value is 0.

            useProperties=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty.TangentialBehavior.useProperties "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether property values will be used. The default value is OFF.

*class* AcousticImpedanceState[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/AcousticImpedanceState.py#L9-L47)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.AcousticImpedanceState.AcousticImpedanceState "Permalink to this definition")
:   Bases: [`InteractionState`](#abaqus.Interaction.XFEMCrackGrowthState.InteractionState "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionState.InteractionState (Python class)")

    The AcousticImpedanceState object stores the propagating data of an AcousticImpedance object in a step.
    One instance of this object is created internally by the AcousticImpedance object for each step. The
    instance is also deleted internally by the AcousticImpedance object. The AcousticImpedanceState object has
    no constructor or methods. The AcousticImpedanceState object is derived from the InteractionState object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].steps[name].interactionStates[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * SIMPEDANCE

    Note

    Check [AcousticImpedanceState on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-acousticimpedancestatepyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    Member Details:

    interactionProperty : --is-rst--:py:class:`str` = `''`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/AcousticImpedanceState.py#L31-L33)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.AcousticImpedanceState.AcousticImpedanceState.interactionProperty "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A String specifying the name of the AcousticImpedanceProp object associated with this
        interaction.

    interactionPropertyState : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.SymbolicConstant.SymbolicConstant`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/AcousticImpedanceState.py)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.AcousticImpedanceState.AcousticImpedanceState.interactionPropertyState "Permalink to this definition")

    The ActuatorSensor object defines a single point actuator where the actuation is determined by a user
    subroutine (UEL). The subroutine senses the data at the same point as the actuator. The ActuatorSensor
    object is derived from the Interaction object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactions[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * ELEMENT
    * USER ELEMENT
    * INITIAL CONDITIONS

    Note

    Check [ActuatorSensor on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-actuatorsensorpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    The ActuatorSensorState object stores the propagating data of an actuator sensor in a step. One instance
    of this object is created internally by the ActuatorSensor object for each step. The instance is also
    deleted internally by the ActuatorSensor object. The ActuatorSensorState object has no constructor, methods,
    or members. The ActuatorSensorState object is derived from the InteractionState object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].steps[name].interactionStates[name]
    ```

    The CavityRadiation object defines cavities for thermal radiation heat transfer and controls the
    calculation of viewfactors. The CavityRadiation object is derived from the Interaction object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactions[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * CAVITY DEFINITION
    * CYCLIC
    * EMISSIVITY
    * PERIODIC
    * RADIATION SYMMETRY
    * RADIATION VIEWFACTOR
    * REFLECTION

    Note

    Check [CavityRadiation on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-cavityradiationpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    :   None or a Float specifying the reference ambient temperature value, θ0θ0. Specifying a
        value indicates an open cavity. The default value is None.

        as a result of this symmetry. This argument applies only when **cyclicSymmetry** = ON. The
        default value is 2.

    :   A ModelDot object specifying the rotation axis end point. This argument applies only for
        three-dimensional models, and only when **cyclicSymmetry** = ON.

    cyclicRotPt : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.BasicGeometry.ModelDot.ModelDot` = `<abaqus.BasicGeometry.ModelDot.ModelDot object>`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L122-L124)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.cyclicRotPt "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A ModelDot object specifying the rotation axis point. This argument applies only when
        **cyclicSymmetry** = ON.

    cyclicSymPt : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.BasicGeometry.ModelDot.ModelDot` = `<abaqus.BasicGeometry.ModelDot.ModelDot object>`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L130-L132)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.cyclicSymPt "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A ModelDot object specifying the symmetry axis end point. This argument applies only
        when **cyclicSymmetry** = ON.

    cyclicSymmetry : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Union`\[:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.AbaqusBoolean.AbaqusBoolean`, :py:class:`bool`] = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L56-L58)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.cyclicSymmetry "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Boolean specifying whether cyclic symmetry will be applied. This argument cannot be
        specified for axisymmetric models. The default value is OFF.

    minInfinitesimalRatio : --is-rst--:py:class:`float` = `64`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L43-L45)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.minInfinitesimalRatio "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Float specifying the facet area ratio above which the infinitesimal-to-finite area
        approximation is used for viewfactor calculations. The default value is 64.0.

    minLumpedAreaDS : --is-rst--:py:class:`float` = `5`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L52-L54)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.minLumpedAreaDS "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Float specifying the nondimensional distance-square value above which the lumped area
        approximation is used for viewfactor calculations. The default value is 5.0.

    name : --is-rst--:py:class:`str` = `''`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L36-L37)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.name "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A String specifying the repository key.

    numPointsPerEdge : --is-rst--:py:class:`int` = `3`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L47-L50)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.numPointsPerEdge "Permalink to this definition")
    :   An Int specifying the number of Gauss integration points to be used along each edge when
        the numerical integration of contour integrals is used for viewfactor calculations. One
        to five integration points are allowed. The default value is 3.

    periodicDistZ : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Optional`\[:py:class:`float`] = `None`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L95-L98)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.periodicDistZ "Permalink to this definition")
    :   None or a Float specifying the Z value indicating the periodic distance in axisymmetric

        **periodicSymmetries** = 1. The default value is None.

    periodicDistance\_1 : --is-rst--:py:class:`tuple`\[:py:class:`tuple`\[:py:class:`float`, :py:data:`...<Ellipsis>`], :py:data:`...<Ellipsis>`] = `()`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L134-L138)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.periodicDistance_1 "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A tuple of tuples of Floats specifying the two points of the vector that describes the
        periodic distance for the first periodic symmetry. Each point is defined by a tuple of
        three coordinates indicating its position. This argument applies only when
        **periodicSymmetries** is greater than zero. The default value is an empty sequence.

    periodicDistance\_2 : --is-rst--:py:class:`tuple`\[:py:class:`tuple`\[:py:class:`float`, :py:data:`...<Ellipsis>`], :py:data:`...<Ellipsis>`] = `()`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L134-L138)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.periodicDistance_2 "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A tuple of tuples of Floats specifying the two points of the vector that describes the

        three coordinates indicating its position. This argument applies only when
        **periodicSymmetries** is greater than one. The default value is an empty sequence.

    periodicDistance\_3 : --is-rst--:py:class:`tuple`\[:py:class:`tuple`\[:py:class:`float`, :py:data:`...<Ellipsis>`], :py:data:`...<Ellipsis>`] = `()`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L134-L138)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.periodicDistance_3 "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A tuple of tuples of Floats specifying the two points of the vector that describes the

        three coordinates indicating its position. This argument applies only when
        **periodicSymmetries** = 3. The default value is an empty sequence.

    periodicImages\_1 : --is-rst--:py:class:`int` = `2`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L69-L74)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.periodicImages_1 "Permalink to this definition")
    :   An Int specifying the number of repetitions used in the numerical calculation of the
        cavity viewfactors resulting from the first periodic symmetry. The result of this
        symmetry is a cavity composed of the cavity surface defined in the model plus twice the
        value of **periodicImages\_1**. This argument applies only when **periodicSymmetries** is
        greater than zero. The default value is 2.

    periodicImages\_2 : --is-rst--:py:class:`int` = `2`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L69-L74)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.periodicImages_2 "Permalink to this definition")
    :   An Int specifying the number of repetitions used in the numerical calculation of the
        cavity viewfactors resulting from the second periodic symmetry. The result of this
        symmetry is a cavity composed of the cavity surface defined in the model plus twice the
        value of **periodicImages\_2**. This argument applies only when **periodicSymmetries** is
        greater than one. The default value is 2.

    periodicImages\_3 : --is-rst--:py:class:`int` = `2`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L69-L74)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.periodicImages_3 "Permalink to this definition")
    :   An Int specifying the number of repetitions used in the numerical calculation of the

        value of **periodicImages\_3**. This argument applies only when **periodicSymmetries** = 3.
        The default value is 2.

    periodicSymZ : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Optional`\[:py:class:`float`] = `None`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L90-L93)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.periodicSymZ "Permalink to this definition")
    :   None or a Float specifying the Z value indicating the symmetry reference line in

    :   An Int specifying the number of periodic symmetries that will be applied. The default

"Permalink to this definition")
    :   This method modifies the data for an existing CavityRadiation object in the step where it is created.

        Note

        Check [CavityRadiation.setValues on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-cavityradiationpyc.htm?contextscope=all#simaker-cavityradiationsetvaluespyc).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValues-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   surfaceEmissivities=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValues.surfaceEmissivities "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of Strings specifying the names of the Cavity Radiation properties containing
                the surface emissivity data. One name per specified surface. The emissivity data is
                ignored when **surfaceReflection** = OFF.

            ambientTemp=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValues.ambientTemp "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the reference ambient temperature value, θ0θ0. Specifying a
                value indicates an open cavity. The default value is None.

            blocking=`abaqusConstants.BLOCKING_ALL`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValues.blocking "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the blocking checks to be performed in the viewfactor
                calculations. Possible values are BLOCKING\_ALL, NO\_BLOCKING, and PARTIAL\_BLOCKING. The
                default value is BLOCKING\_ALL.

            blockingSurfaces=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValues.blockingSurfaces "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A RegionArray object specifying the surfaces that provide blocking inside the cavity.
                This argument applies only when **blocking** = PARTIAL\_BLOCKING.

            rangeOfView=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValues.rangeOfView "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the maximum distance between surface facets at which
                viewfactors are calculated. More distant facets are deemed too far apart to exchange
                significant amounts of heat through radiation effects, and the viewfactors between these
                facets are assumed to be zero. If **rangeOfView** = None, there is no upper limit. The
                default value is None.

            surfaceReflection=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValues.surfaceReflection "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether heat reflections are to be included in the cavity radiation
                calculations. The default value is ON.

            viewfactorAccurTol=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValues.viewfactorAccurTol "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the acceptable tolerance for the viewfactor calculations. The default
                value is 0.05.

            minInfinitesimalRatio=`64`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValues.minInfinitesimalRatio "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the facet area ratio above which the infinitesimal-to-finite area
                approximation is used for viewfactor calculations. The default value is 64.0.

            numPointsPerEdge=`3`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValues.numPointsPerEdge "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of Gauss integration points to be used along each edge when
                the numerical integration of contour integrals is used for viewfactor calculations. One
                to five integration points are allowed. The default value is 3.

            minLumpedAreaDS=`5`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValues.minLumpedAreaDS "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the nondimensional distance-square value above which the lumped area
                approximation is used for viewfactor calculations. The default value is 5.0.

            cyclicSymmetry=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValues.cyclicSymmetry "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether cyclic symmetry will be applied. This argument cannot be
                specified for axisymmetric models. The default value is OFF.

            cyclicImages=`2`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValues.cyclicImages "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of cyclically similar images that compose the cavity formed
                as a result of this symmetry. This argument applies only when **cyclicSymmetry** = ON. The
                default value is 2.

            cyclicRotPt=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValues.cyclicRotPt "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A ModelDot object specifying the rotation axis point. This argument applies only when
                **cyclicSymmetry** = ON.

            cyclicRotEndPt=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValues.cyclicRotEndPt "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A ModelDot object specifying the rotation axis end point. This argument applies only for
                three-dimensional models, and only when **cyclicSymmetry** = ON.

            cyclicSymPt=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValues.cyclicSymPt "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A ModelDot object specifying the symmetry axis end point. This argument applies only
                when **cyclicSymmetry** = ON.

            periodicSymmetries=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValues.periodicSymmetries "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of periodic symmetries that will be applied. The default
                value is 0.

            periodicImages\_1=`2`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValues.periodicImages_1 "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of repetitions used in the numerical calculation of the
                cavity viewfactors resulting from the first periodic symmetry. The result of this
                symmetry is a cavity composed of the cavity surface defined in the model plus twice the
                value of **periodicImages\_1**. This argument applies only when **periodicSymmetries** is
                greater than zero. The default value is 2.

            periodicImages\_2=`2`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValues.periodicImages_2 "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of repetitions used in the numerical calculation of the
                cavity viewfactors resulting from the second periodic symmetry. The result of this
                symmetry is a cavity composed of the cavity surface defined in the model plus twice the
                value of **periodicImages\_2**. This argument applies only when **periodicSymmetries** is
                greater than one. The default value is 2.

            periodicImages\_3=`2`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValues.periodicImages_3 "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of repetitions used in the numerical calculation of the
                cavity viewfactors resulting from the third periodic symmetry. The result of this
                symmetry is a cavity composed of the cavity surface defined in the model plus twice the
                value of **periodicImages\_3**. This argument applies only when **periodicSymmetries** = 3.
                The default value is 2.

            periodicSymAxis\_1=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValues.periodicSymAxis_1 "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A straight Edge, a Datum object representing a datum axis, or an ElementEdge object
                indicating the first line of symmetry in two-dimensional models. This argument applies
                only for 2D models, and when **periodicSymmetries** is greater than zero.

            periodicSymAxis\_2=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValues.periodicSymAxis_2 "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A straight Edge, a Datum object representing a datum axis, or an ElementEdge object
                indicating the second line of symmetry in two-dimensional models. This argument applies
                only for two-dimensional models, and when **periodicSymmetries** = 2.

            periodicSymPlane\_1=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValues.periodicSymPlane_1 "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A planar Face, an ElementFace, or a Datum object representing a datum plane; indicating
                the first plane of symmetry in three-dimensional models. This argument applies only for

            periodicSymPlane\_2=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValues.periodicSymPlane_2 "Permalink to this definition")

            :   A planar Face, an ElementFace, or a Datum object representing a datum plane; indicating

This argument applies only when blocking = PARTIAL_BLOCKING.")=`None`*, *[rangeOfView](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValuesInStep.rangeOfView "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValuesInStep.rangeOfView (Python parameter) — None or a Float specifying the maximum distance between surface facets at which viewfactors are calculated.")=`None`*, *[surfaceReflection](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValuesInStep.surfaceReflection "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValuesInStep.surfaceReflection (Python parameter) — A Boolean specifying whether heat reflections are to be included in the cavity radiation calculations.")=`1`*, *[viewfactorAccurTol](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValuesInStep.viewfactorAccurTol "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValuesInStep.viewfactorAccurTol (Python parameter) — A Float specifying the acceptable tolerance for the viewfactor calculations.")=`0`*)[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L553-L590)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValuesInStep "Permalink to this definition")
    :   This method modifies the propagating data of an existing CavityRadiation object in the specified
        step.

        Note

        Check [CavityRadiation.setValuesInStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-cavityradiationpyc.htm?contextscope=all#simaker-cavityradiationsetvaluesinsteppyc).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValuesInStep-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   stepName[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValuesInStep.stepName "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the step in which the interaction is modified.

            blocking=`abaqusConstants.BLOCKING_ALL`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValuesInStep.blocking "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the blocking checks to be performed in the viewfactor
                calculations. Possible values are BLOCKING\_ALL, NO\_BLOCKING, and PARTIAL\_BLOCKING. The
                default value is BLOCKING\_ALL.

            blockingSurfaces=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValuesInStep.blockingSurfaces "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A RegionArray object specifying the surfaces that provide blocking inside the cavity.
                This argument applies only when **blocking** = PARTIAL\_BLOCKING.

            rangeOfView=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValuesInStep.rangeOfView "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the maximum distance between surface facets at which
                viewfactors are calculated. More distant facets are deemed too far apart to exchange
                significant amounts of heat through radiation effects, and the viewfactors between these
                facets are assumed to be zero. If **rangeOfView** = None, there is no upper limit. The
                default value is None.

            surfaceReflection=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValuesInStep.surfaceReflection "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether heat reflections are to be included in the cavity radiation
                calculations. The default value is ON.

            viewfactorAccurTol=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CavityRadiation.setValuesInStep.viewfactorAccurTol "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the acceptable tolerance for the viewfactor calculations. The default
                value is 0.05.

    The CavityRadiationProp object is an interaction property that defines emissivity as a function of
    temperature and field variables. The CavityRadiationProp object is derived from the InteractionProperty
    object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactionProperties[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * EMISSIVITY

    Note

    Check [CavityRadiationProp on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-cavityradiationproppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

*class* CavityRadiationState[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/CavityRadiationState.py#L9-L69)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.CavityRadiationState.CavityRadiationState "Permalink to this definition")
:   Bases: [`InteractionState`](#abaqus.Interaction.XFEMCrackGrowthState.InteractionState "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionState.InteractionState (Python class)")

    The CavityRadiationState object stores the propagating data for a CavityRadiation object. One instance of
    this object is created internally by the CavityRadiation object for each step. The instance is also deleted
    internally by the CavityRadiation object. The CavityRadiationState object has no constructor or methods. The
    CavityRadiationState object is derived from the InteractionState object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].steps[name].interactionStates[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * RADIATION VIEWFACTOR

    Note

    Check [CavityRadiationState on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-cavityradiationstatepyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    The CohesiveBehaviour.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactionProperties[name].cohesiveBehavior
    ```

    The table data for this object are:

    * If **coupling** = UNCOUPLED, the table data specify the following:

      > + Stiffness coefficient in the normal direction, Knn.
      > + Stiffness coefficient in the first shear direction, Kss.
      > + Stiffness coefficient in the second shear direction, Ktt.
      > + Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
      > + Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
      > + Value of the second field variable.
      > + Etc.
    * If **coupling** = COUPLED, the table data specify the following:

      > + Stiffness coefficient in the normal direction, Knn.
      > + Stiffness coefficient in the first shear direction, Kss.
      > + Stiffness coefficient in the second shear direction, Ktt.
      > + Coupled stiffness coefficient, Kns.
      > + Coupled stiffness coefficient, Knt.
      > + Coupled stiffness coefficient, Kst.
      > + Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
      > + Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
      > + Value of the second field variable.
      > + Etc.

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * COHESIVE BEHAVIOR

    Note

    Check [CohesiveBehavior on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-cohesivebehaviorpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

:   Bases: [`Interaction`](#abaqus.Interaction.XFEMCrackGrowth.Interaction "abaqus.Interaction.Interaction.Interaction (Python class)")

    The ConcentratedFilmCondition object defines concentrated film coefficients and associated sink
    temperatures. The ConcentratedFilmCondition object is derived from the Interaction object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactions[name]
    ```

    Note

    Check [ConcentratedFilmCondition on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-concentratedfilmconditionpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        interaction. The **field** argument applies only when **definition** = FIELD. The default

*class* ConcentratedFilmConditionState[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/ConcentratedFilmConditionState.py#L9-L85)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.ConcentratedFilmConditionState.ConcentratedFilmConditionState "Permalink to this definition")
:   Bases: [`InteractionState`](#abaqus.Interaction.XFEMCrackGrowthState.InteractionState "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionState.InteractionState (Python class)")

    The ConcentratedFilmConditionState object stores the propagating data for a ConcentratedFilmCondition
    object. One instance of this object is created internally by the ConcentratedFilmCondition object for each
    step. The instance is also deleted internally by the ConcentratedFilmCondition object. The
    ConcentratedFilmConditionState object has no constructor or methods. The ConcentratedFilmConditionState
    object is derived from the InteractionState object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].steps[name].interactionStates[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * CFILM

    Note

    Check [ConcentratedFilmConditionState on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-concentratedfilmconditionstatepyc.htm?contextscope=all).

:   Bases: [`Interaction`](#abaqus.Interaction.XFEMCrackGrowth.Interaction "abaqus.Interaction.Interaction.Interaction (Python class)")

    The ConcentratedRadiationToAmbient object defines radiant heat transfer between a point and its
    nonreflecting environment. The ConcentratedRadiationToAmbient object is derived from the Interaction object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactions[name]
    ```

    Note

    Check [ConcentratedRadiationToAmbient on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-concentratedradiationtoambientpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    ambientTemperature : --is-rst--:py:class:`float`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ConcentratedRadiationToAmbient.ambientTemperature "Permalink to this definition")

        the reference ambient temperature is applied throughout the step.

*class* ConcentratedRadiationToAmbientState[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/ConcentratedRadiationToAmbientState.py#L9-L70)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.ConcentratedRadiationToAmbientState.ConcentratedRadiationToAmbientState "Permalink to this definition")
:   Bases: [`InteractionState`](#abaqus.Interaction.XFEMCrackGrowthState.InteractionState "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionState.InteractionState (Python class)")

    The ConcentratedRadiationToAmbientState object stores the propagating data for a
    ConcentratedRadiationToAmbient object. One instance of this object is created internally by the
    ConcentratedRadiationToAmbient object for each step. The instance is also deleted internally by the
    ConcentratedRadiationToAmbient object. The ConcentratedRadiationToAmbientState object has no constructor or
    methods. The ConcentratedRadiationToAmbientState object is derived from the InteractionState object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].steps[name].interactionStates[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * CRADIATE

    Note

    Check [ConcentratedRadiationToAmbientState on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-concentratedradiationtoambientstatepyc.htm?contextscope=all).

definition")
:   Bases: [`object`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#object "(in Python v3.13)")

    The ContactDamage object specifies damage options for a contact interaction property.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactionProperties[name].damage
    ```

    The table data for this object are:

    Table data for **initTable**:

    If **criterion** = MAX\_STRESS or QUAD\_TRACTION, the table data specify the following:

    * Maximum nominal stress in the normal-only mode.
    * Maximum nominal stress in the first shear direction (for a mode that involves separation only in this direction).
    * Maximum nominal stress in the second shear direction (for a mode that involves separation only in this direction).
    * Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
    * Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
    * Value of the second field variable.
    * Etc.

    If **criterion** = MAX\_SEPARATION or QUAD\_SEPARATION, the table data specify the following:

    * Separation at damage initiation in a normal-only mode.
    * Separation at damage initiation in a shear-only mode that involves separation only along the first shear direction.
    * Separation at damage initiation in a shear-only mode that involves separation only along the second shear direction.
    * Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
    * Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
    * Value of the second field variable.
    * Etc.

    Table data for **evolTable**:

    If **evolutionType** = DISPLACEMENT, **softening** = LINEAR, and **useMixedMode** = OFF, the table data specify the following:

    * Effective total or Plastic displacement at failure, measured from the time of damage initiation.
    * Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
    * Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
    * Value of the second field variable.
    * Etc.

    If **evolutionType** = ENERGY, **softening** = LINEAR or EXPONENTIAL, and **useMixedMode** = OFF, the table data specify the following:

    * Fracture energy.
    * Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
    * Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
    * Value of the second field variable.
    * Etc.

    If **evolutionType** = DISPLACEMENT, **softening** = LINEAR, **useMixedMode** = ON, **mixedModeType** = TABULAR, and
    **modeMixRatio** = ENERGY or TRACTION, the table data specify the following:

    * Total displacement at failure, measured from the time of damage initiation.
    * Appropriate mode mix ratio.
    * Appropriate mode mix ratio (if relevant, for three dimensional problems with anisotropic shear behavior).
    * Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
    * Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
    * Value of the second field variable.
    * Etc.

    If **evolutionType** = ENERGY, **softening** = LINEAR or EXPONENTIAL, **useMixedMode** = ON, **mixedModeType** = TABULAR, and
    **modeMixRatio** = ENERGY or TRACTION, the table data specify the following:

    * Fracture energy.
    * Appropriate mode mix ratio.
    * Appropriate mode mix ratio (if relevant, for three dimensional problems with anisotropic shear behavior).
    * Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
    * Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
    * Value of the second field variable.
    * Etc.

    If **evolutionType** = DISPLACEMENT, **softening** = EXPONENTIAL, and **useMixedMode** = OFF, the table data specify the following:

    * Effective total or Plastic displacement at failure, measured from the time of damage initiation.
    * Exponential law parameter.
    * Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
    * Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
    * Value of the second field variable.
    * Etc.

    If **evolutionType** = DISPLACEMENT, **softening** = EXPONENTIAL, **useMixedMode** = ON, **mixedModeType** = TABULAR, and
    **modeMixRatio** = ENERGY or TRACTION, the table data specify the following:

    * Total displacement at failure, measured from the time of damage initiation.
    * Exponential law parameter.
    * Appropriate mode mix ratio.
    * Appropriate mode mix ratio (if relevant, for three dimensional problems with anisotropic shear behavior).
    * Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
    * Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
    * Value of the second field variable.
    * Etc.

    If **evolutionType** = DISPLACEMENT, **softening** = TABULAR, and **useMixedMode** = OFF, the table data specify the following:

    * Damage variable.
    * Effective total or Plastic displacement at failure, measured from the time of damage initiation.
    * Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
    * Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
    * Value of the second field variable.
    * Etc.

    If **evolutionType** = DISPLACEMENT, **softening** = TABULAR, **useMixedMode** = ON, **mixedModeType** = TABULAR, and
    **modeMixRatio** = ENERGY or TRACTION, the table data specify the following:

    * Damage variable.
    * Effective total displacement, measured from the time of damage initiation.
    * Appropriate mode mix ratio.
    * Appropriate mode mix ratio (if relevant, for three dimensional problems with anisotropic shear behavior).
    * Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
    * Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
    * Value of the second field variable.
    * Etc.

    If **evolutionType** = ENERGY, **softening** = LINEAR or EXPONENTIAL, **useMixedMode** = ON, **mixedModeType** = POWER\_LAW or
    BK, and **modeMixRatio** = ENERGY, the table data specify the following:

    * Normal mode fracture energy.
    * Shear mode fracture energy for failure in the first shear direction.
    * Shear mode fracture energy for failure in the second shear direction.
    * Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
    * Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
    * Value of the second field variable.
    * Etc.

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * DAMAGE INITIATION
    * DAMAGE EVOLUTION
    * DAMAGE STABILIZATION

    Note

    Check [ContactDamage on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-contactdamagepyc.htm?contextscope=all).
