:   Bases: [`object`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#object "(in Python v3.13)")

    The ContactDamping object specifies damping for a contact interaction property.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactionProperties[name].damping
    ```

    The table data for this object are:

    * If **definition** = DAMPING\_COEFFICIENT and **clearanceDependence** = STEP, the table data specify the following:

      > + Damping coefficient.
    * If **definition** = DAMPING\_COEFFICIENT and **clearanceDependence** = LINEAR or BILINEAR, the table data specify the following:

      > + Damping coefficient.
      > + Clearance.
      >
      > Two pairs must be given for **clearanceDependence** = LINEAR and three pairs for **clearanceDependence** = BILINEAR. The first pair must have **clearance** = 0.0, and the last pair must have **coefficient** = 0.0.
    * If **definition** = CRITICAL\_DAMPING\_FRACTION, the table data specify the following:

      > + Critical damping fraction.

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * CONTACT DAMPING

    Note

    Check [ContactDamping on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-contactdampingpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the variation of the damping coefficient or fraction with
        respect to clearance. Possible values are STEP, LINEAR, and BILINEAR. The default value
        is STEP.If **definition** = CRITICAL\_DAMPING\_FRACTION, the only possible value is STEP.

    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the method used to define the damping. Possible values are
        DAMPING\_COEFFICIENT and CRITICAL\_DAMPING\_FRACTION. The default value is

:   Bases: [`Interaction`](#abaqus.Interaction.XFEMCrackGrowth.Interaction "abaqus.Interaction.Interaction.Interaction (Python class)")

    The ContactExp object defines the contact domain and associated properties during contact in an
    Abaqus/Explicit analysis. The ContactExp object is derived from the Interaction object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactions[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * CONTACT

    Note

    Check [ContactExp on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-contactexppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    Member Details:

    contactPropertyAssignments : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.Interaction.ContactPropertyAssignment.ContactPropertyAssignment` = `<abaqus.Interaction.ContactPropertyAssignment.ContactPropertyAssignment object>`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L58-L60)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactExp.contactPropertyAssignments "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A ContactPropertyAssignment object specifying the contact property assignments in the
        contact domain.

    excludedPairs : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.Interaction.RegionPairs.RegionPairs` = `<abaqus.Interaction.RegionPairs.RegionPairs object>`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L55-L56)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactExp.excludedPairs "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A RegionPairs object specifying the domain pairs excluded from contact.

    globalSmoothing : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Union`\[:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.AbaqusBoolean.AbaqusBoolean`, :py:class:`bool`] = `1`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L48-L50)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactExp.globalSmoothing "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Boolean specifying whether surface smoothing (geometric correction) is automatically
        applied to all eligible surfaces. The default value is ON.

    includedPairs : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.Interaction.RegionPairs.RegionPairs` = `<abaqus.Interaction.RegionPairs.RegionPairs object>`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L52-L53)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactExp.includedPairs "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A RegionPairs object specifying the domain pairs included in contact.

    mainSecondaryAssignments : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.Interaction.MainSecondaryAssignment.MainSecondaryAssignment` = `<abaqus.Interaction.MainSecondaryAssignment.MainSecondaryAssignment object>`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L81-L83)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactExp.mainSecondaryAssignments "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A MainSecondaryAssignment object specifying the main-secondary assignments in the
        contact domain.

        Changed in version 2022: The attribute `masterSlaveAssignments` was renamed to `mainSecondaryAssignments`.

    name : --is-rst--:py:class:`str` = `''`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L45-L46)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactExp.name "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A String specifying the repository key.

    polarityAssignments : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.Interaction.PolarityAssignments.PolarityAssignments` = `<abaqus.Interaction.PolarityAssignments.PolarityAssignments object>`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L87-L89)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactExp.polarityAssignments "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A PolarityAssignments object specifying the polarity assignments in the contact domain.

        New in version 2020: The `polarityAssignments` attribute was added.

    smoothingAssignments : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.Interaction.SmoothingAssignment.SmoothingAssignment` = `<abaqus.Interaction.SmoothingAssignment.SmoothingAssignment object>`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L74-L76)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactExp.smoothingAssignments "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SmoothingAssignment object specifying the surface smoothing assignments in the contact
        domain.

    surfaceFeatureAssignments : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.SurfaceFeatureAssignment` = `<abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.SurfaceFeatureAssignment object>`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L70-L72)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactExp.surfaceFeatureAssignments "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SurfaceFeatureAssignment object specifying the surface feature angle assignments in
        the contact domain.

    surfaceOffsetAssignments : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceOffsetAssignment.SurfaceOffsetAssignment` = `<abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceOffsetAssignment.SurfaceOffsetAssignment object>`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L66-L68)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactExp.surfaceOffsetAssignments "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SurfaceOffsetAssignment object specifying the surface offset fraction assignments in
        the contact domain.

    :   A SurfaceThicknessAssignment object specifying the surface thickness assignments in the
        contact domain.

*class* ContactPropertyAssignment[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L12-L99)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactPropertyAssignment "Permalink to this definition")
:   Bases: [`object`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#object "(in Python v3.13)")

    The ContactPropertyAssignment object stores the contact property assignment definition for domain pairs
    in ContactExp and ContactStd objects. The ContactPropertyAssignment object has no constructor or members.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactions[name].contactPropertyAssignments
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * CONTACT PROPERTY ASSIGNMENT

    Note

    Check [ContactPropertyAssignment on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-contactpropertyassignmentpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    Member Details:

    appendInStep(*[stepName](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactPropertyAssignment.appendInStep.stepName "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactPropertyAssignment.appendInStep.stepName (Python parameter) — A String specifying the name of the step in which new contact property assignments are to be defined.")*, *[assignments](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactPropertyAssignment.appendInStep.assignments "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactPropertyAssignment.appendInStep.assignments (Python parameter) — A sequence of tuples specifying the properties assigned to each surface pair.")*)[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L47-L74)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactPropertyAssignment.appendInStep "Permalink to this definition")
    :   This method allows addition of contact property assignments to new domain pairs in a given step.

        Note

        Check [ContactPropertyAssignment.appendInStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-contactpropertyassignmentpyc.htm?contextscope=all#simaker-contactpropertyassignmentappendinsteppyc).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactPropertyAssignment.appendInStep-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   stepName[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactPropertyAssignment.appendInStep.stepName "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the step in which new contact property assignments are
                to be defined.

            assignments[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactPropertyAssignment.appendInStep.assignments "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of tuples specifying the properties assigned to each surface pair. Each tuple
                contains three entries:

                * A region or a material object or the SymbolicConstant GLOBAL.
                * A region or a material object or the SymbolicConstant SELF. When used with a ContactExp
                  object, this parameter can also be a string that references an Eulerian material
                  surface.
                * A String specifying a ContactProperty object associated with this pair of
                  regions.

                Changed in version 2021: Update descriptions of the three entries in the tuple.

    changeValuesInStep(*[stepName](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactPropertyAssignment.changeValuesInStep.stepName "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactPropertyAssignment.changeValuesInStep.stepName (Python parameter) — A String specifying the name of the step in which the contact property assignments are to be modified.")*, *[index](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactPropertyAssignment.changeValuesInStep.index "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactPropertyAssignment.changeValuesInStep.index (Python parameter) — An Int specifying the position of the contact property assignment whose value is to be modified.")*, *[value](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactPropertyAssignment.changeValuesInStep.value "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactPropertyAssignment.changeValuesInStep.value (Python parameter) — A String specifying the value of the contact property to be assigned to the domain pair whose index is referenced.")*)[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L28-L45)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactPropertyAssignment.changeValuesInStep "Permalink to this definition")
    :   This method allows modification of contact property assignments to domain pairs already defined in a
        given step.

        Note

        Check [ContactPropertyAssignment.changeValuesInStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-contactpropertyassignmentpyc.htm?contextscope=all#simaker-contactpropertyassignmentchangevaluesinsteppyc).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactPropertyAssignment.changeValuesInStep-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   stepName[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactPropertyAssignment.changeValuesInStep.stepName "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the step in which the contact property assignments are
                to be modified.

            index[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactPropertyAssignment.changeValuesInStep.index "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the position of the contact property assignment whose value is to be
                modified.

            value[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactPropertyAssignment.changeValuesInStep.value "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the value of the contact property to be assigned to the domain pair
                whose index is referenced.

    delete(*[indices](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactPropertyAssignment.delete.indices "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactPropertyAssignment.delete.indices (Python parameter) — A sequence of Ints specifying the index of each contact property assignment to delete. The indices and surfPair arguments are mutually exclusive.")*, *[surfPair](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactPropertyAssignment.delete.surfPair "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactPropertyAssignment.delete.surfPair (Python parameter) — A sequence of tuples specifying the surface pair of each contact property assignment to delete.")*)[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L76-L99)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactPropertyAssignment.delete "Permalink to this definition")
    :   The delete method allows you to delete existing contact property assignments.

        Note

        Check [ContactPropertyAssignment.delete on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-contactpropertyassignmentpyc.htm?contextscope=all#simaker-contactpropertyassignmentdeletepyc).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactPropertyAssignment.delete-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   indices[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactPropertyAssignment.delete.indices "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of Ints specifying the index of each contact property assignment to delete.
                The **indices** and **surfPair** arguments are mutually exclusive.

            surfPair[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.ContactPropertyAssignment.delete.surfPair "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of tuples specifying the surface pair of each contact property assignment to
                delete. Each tuple contains two entries:

                * A region or a material object or the SymbolicConstant GLOBAL.
                * A region or a material object or the SymbolicConstant SELF. When
                  used with a ContactExp object, this parameter can also be a string that references an
                  Eulerian material surface.

                **surfPair** and **indices** arguments are mutually exclusive.

                Changed in version 2021: Update descriptions of the two entries in the tuple.

*class* MainSecondaryAssignment[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/MainSecondaryAssignment.py#L11-L85)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.MainSecondaryAssignment.MainSecondaryAssignment "Permalink to this definition")
:   Bases: [`object`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#object "(in Python v3.13)")

    The MainSecondaryAssignment object stores the main-secondary assignment definition for surfaces in
    ContactExp and ContactStd objects. The MainSecondaryAssignment object has no constructor or members.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactions[name].mainSecondaryAssignments
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * CONTACT FORMULATION

    Changed in version 2022: The MasterSlaveAssignment class was renamed to MainSecondaryAssignment.

    Note

    Check [MainSecondaryAssignment on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-mainsecondaryassignmentpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    appendInStep(*[stepName](#abaqus.Interaction.MainSecondaryAssignment.MainSecondaryAssignment.appendInStep.stepName "abaqus.Interaction.MainSecondaryAssignment.MainSecondaryAssignment.appendInStep.stepName (Python parameter) — A String specifying the name of the step in which the main-secondary assignments are to be defined.")*, *[assignments](#abaqus.Interaction.MainSecondaryAssignment.MainSecondaryAssignment.appendInStep.assignments "abaqus.Interaction.MainSecondaryAssignment.MainSecondaryAssignment.appendInStep.assignments (Python parameter) — A sequence of tuples specifying the main-secondary assignments.")*)[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/MainSecondaryAssignment.py#L50-L74)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.MainSecondaryAssignment.MainSecondaryAssignment.appendInStep "Permalink to this definition")
    :   This method allows addition of main-secondary assignments to new surface pairs in a given step.

        Note

        Check [MainSecondaryAssignment.appendInStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-mainsecondaryassignmentpyc.htm?contextscope=all#simaker-mainsecondaryassignmentappendinsteppyc).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.MainSecondaryAssignment.MainSecondaryAssignment.appendInStep-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   stepName[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.MainSecondaryAssignment.MainSecondaryAssignment.appendInStep.stepName "Permalink to this definition")

                * A Float specifying the crush initiation angle value to be used for the surface.
                * A Float specifying the crush continuation angle value to be used for the surface.

                - A Float specifying the crush continuation angle value to be used for the surface.

*class* SurfaceFeatureAssignment[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceFeatureAssignment.py#L15-L134)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.SurfaceFeatureAssignment "Permalink to this definition")
:   Bases: [`object`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#object "(in Python v3.13)")

    The SurfaceFeatureAssignment object stores the surface feature angle assignment definition for surfaces
    in ContactExp or ContactStd objects. The SurfaceFeatureAssignment object has no constructor or members.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactions[name].surfaceFeatureAssignments
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * SURFACE PROPERTY ASSIGNMENT

    Note

    Check [SurfaceFeatureAssignment on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-surfacefeatureassignmentpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    Member Details:

    appendInStep(*[stepName](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.appendInStep.stepName "abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.appendInStep.stepName (Python parameter) — A String specifying the name of the step in which new surface feature angle assignments are to be defined.")*, *[assignments](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.appendInStep.assignments "abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.appendInStep.assignments (Python parameter) — A sequence of tuples specifying the surface feature angle assignments.")*, *[useDynFeatEdge](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.appendInStep.useDynFeatEdge "abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.appendInStep.useDynFeatEdge (Python parameter) — A Boolean specifying whether the dynamic feature edge criterion should be activated for the contact surface in an Abaqus/Explicit analysis.")=`1`*)[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceFeatureAssignment.py#L75-L121)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.appendInStep "Permalink to this definition")
    :   This method allows addition of surface feature angle assignments to new surfaces in a given step.

        Note

        Check [SurfaceFeatureAssignment.appendInStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-surfacefeatureassignmentpyc.htm?contextscope=all#simaker-surfacefeatureassignmentappendinsteppyc).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.appendInStep-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   stepName[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.appendInStep.stepName "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the step in which new surface feature angle assignments
                are to be defined.

            assignments[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.appendInStep.assignments "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of tuples specifying the surface feature angle assignments. Each tuple
                contains three entries for Abaqus/Standard and four entries for Abaqus/Explicit:

                * A region or a material object or the SymbolicConstant GLOBAL specifying the surface to
                  which the feature angle is assigned.
                * A Float or a SymbolicConstant specifying the overriding surface primary feature angle
                  value to be used for the surface. Possible values of the SymbolicConstant are PERIMETER,
                  ALL, PICKED, or NONE. The ALL and PICKED values cannot be specified with the GLOBAL
                  region constant and can be used only in the Abaqus/Explicit version of general contact.
                * A Float or a SymbolicConstant specifying the overriding surface slave feature
                  angle value to be used for the surface. Possible values of the SymbolicConstant are
                  PERIMETER, ALL, PICKED, or NONE. The ALL and PICKED values cannot be specified with the
                  GLOBAL region constant and can be used only in the Abaqus/Explicit version of general
                  contact.
                * A SymbolicConstant ORIGINAL or CURRENT specifying the configuration.

            useDynFeatEdge=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.appendInStep.useDynFeatEdge "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the dynamic feature edge criterion should be activated for the contact surface
                in an Abaqus/Explicit analysis. This argument can be set to ON (default) or OFF.

                New in version 2023: The `useDynFeatEdge` argument was added.

    changeValuesInStep(*[stepName](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.changeValuesInStep.stepName "abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.changeValuesInStep.stepName (Python parameter) — A String specifying the name of the step in which the surface feature assignments are to be modified.")*, *[index](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.changeValuesInStep.index "abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.changeValuesInStep.index (Python parameter) — An Int specifying the position of the surface feature angle assignment whose value is to be modified.")*, *[value](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.changeValuesInStep.value "abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.changeValuesInStep.value (Python parameter) — A tuple specifying the value of the surface feature assignments for the surface whose index is referenced.")*, *[useDynFeatEdge](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.changeValuesInStep.useDynFeatEdge "abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.changeValuesInStep.useDynFeatEdge (Python parameter) — A Boolean specifying whether the dynamic feature edge criterion should be activated for the contact surface in an Abaqus/Explicit analysis.")=`1`*)[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceFeatureAssignment.py#L31-L73)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.changeValuesInStep "Permalink to this definition")
    :   This method allows modification of surface feature angle assignments already defined on surfaces in a
        given step.

        Note

        Check [SurfaceFeatureAssignment.changeValuesInStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-surfacefeatureassignmentpyc.htm?contextscope=all#simaker-surfacefeatureassignmentchangevaluesinsteppyc).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.changeValuesInStep-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   stepName[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.changeValuesInStep.stepName "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the step in which the surface feature assignments are to
                be modified.

            index[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.changeValuesInStep.index "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the position of the surface feature angle assignment whose value is to
                be modified.

            value[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.changeValuesInStep.value "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A tuple specifying the value of the surface feature assignments for the surface whose
                index is referenced. Each tuple contains two entries for Abaqus/Standard and three
                entries for Abaqus/Explicit:

                * A Float or a SymbolicConstant specifying the overriding surface primary feature angle
                  value to be used for the surface. Possible values of the SymbolicConstant are PERIMETER,
                  ALL, PICKED, or NONE. The ALL and PICKED values cannot be specified with the GLOBAL
                  region constant and can be used only in the Abaqus/Explicit version of general contact.
                * A Float or a SymbolicConstant specifying the overriding surface secondary feature
                  angle value to be used for the surface. Possible values of the SymbolicConstant are
                  PERIMETER, ALL, PICKED, or NONE. The ALL and PICKED values cannot be specified with the
                  GLOBAL region constant and can be used only in the Abaqus/Explicit version of general
                  contact.
                * A SymbolicConstant ORIGINAL or CURRENT specifying the configuration.

            useDynFeatEdge=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.SurfaceFeatureAssignment.changeValuesInStep.useDynFeatEdge "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the dynamic feature edge criterion should be activated for the contact surface
                in an Abaqus/Explicit analysis. This argument can be set to ON (default) or OFF.

                New in version 2023: The `useDynFeatEdge` argument was added.

        :   stepName[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceThicknessAssignment.SurfaceThicknessAssignment.appendInStep.stepName "Permalink to this definition")

                to be defined.

            assignments[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceThicknessAssignment.SurfaceThicknessAssignment.appendInStep.assignments "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of tuples specifying the surface thickness assignments. Each tuple contains
                three entries:

                * A region or a material object or the SymbolicConstant GLOBAL specifying the surface to
                  which the thickness is assigned.
                * A Float or a SymbolicConstant specifying the overriding thickness value to be used in
                  the contact definition. Possible values of the SymbolicConstant are ORIGINAL and
                  THINNING. The SymbolicConstant THINNING can be specified only in an Abaqus/Explicit
                  analysis.
                * A Float specifying a scale factor that multiplies the thickness value specified in the
                  second entry.

                Changed in version 2021: The first entry in the tuple can be a material object now.

"Permalink to this definition")
:   Bases: [`object`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#object "(in Python v3.13)")

    The ContactTangentialBehavior object specifies tangential behavior for a contact interaction property.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactionProperties[name].tangentialBehavior
    ```

    The table data for this object are:

    * If **formulation** = PENALTY or LAGRANGE, the table data specify the following:

      > + Friction coefficient in the first slip direction, μ1μ1.
      > + Friction coefficient in the second slip direction, μ2μ2 (if **directionality** = ANISOTROPIC).
      > + Slip rate, if the data depend on slip rate.
      > + Contact pressure, if the data depend on contact pressure.
      > + Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
      > + Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
      > + Value of the second field variable.
      > + Etc.
    * If **formulation** = EXPONENTIAL\_DECAY and **exponentialDecayDefinition** = COEFFICIENTS, the table data specify the following:

      > + Static friction coefficient.
      > + Kinetic friction coefficient.
      > + Decay coefficient.
    * If **formulation** = EXPONENTIAL\_DECAY and **exponentialDecayDefinition** = TEST\_DATA, the table data specify the following:

      > + Friction coefficient.
      > + Slip rate.
    * If **formulation** = USER\_DEFINED, the table data specify the following:

      > + Friction property.

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * FRICTION
    * CHANGE FRICTION

    Note

    Check [ContactTangentialBehavior on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-contacttangentialbehaviorpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

:   Bases: [`object`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#object "(in Python v3.13)")

    The FractureCriterion object specifies fractureCriterion options for a contact interaction property.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactionProperties[name].fractureCriterion
    ```

    The table data for this object are:

    Table data for **initTable**:

    If **type** = VCCT for **mixedModeBehavior** = BK or REEDER, the table data specify the following:

    * Mode I critical energy release rate, \(G\_{I C}\).
    * Mode II critical energy release rate, \(G\_{I I C}\).
    * Mode III critical energy release rate, \(G\_{I I I C}\).
    * Exponent, \(\eta\).
    * Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
    * Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
    * Value of the second field variable.
    * Etc.

    If **type** = VCCT for **mixedModeBehavior** = POWER, the table data specify the following:

    * Mode I critical energy release rate, \(G\_{I C}\).
    * Mode II critical energy release rate, \(G\_{I I C}\).
    * Mode III critical energy release rate, \(G\_{I I I C}\).
    * Exponent, \(am\).
    * Exponent, \(an\).
    * Exponent, \(ao\).
    * Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
    * Value of the second field variable.
    * Etc.

    If **type** = ENHANCED VCCT for **mixedModeBehavior** = BK or REEDER, the table data specify the following:

    * Mode I critical energy release rate for onset crack, \(G\_{I C}\).
    * Mode II critical energy release rate for onset crack, \(G\_{I I C}\).
    * Mode III critical energy release rate for onset crack, \(G\_{I I I C}\).
    * Mode I critical energy release rate for crack propagation, \(G\_{I C}\).
    * Mode II critical energy release rate for crack propagation, \(G\_{I I C}\).
    * Mode III critical energy release rate for crack propagation, \(G\_{I I I C}\).
    * Exponent, \(\eta\)
    * Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
    * Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
    * Value of the second field variable.
    * Etc.

    If **type** = ENHANCED VCCT for **mixedModeBehavior** = POWER, the table data specify the following:

    * Mode I critical energy release rate for onset crack, \(G\_{I C}\).
    * Mode II critical energy release rate for onset crack, \(G\_{I I C}\).
    * Mode III critical energy release rate for onset crack, \(G\_{I I I C}\).
    * Mode I critical energy release rate for crack propagation, \(G\_{I C}\).
    * Mode II critical energy release rate for crack propagation, \(G\_{I I C}\).
    * Mode III critical energy release rate for crack propagation, \(G\_{I I I C}\).
    * Exponent, \(am\).
    * Exponent, \(an\).
    * Exponent, \(ao\).
    * Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
    * Value of the second field variable.
    * Etc.

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * FRACTURE CRITERION

    Note

    Check [FractureCriterion on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-fracturecriterionpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    The GapElectricalConductance object specifies electrical conductance for a contact interaction property.

    Note

    ```python
    import interaction
    ```

    The table data for this object are:

    The **clearanceDepTable** data specify the following:

    * Conductivity.

    * Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
    * Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
    * Value of the second field variable.
    * Etc.

    The **pressureDepTable** data specify the following:

    * Conductivity.
    * Pressure.
    * Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
    * Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
    * Value of the second field variable.
    * Etc.

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * GAP ELECTRICAL CONDUCTANCE

    numProperties : --is-rst--:py:class:`int` = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/GeometricProperties.py#L43-L46)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.GeometricProperties.GeometricProperties.numProperties "Permalink to this definition")
    :   An Int specifying the number of property values required. The default value is 0. This
        argument is applicable only if **modelType** = MODELTYPE\_USER or
        **modelType** = MODELTYPE\_USER\_INTERACTION.

    padThickness : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Optional`\[:py:class:`float`] = `None`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/GeometricProperties.py#L28-L31)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.GeometricProperties.GeometricProperties.padThickness "Permalink to this definition")
    :   None or a Float specifying the thickness of an interfacial layer between the contacting
        surfaces. If **padThickness** = None, there is no interfacial layer. The default value is
        None.

    setValues(*\*[args](#abaqus.Interaction.GeometricProperties.GeometricProperties.setValues "abaqus.Interaction.GeometricProperties.GeometricProperties.setValues.args (Python parameter)")*, *\*\*[kwargs](#abaqus.Interaction.GeometricProperties.GeometricProperties.setValues "abaqus.Interaction.GeometricProperties.GeometricProperties.setValues.kwargs (Python parameter)")*)[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/GeometricProperties.py#L110-L113)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.GeometricProperties.GeometricProperties.setValues "Permalink to this definition")

    :   None or a Float specifying the thickness that determines the contacting surfaces to be

    useUnsymmetricEqunProcedure : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Union`\[:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.AbaqusBoolean.AbaqusBoolean`, :py:class:`bool`] = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/GeometricProperties.py#L48-L51)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.GeometricProperties.GeometricProperties.useUnsymmetricEqunProcedure "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Boolean specifying whether to use unsymmetric equation solution procedures. This
        argument is applicable only if **modelType** = MODELTYPE\_USER or
        **modelType** = MODELTYPE\_USER\_INTERACTION.

definition")
:   Bases: [`object`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#object "(in Python v3.13)")

    The NormalBehavior object specifies normal behavior for a contact interaction property.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactionProperties[name].normalBehavior
    ```

    The table data for this object are:

    * If **pressureOverclosure** = EXPONENTIAL, the table data specify the following:

      > + Pressure at zero clearance, p0p0.
      > + Clearance at which the contact pressure is zero, c0c0.
    * If **pressureOverclosure** = TABULAR, the table data specify the following:

      > + Pressure.
      > + Overclosure.

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * SURFACE BEHAVIOR

    Note

    Check [NormalBehavior on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-normalbehaviorpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    Member Details:

    allowSeparation : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Union`\[:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.AbaqusBoolean.AbaqusBoolean`, :py:class:`bool`] = `1`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/NormalBehavior.py#L58-L59)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.NormalBehavior.NormalBehavior.allowSeparation "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Boolean specifying whether to allow separation after contact. The default value is ON.

    clearanceAtZeroContactPressure : --is-rst--:py:class:`float` = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/NormalBehavior.py#L92-L94)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.NormalBehavior.NormalBehavior.clearanceAtZeroContactPressure "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Float specifying the clearance at which the contact pressure is zero. The default
        value is 0.0.

    constraintEnforcementMethod : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.SymbolicConstant.SymbolicConstant` = `'DEFAULT'`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/NormalBehavior.py#L70-L73)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.NormalBehavior.NormalBehavior.constraintEnforcementMethod "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the method for enforcement of the contact constraint.
        Possible values are DEFAULT, AUGMENTED\_LAGRANGE, PENALTY, and DIRECT. The default value
        is DEFAULT.

    contactStiffness : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Union`\[:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.SymbolicConstant.SymbolicConstant`, :py:class:`float`] = `'DEFAULT'`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/NormalBehavior.py#L46-L51)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.NormalBehavior.NormalBehavior.contactStiffness "Permalink to this definition")
    :   The SymbolicConstant DEFAULT or a Float specifying the contact stiffness. This argument
        is valid for **pressureOverclosure** = LINEAR. This argument is also valid for
        **pressureOverclosure** = HARD when **constraintEnforcementMethod** = AUGMENTED\_LAGRANGE or
        PENALTY. A value of DEFAULT is valid only when the later conditions are met. A value of
        zero is equivalent to specifying DEFAULT. The default value is DEFAULT.

    contactStiffnessScaleFactor : --is-rst--:py:class:`float` = `1`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/NormalBehavior.py#L84-L86)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.NormalBehavior.NormalBehavior.contactStiffnessScaleFactor "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Float specifying scale factor for the penalty stiffness or the geometric scaling of
        the “base” stiffness. The default value is 1.0.

    initialStiffnessScaleFactor : --is-rst--:py:class:`float` = `1`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/NormalBehavior.py#L88-L90)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.NormalBehavior.NormalBehavior.initialStiffnessScaleFactor "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Float specifying an additional scale factor for the “base” default contact stiffness.
        The default value is 1.0.

    lowerQuadraticRatio : --is-rst--:py:class:`float` = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/NormalBehavior.py#L111-L116)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.NormalBehavior.NormalBehavior.lowerQuadraticRatio "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Float specifying the ratio of the overclosure at the initial stiffness divided by the
        overclosure at the maximum stiffness, both relative to the clearance at which the
        contact pressure is zero. This argument is valid only when
        **stiffnessBehavior** = NONLINEAR. Possible values are 0 ≤ **stiffnessRatio** < 1. The
        default value is 0.33333.

    maxStiffness : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Optional`\[:py:class:`float`] = `None`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/NormalBehavior.py#L61-L63)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.NormalBehavior.NormalBehavior.maxStiffness "Permalink to this definition")
    :   None or a Float specifying the maximum stiffness. If **maxStiffness** = None, there is no
        upper limit. The default value is None.

    overclosureFactor : --is-rst--:py:class:`float` = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/NormalBehavior.py#L75-L78)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.NormalBehavior.NormalBehavior.overclosureFactor "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Float specifying the overclosure measure (used to delineate the segments of the
        pressure-overclosure curve) as a percentage of the minimum element size in the contact
        region. The default value is 0.0.

    overclosureMeasure : --is-rst--:py:class:`float` = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/NormalBehavior.py#L75-L77)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.NormalBehavior.NormalBehavior.overclosureMeasure "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Float specifying the overclosure measure (used to delineate the segments of the
        pressure-overclosure curve) directly. The default value is 0.0.

    pressureOverclosure : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.SymbolicConstant.SymbolicConstant` = `'HARD'`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/NormalBehavior.py#L53-L56)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.NormalBehavior.NormalBehavior.pressureOverclosure "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the pressure-overclosure relationship to be used. Possible
        values are HARD, EXPONENTIAL, LINEAR, TABULAR, and SCALE\_FACTOR. The default value is
        HARD.

    setValues(*\*[args](#abaqus.Interaction.NormalBehavior.NormalBehavior.setValues "abaqus.Interaction.NormalBehavior.NormalBehavior.setValues.args (Python parameter)")*, *\*\*[kwargs](#abaqus.Interaction.NormalBehavior.NormalBehavior.setValues "abaqus.Interaction.NormalBehavior.NormalBehavior.setValues.kwargs (Python parameter)")*)[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/NormalBehavior.py#L211-L214)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.NormalBehavior.NormalBehavior.setValues "Permalink to this definition")
    :   This method modifies the NormalBehavior object.

    stiffnessBehavior : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.SymbolicConstant.SymbolicConstant` = `'LINEAR'`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/NormalBehavior.py#L96-L99)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.NormalBehavior.NormalBehavior.stiffnessBehavior "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of penalty stiffness to be defined. This argument
        is valid only when **constraintEnforcementMethod** = PENALTY. Possible values are LINEAR and
        NONLINEAR. The default value is LINEAR.

    stiffnessRatio : --is-rst--:py:class:`float` = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/NormalBehavior.py#L101-L104)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.NormalBehavior.NormalBehavior.stiffnessRatio "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Float specifying the ratio of the initial stiffness divided by the final stiffness.
        This argument is valid only when **stiffnessBehavior** = NONLINEAR. Possible values are 0 ≤
        **stiffnessRatio** < 1. The default value is 0.01.

    table : --is-rst--:py:class:`tuple`\[:py:class:`tuple`\[:py:class:`float`, :py:data:`...<Ellipsis>`], :py:data:`...<Ellipsis>`] = `()`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/NormalBehavior.py#L65-L68)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.NormalBehavior.NormalBehavior.table "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the normal behavior properties. This
        argument is valid only for **pressureOverclosure** = EXPONENTIAL or TABULAR. The items in
        the table data are described below.

    upperQuadraticFactor : --is-rst--:py:class:`float` = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/NormalBehavior.py#L106-L109)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.NormalBehavior.NormalBehavior.upperQuadraticFactor "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Float specifying the ratio of the overclosure at the maximum stiffness divided by the
        characteristic facet length. This argument is valid only when
        **stiffnessBehavior** = NONLINEAR. The default value is 0.03.

:   Bases: [`object`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#object "(in Python v3.13)")

    The ThermalConductance object specifies thermal conductance for a contact interaction property.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactionProperties[name].thermalConductance
    ```

    The table data for this object are:

    The **clearanceDepTable** data specify the following:

    * Conductivity.
    * Clearance.
    * Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
    * Mass flow rate, if the data depend on mass flow rate.
    * Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
    * Value of the second field variable.
    * Etc.

    The **pressureDepTable** data specify the following:

    * Conductivity.
    * Pressure.
    * Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
    * Mass flow rate, if the data depend on mass flow rate.
    * Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
    * Value of the second field variable.
    * Etc.

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * GAP CONDUCTANCE

    Note

    Check [ThermalConductance on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-thermalconductancepyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    Member Details:

    clearanceDepTable : --is-rst--:py:class:`tuple`\[:py:class:`tuple`\[:py:class:`float`, :py:data:`...<Ellipsis>`], :py:data:`...<Ellipsis>`] = `()`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/ThermalConductance.py#L70-L72)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.ThermalConductance.ThermalConductance.clearanceDepTable "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying clearance dependency data. The items in the
        table data are described below.

    clearanceDependency : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Union`\[:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.AbaqusBoolean.AbaqusBoolean`, :py:class:`bool`] = `1`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/ThermalConductance.py#L52-L53)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.ThermalConductance.ThermalConductance.clearanceDependency "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Boolean specifying whether to use clearance-dependent data. The default value is ON.

    definition : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.SymbolicConstant.SymbolicConstant` = `'TABULAR'`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/ThermalConductance.py#L48-L50)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.ThermalConductance.ThermalConductance.definition "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying how the thermal conductance is defined. Possible values
        are TABULAR and USER\_DEFINED. The default value is TABULAR.

    dependenciesC : --is-rst--:py:class:`int` = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/ThermalConductance.py#L66-L68)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.ThermalConductance.ThermalConductance.dependenciesC "Permalink to this definition")
    :   An Int specifying the number of field variables to use with clearance dependency. The
        default value is 0.

    dependenciesP : --is-rst--:py:class:`int` = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/ThermalConductance.py#L82-L84)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.ThermalConductance.ThermalConductance.dependenciesP "Permalink to this definition")
    :   An Int specifying the number of field variables to use with pressure dependency. The
        default value is 0.

    massFlowRateDependencyC : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Union`\[:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.AbaqusBoolean.AbaqusBoolean`, :py:class:`bool`] = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/ThermalConductance.py#L62-L64)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.ThermalConductance.ThermalConductance.massFlowRateDependencyC "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Boolean specifying whether to use mass-flow-rate-dependent data with clearance
        dependency. The default value is OFF.

    massFlowRateDependencyP : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Union`\[:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.AbaqusBoolean.AbaqusBoolean`, :py:class:`bool`] = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/ThermalConductance.py#L78-L80)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.ThermalConductance.ThermalConductance.massFlowRateDependencyP "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Boolean specifying whether to use mass-flow-rate-dependent data with pressure
        dependency. The default value is OFF.

    pressureDepTable : --is-rst--:py:class:`tuple`\[:py:class:`tuple`\[:py:class:`float`, :py:data:`...<Ellipsis>`], :py:data:`...<Ellipsis>`] = `()`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/ThermalConductance.py#L86-L88)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.ThermalConductance.ThermalConductance.pressureDepTable "Permalink to this definition")

*class* ContactStabilization[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/StdStabilization.py#L6-L18)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.StdStabilization.ContactStabilization "Permalink to this definition")

    ContactStabilization object has no explicit constructor, members, or methods.

    ```python
    import interaction
    ```

:   Bases: [`Interaction`](#abaqus.Interaction.XFEMCrackGrowth.Interaction "abaqus.Interaction.Interaction.Interaction (Python class)")

    The ContactStd object defines the contact domain and associated properties during contact in an
    Abaqus/Standard analysis. The ContactStd object is derived from the Interaction object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactions[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * CONTACT

    Note

    Check [ContactStd on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-contactstdpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    Member Details:

                are to be defined.

            assignments[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.InitializationAssignment.appendInStep.assignments "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of tuples specifying the initializations assigned to each surface pair. Each
                tuple contains four entries (fourth entry is for Abaqus/Explicit and is optional):

"Permalink to this definition")
:   Bases: [`Interaction`](#abaqus.Interaction.XFEMCrackGrowth.Interaction "abaqus.Interaction.Interaction.Interaction (Python class)")

    The CyclicSymmetry object defines a cyclic symmetry analysis. The CyclicSymmetry object is derived from
    the Interaction object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactions[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * CLOAD
    * CYCLIC SYMMETRY MODEL
    * DLOAD - CLOAD - CYCLIC SYMMETRY MODEL
    * DLOAD - SELECT CYCLIC SYMMETRY MODES
    * TIE

    Note

    Check [CyclicSymmetry on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-cyclicsymmetrypyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    Member Details:

    adjustTie : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Union`\[:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.AbaqusBoolean.AbaqusBoolean`, :py:class:`bool`] = `1`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L94-L96)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.adjustTie "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Boolean specifying whether or not to adjust the secondary surface of the cyclic
        symmetry to tie it to the main surface. The default value is ON.

    axisPoint1 : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.Region.Region.Region`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.axisPoint1 "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Region object specifying the first point of the axis of symmetry. The region should
        contain exactly one mesh node, vertex, interesting point, reference point, or datum
        point. In a two-dimensional model **axisPoint1** is the only point used to define the axis
        of symmetry.

    axisPoint2 : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.Region.Region.Region`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.axisPoint2 "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Region object specifying the second point of the axis of symmetry. The region should
        contain exactly one mesh node, vertex, interesting point, reference point, or datum
        point. This point is ignored in a two-dimensional model.

    createStepName : --is-rst--:py:class:`str`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.createStepName "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A String specifying the name of the step in which the cyclic symmetry interaction should
        be created.

    excitationNodalDiameter : --is-rst--:py:class:`int` = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L87-L92)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.excitationNodalDiameter "Permalink to this definition")
    :   An Int specifying the nodal diameter for which the modal-based steady-state dynamic
        analysis will be performed. This value should be greater than or equal to the lowest
        nodal diameter (specified in the **lowestNodalDiameter** parameter), and less than or
        equal to the highest nodal diameter (specified in the **highestNodalDiameter** parameter).
        The default value is 0.

    extractedNodalDiameter : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.SymbolicConstant.SymbolicConstant` = `'ALL_NODAL_DIAMETER'`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L72-L76)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.extractedNodalDiameter "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether Abaqus should extract all possible nodal diameters
        or the nodal diameters between the user-specified values for **lowestNodalDiameter** and
        **highestNodalDiameter**. Possible values are ALL\_NODAL\_DIAMETER and
        SPECIFIED\_NODAL\_DIAMETER. The default value is ALL\_NODAL\_DIAMETER.

    highestNodalDiameter : --is-rst--:py:class:`int` = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L82-L85)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.highestNodalDiameter "Permalink to this definition")
    :   An Int specifying the highest nodal diameter to be used in the eigenfrequency analysis.
        This argument value should be less than or equal to the half of the total number of
        sectors (as specified in the **repetitiveSectors** parameter). The default value is 0.

    lowestNodalDiameter : --is-rst--:py:class:`int` = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L78-L80)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.lowestNodalDiameter "Permalink to this definition")
    :   An Int specifying the lowest nodal diameter to be used in the eigenfrequency analysis.
        The default value is 0.

    main : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.Region.Region.Region`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.main "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Region object specifying the main surface.

        Changed in version 2022: The attribute `master` was renamed to `main`.

    positionTolerance : --is-rst--:py:class:`float` = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L98-L100)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.positionTolerance "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Float specifying the position tolerance. The\*positionTolerance\* argument applies only
        when **positionToleranceMethod** = SPECIFY\_TOLERANCE. The default value is 0.0.

    positionToleranceMethod : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.SymbolicConstant.SymbolicConstant` = `'COMPUTED_TOLERANCE'`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L102-L105)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.positionToleranceMethod "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the method used to determine the position tolerance.
        Possible values are COMPUTED\_TOLERANCE and SPECIFY\_TOLERANCE. The default value is
        COMPUTED\_TOLERANCE.

    repetitiveSectors : --is-rst--:py:class:`int`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.repetitiveSectors "Permalink to this definition")
    :   An Int specifying the total number of sectors in the cyclic symmetric model.

    secondary : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.Region.Region.Region`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.secondary "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Region object specifying the secondary surface.

        Changed in version 2022: The attribute `slave` was renamed to `secondary`.

    :   This method modifies the data for an existing CyclicSymmetry object in the step where it is created.

        Note

        Check [CyclicSymmetry.setValues on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-cyclicsymmetrypyc.htm?contextscope=all#simaker-cyclicsymmetrysetvaluespyc).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.setValues-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   extractedNodalDiameter=`abaqusConstants.ALL_NODAL_DIAMETER`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.setValues.extractedNodalDiameter "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether Abaqus should extract all possible nodal diameters
                or the nodal diameters between the user-specified values for **lowestNodalDiameter** and
                **highestNodalDiameter**. Possible values are ALL\_NODAL\_DIAMETER and
                SPECIFIED\_NODAL\_DIAMETER. The default value is ALL\_NODAL\_DIAMETER.

            lowestNodalDiameter=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.setValues.lowestNodalDiameter "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the lowest nodal diameter to be used in the eigenfrequency analysis.
                The default value is 0.

            highestNodalDiameter=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.setValues.highestNodalDiameter "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the highest nodal diameter to be used in the eigenfrequency analysis.
                This argument value should be less than or equal to the half of the total number of
                sectors (as specified in the **repetitiveSectors** parameter). The default value is 0.

            excitationNodalDiameter=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.setValues.excitationNodalDiameter "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the nodal diameter for which the modal-based steady-state dynamic
                analysis will be performed. This value should be greater than or equal to the lowest
                nodal diameter (specified in the **lowestNodalDiameter** parameter), and less than or
                equal to the highest nodal diameter (specified in the **highestNodalDiameter** parameter).
                The default value is 0.

            adjustTie=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.setValues.adjustTie "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether or not to adjust the secondary surface of the cyclic
                symmetry to tie it to the main surface. The default value is ON.

            positionTolerance=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.setValues.positionTolerance "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the position tolerance. The\*positionTolerance\* argument applies only
                when **positionToleranceMethod** = SPECIFY\_TOLERANCE. The default value is 0.0.

            positionToleranceMethod=`abaqusConstants.COMPUTED_TOLERANCE`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.CyclicSymmetry.setValues.positionToleranceMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the method used to determine the position tolerance.
                Possible values are COMPUTED\_TOLERANCE and SPECIFY\_TOLERANCE. The default value is
                COMPUTED\_TOLERANCE.

*class* CyclicSymmetryState[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/CyclicSymmetryState.py#L9-L80)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.CyclicSymmetryState.CyclicSymmetryState "Permalink to this definition")
:   Bases: [`InteractionState`](#abaqus.Interaction.XFEMCrackGrowthState.InteractionState "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionState.InteractionState (Python class)")

    The CyclicSymmetryState object stores the propagating data for a CyclicSymmetry object. One instance of
    this object is created internally by the CyclicSymmetry object for each step. The instance is also deleted
    internally by the CyclicSymmetry object. The CyclicSymmetryState object has no constructor or methods. The
    CyclicSymmetryState object is derived from the InteractionState object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].steps[name].interactionStates[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * CLOAD
    * DLOAD
    * DSLOAD
    * SELECT CYCLIC SYMMETRY MODES

    Note

    Check [CyclicSymmetryState on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-cyclicsymmetrystatepyc.htm?contextscope=all).

:   Bases: [`ContactControl`](#abaqus.Interaction.StdContactControl.ContactControl "abaqus.Interaction.ContactControl.ContactControl (Python class)")

    The ExpContactControl object is used in Abaqus/Explicit analyses to specify optional solution controls
    for problems involving contact between bodies. The ExpContactControl object is derived from the
    ContactControl object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].contactControls[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * CONTACT CONTROLS

    Note

:   Bases: [`ContactInitialization`](#abaqus.Interaction.StdInitialization.ContactInitialization "abaqus.Interaction.ContactInitialization.ContactInitialization (Python class)")

    The ExpInitialization object is used in conjunction with ContactExp in Abaqus/Explicit analyses to
    specify contact initialization data. The ExpInitialization object is derived from the ContactInitialization
    object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].contactInitializations[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * CONTACT INITIALIZATION DATA

    New in version 2020: The `ExpInitialization` class was added.

    Note

    Check [ExpInitialization on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-expinitializationpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    Member Details:

    adjustNodalCoords : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Union`\[:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.AbaqusBoolean.AbaqusBoolean`, :py:class:`bool`] = `True`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionContactInitializationModel.py#L58-L62)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactInitializationModel.ExpInitialization.adjustNodalCoords "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Boolean specifying whether to resolve clearances/overclosures by adjusting the nodal
        coordinates without creating strain in the model. **adjustNodalCoords** = True can be used
        only for clearances/overclosures defined in the first step of an analysis. The default
        value is True.

    clearanceDistance : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Optional`\[:py:class:`float`] = `None`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionContactInitializationModel.py#L43-L46)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactInitializationModel.ExpInitialization.clearanceDistance "Permalink to this definition")
    :   None or a Float specifying the initial clearance distance. This argument is valid only
        when **overclosureType** = CLEARANCE and must be specified in that case. The default value
        is None.

    interferenceDistance : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Optional`\[:py:class:`float`] = `None`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionContactInitializationModel.py#L39-L41)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactInitializationModel.ExpInitialization.interferenceDistance "Permalink to this definition")
    :   None or a Float specifying the interference distance. This argument is valid only when
        **overclosureType** = INTERFERENCE. The default value is None.

    name : --is-rst--:py:class:`str`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionContactInitializationModel.py)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactInitializationModel.ExpInitialization.name "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A String specifying the contact initialization repository key.

    openingTolerance : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Optional`\[:py:class:`float`] = `None`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionContactInitializationModel.py#L48-L52)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactInitializationModel.ExpInitialization.openingTolerance "Permalink to this definition")
    :   None or a Float specifying the distance tolerance within which initial openings will
        undergo strain-free adjustments. This argument is not valid when
        **overclosureType** = INTERFERENCE unless a value has been specified for
        **interferenceDistance**. The default value is None.

    overclosureTolerance : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Optional`\[:py:class:`float`] = `None`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionContactInitializationModel.py#L54-L56)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactInitializationModel.ExpInitialization.overclosureTolerance "Permalink to this definition")
    :   None or a Float specifying the distance tolerance within which initial overclosures will
        undergo strain-free adjustments. The default value is None.

    overclosureType : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.SymbolicConstant.SymbolicConstant` = `'ADJUST'`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionContactInitializationModel.py#L35-L37)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactInitializationModel.ExpInitialization.overclosureType "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of overclosure to be defined. Possible values are
        ADJUST, INTERFERENCE, and CLEARANCE. The default value is ADJUST.

    secondaryNodesetName : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Optional`\[:py:class:`str`] = `None`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionContactInitializationModel.py#L69-L71)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionContactInitializationModel.ExpInitialization.secondaryNodesetName "Permalink to this definition")

        included in the initial clearance specification. This argument is not valid when
        **overclosureType** = INTERFERENCE and if **openingTolerance** or **overclosureTolerance** is
        specified. The default value is None.

    The FilmCondition object defines film coefficients and associated sink temperatures for coupled
    temperature-displacement analyses. The FilmCondition object is derived from the Interaction object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactions[name]
    ```

    Note

    Check [FilmCondition on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-filmconditionpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    Member Details:

    createStepName : --is-rst--:py:class:`str`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.FilmCondition.createStepName "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A String specifying the name of the step in which the FilmCondition object is created.

    definition : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.SymbolicConstant.SymbolicConstant`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.FilmCondition.definition "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying how the film condition is defined. Possible values are
        EMBEDDED\_COEFF, PROPERTY\_REF, USER\_SUB, and FIELD.

    field : --is-rst--:py:class:`str` = `''`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L68-L71)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.FilmCondition.field "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A String specifying the name of the AnalyticalField object associated with this
        interaction. The **field** argument applies only when **definition** = FIELD. The default
        value is an empty string.

    filmCoeff : --is-rst--:py:class:`float` = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L55-L58)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.FilmCondition.filmCoeff "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Float specifying the reference film coefficient value, hh. The **filmCoeff** argument

    The FilmConditionProp object is an interaction property that defines a film coefficient as a function of
    temperature and field variables. The FilmConditionProp object is derived from the InteractionProperty
    object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactionProperties[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * FILM PROPERTY

    Note

    Check [FilmConditionProp on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-filmconditionproppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

*class* FilmConditionState[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/FilmConditionState.py#L9-L77)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.FilmConditionState.FilmConditionState "Permalink to this definition")
:   Bases: [`InteractionState`](#abaqus.Interaction.XFEMCrackGrowthState.InteractionState "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionState.InteractionState (Python class)")

    The FilmConditionState object stores the propagating data for a FilmCondition object. One instance of
    this object is created internally by the FilmCondition object for each step. The instance is also deleted
    internally by the FilmCondition object. The FilmConditionState object has no constructor or methods. The
    FilmConditionState object is derived from the InteractionState object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].steps[name].interactionStates[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * SFILM
    * FILM

    Note

    Check [FilmConditionState on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-filmconditionstatepyc.htm?contextscope=all).
