"Permalink to this definition")
:   Bases: [`ContactProperty`](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty "abaqus.Interaction.ContactProperty.ContactProperty (Python class)")

    The FluidCavityProperty object is an interaction property that defines the fluid behavior for a surface-
    based fluid cavity. The FluidCavityProperty object is derived from the InteractionProperty object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactionProperties[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * FLUID BEHAVIOR
    * CAPACITY
    * FLUID BULK MODULUS
    * FLUID DENSITY
    * FLUID EXPANSION
    * MOLECULAR WEIGHT

    Note

    Check [FluidCavityProperty on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-fluidcavitypropertypyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    Member Details:

    bulkModulusDependencies : --is-rst--int = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionPropertyModel.py#L95-L98)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.bulkModulusDependencies "Permalink to this definition")
    :   An Int specifying the number of field variable dependencies in the fluid bulk modulus
        data. This argument is applicable only when **definition** = HYDRAULIC and when
        **useBulkModulus** = True. The default value is 0.

    bulkModulusTable : --is-rst--tuple[tuple[float, ...], ...] = `()`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionPropertyModel.py#L104-L109)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.bulkModulusTable "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the fluid bulk modulus values. This
        argument is applicable only when **definition** = HYDRAULIC and when **useBulkModulus** = True.
        Each sequence contains the following data:

        * The fluid bulk modulus.
        * Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
        * Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
        * Value of the second field variable.
        * Etc.

    bulkModulusTempDep : --is-rst--Boolean = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionPropertyModel.py#L90-L93)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.bulkModulusTempDep "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Boolean specifying whether the fluid bulk modulus data will have temperature
        dependency. This argument is applicable only when **definition** = HYDRAULIC and when
        **useBulkModulus** = True. The default value is OFF.

    capacityDependencies : --is-rst--int = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionPropertyModel.py#L124-L127)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.capacityDependencies "Permalink to this definition")
    :   An Int specifying the number of field variable dependencies in the molar heat capacity
        data. This argument is applicable only when **definition** = PNEUMATIC, when
        **useCapacity** = True, and when **capacityType** = TABULAR. The default value is 0.

    capacityTable : --is-rst--tuple[tuple[float, ...], ...] = `()`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionPropertyModel.py#L145-L150)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.capacityTable "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the molar heat capacity values in the form
        of a polynomial expression. This argument is applicable only when
        **definition** = PNEUMATIC, when **useCapacity** = True, and when **capacityType** = POLYNOMIAL. In
        this form, only one sequence is specified and that sequence contains the following data:

        * The first molar heat capacity coefficient.
        * The second molar heat capacity coefficient.
        * The third molar heat capacity coefficient.
        * The fourth molar heat capacity coefficient.
        * The fifth molar heat capacity coefficient.

        Alternatively, the sequence data may specify the molar heat capacity values at constant
        pressure for an ideal gas species. This argument is applicable only when
        **definition** = PNEUMATIC, when **useCapacity** = True, and when **capacityType** = TABULAR. Each
        sequence contains the following data:

        * The molar heat capacity at constant pressure.
        * Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
        * Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
        * Value of the second field variable.
        * Etc.

    capacityTempDep : --is-rst--Boolean = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionPropertyModel.py#L119-L122)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.capacityTempDep "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Boolean specifying whether the molar heat capacity data will have temperature
        dependency. This argument is applicable only when **definition** = PNEUMATIC, when
        **useCapacity** = True, and when **capacityType** = TABULAR. The default value is OFF.

    capacityType : --is-rst--SymbolicConstant = `'POLYNOMIAL'`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionPropertyModel.py#L115-L117)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.capacityType "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the method to define the molar heat capacity. Possible
        values are POLYNOMIAL and TABULAR. The default value is POLYNOMIAL.

    definition : --is-rst--SymbolicConstant = `'HYDRAULIC'`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionPropertyModel.py#L42-L44)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.definition "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of fluid cavity property to be defined. Possible
        values are HYDRAULIC and PNEUMATIC. The default value is HYDRAULIC.

    expansionDependencies : --is-rst--int = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionPropertyModel.py#L64-L67)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.expansionDependencies "Permalink to this definition")
    :   An Int specifying the number of field variable dependencies in the thermal fluid
        expansion data. This argument is applicable only when **definition** = HYDRAULIC and when
        **useExpansion** = True. The default value is 0.

    expansionTable : --is-rst--tuple[tuple[float, ...], ...] = `()`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionPropertyModel.py#L79-L84)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.expansionTable "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the thermal expansion coefficients. This
        argument is applicable only when **definition** = HYDRAULIC and when **useExpansion** = True.
        Each sequence contains the following data:

        * The mean coefficient of thermal expansion.
        * Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
        * Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
        * Value of the second field variable.
        * Etc.

    expansionTempDep : --is-rst--Boolean = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionPropertyModel.py#L59-L62)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.expansionTempDep "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Boolean specifying whether the thermal fluid expansion data will have temperature
        dependency. This argument is applicable only when **definition** = HYDRAULIC and when
        **useExpansion** = True. The default value is OFF.

    fluidDensity : --is-rst--float | None = `None`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionPropertyModel.py#L46-L48)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.fluidDensity "Permalink to this definition")
    :   None or a Float specifying the reference fluid density. This argument is applicable only
        when **definition** = HYDRAULIC, and is required in that case. The default value is None.

    molecularWeight : --is-rst--float | None = `None`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionPropertyModel.py#L50-L53)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.molecularWeight "Permalink to this definition")
    :   None or a Float specifying the molecular weight of the ideal gas species. This argument
        is applicable only when **definition** = PNEUMATIC, and is required in that case. The
        default value is None.

    name : --is-rst--str[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionPropertyModel.py)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.name "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A String specifying the interaction property repository key.

    :   A Float specifying the reference temperature for the coefficient of thermal expansion.
        This argument is applicable only when **definition** = HYDRAULIC, when **useExpansion** = True,

        0. The default value is 0.0.

                argument is applicable only when **definition** = HYDRAULIC and when **useExpansion** = True.
                Each sequence contains the following data:

                * The mean coefficient of thermal expansion.
                * Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
                * Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
                * Value of the second field variable.
                * Etc.

            useBulkModulus=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.setValues.useBulkModulus "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether fluid bulk modulus values will be defined. This argument is
                applicable only when **definition** = HYDRAULIC. The default value is OFF.

            bulkModulusTempDep=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.setValues.bulkModulusTempDep "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the fluid bulk modulus data will have temperature
                dependency. This argument is applicable only when **definition** = HYDRAULIC and when
                **useBulkModulus** = True. The default value is OFF.

            bulkModulusDependencies=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.setValues.bulkModulusDependencies "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of field variable dependencies in the fluid bulk modulus
                data. This argument is applicable only when **definition** = HYDRAULIC and when
                **useBulkModulus** = True. The default value is 0.

            bulkModulusTable=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.setValues.bulkModulusTable "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the fluid bulk modulus values. This
                argument is applicable only when **definition** = HYDRAULIC and when **useBulkModulus** = True.
                Each sequence contains the following data:

                * The fluid bulk modulus.
                * Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
                * Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
                * Value of the second field variable.
                * Etc.

            useCapacity=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.setValues.useCapacity "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether molar heat capacity values will be defined. This argument
                is applicable only when **definition** = PNEUMATIC. The default value is OFF.

            capacityType=`abaqusConstants.POLYNOMIAL`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.setValues.capacityType "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the method to define the molar heat capacity. Possible
                values are POLYNOMIAL and TABULAR. The default value is POLYNOMIAL.

            capacityTempDep=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.setValues.capacityTempDep "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the molar heat capacity data will have temperature
                dependency. This argument is applicable only when **definition** = PNEUMATIC, when
                **useCapacity** = True, and when **capacityType** = TABULAR. The default value is OFF.

            capacityDependencies=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.setValues.capacityDependencies "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of field variable dependencies in the molar heat capacity
                data. This argument is applicable only when **definition** = PNEUMATIC, when
                **useCapacity** = True, and when **capacityType** = TABULAR. The default value is 0.

            capacityTable=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidCavityProperty.setValues.capacityTable "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the molar heat capacity values in the form
                of a polynomial expression. This argument is applicable only when
                **definition** = PNEUMATIC, when **useCapacity** = True, and when **capacityType** = POLYNOMIAL. In
                this form, only one sequence is specified and that sequence contains the following data:

                * The first molar heat capacity coefficient.
                * The second molar heat capacity coefficient.
                * The third molar heat capacity coefficient.
                * The fourth molar heat capacity coefficient.
                * The fifth molar heat capacity coefficient.

                Alternatively, the sequence data may specify the molar heat capacity values at constant
                pressure for an ideal gas species. This argument is applicable only when
                **definition** = PNEUMATIC, when **useCapacity** = True, and when **capacityType** = TABULAR. Each
                sequence contains the following data:

                * The molar heat capacity at constant pressure.
                * Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
                * Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
                * Value of the second field variable.
                * Etc.

*class* FluidCavityState[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/FluidCavityState.py#L9-L35)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.FluidCavityState.FluidCavityState "Permalink to this definition")
:   Bases: [`InteractionState`](#abaqus.Interaction.XFEMCrackGrowthState.InteractionState "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionState.InteractionState (Python class)")

    The FluidCavityState object stores the propagating data for an FluidCavity object. One instance of this
    object is created internally by the FluidCavity object for each step. The instance is also deleted
    internally by the FluidCavity object. The FluidCavityState object has no constructor or methods. The
    FluidCavityState object is derived from the InteractionState object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].steps[name].interactionStates[name]
    ```

    Note

    Check [FluidCavityState on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-fluidcavitystatepyc.htm?contextscope=all).

:   Bases: [`ContactProperty`](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty "abaqus.Interaction.ContactProperty.ContactProperty (Python class)")

    The FluidExchangeProperty object is an interaction property that defines the fluid exchange property for
    a flow between two fluid cavities or between a fluid cavity and its environment. The FluidExchangeProperty
    object is derived from the InteractionProperty object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactionProperties[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * FLUID EXCHANGE PROPERTY

    Note

    Check [FluidExchangeProperty on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-fluidexchangepropertypyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    Member Details:

    dataTable : --is-rst--tuple[tuple[float, ...], ...] = `()`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionPropertyModel.py#L77-L86)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidExchangeProperty.dataTable "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the viscous and hydrodynamic resistance
        coefficients when **definition** = BULK\_VISCOSITY. Each sequence contains the following
        data:

        * The viscous resistance coefficient.
        * The hydrodynamic resistance coefficient.
        * The average absolute pressure, if the data depend on pressure.
        * The average temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
        * The value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
        * The value of the second field variable.
        * Etc.

        Alternatively, the sequence data may specify the mass flow rate. This is applicable only
        when **definition** = MASS\_FLUX. In this form, only one sequence is specified and that
        sequence contains the following data:

        * The mass flow rate per unit area.

        Alternatively, the sequence data may specify the mass rate leakage. This is applicable
        only when **definition** = MASS\_RATE\_LEAK. Each sequence contains the following data:

        * The absolute value of the mass flow rate per unit area. (The first tabular value
          entered must always be zero.)
        * The absolute value of the pressure difference. (The first tabular value entered must
          always be zero.)
        * The average absolute pressure, if the data depend on pressure.
        * The average temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
        * The value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
        * The value of the second field variable.
        * Etc.

        Alternatively, the sequence data may specify the volume flow rate. This is applicable
        only when **definition** = VOL\_FLUX. In this form, only one sequence is specified and that
        sequence contains the following data:

        * The volumetric flow rate per unit area.

        Alternatively, the sequence data may specify the volume rate leakage. This is applicable
        only when **definition** = VOL\_RATE\_LEAK. Each sequence contains the following data:

        * The absolute value of the volumetric flow rate per unit area. (The first tabular value
          entered must always be zero.)
        * The absolute value of the pressure difference. (The first tabular value entered must
          always be zero.)
        * The average absolute pressure, if the data depend on pressure.
        * The average temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
        * The value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
        * The value of the second field variable.
        * Etc.

    The FluidExchangeState object stores the propagating data for an FluidExchange object. One instance of
    this object is created internally by the FluidExchange object for each step. The instance is also deleted
    internally by the FluidExchange object. The FluidExchangeState object has no constructor or methods. The
    FluidExchangeState object is derived from the InteractionState object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].steps[name].interactionStates[name]
    ```

    Check [FluidExchangeState on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-fluidexchangestatepyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    The FluidInflatorActivation object is used to define the activation of fluid inflators to model the deployment of
    an airbag.

    The FluidInflatorActivation object is derived from the Interaction object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactions[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * FLUID INFLATOR ACTIVATION

:   Bases: [`ContactProperty`](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.ContactProperty "abaqus.Interaction.ContactProperty.ContactProperty (Python class)")

    The FluidInflatorProperty object is an interaction property that defines a fluid inflator property to
    model the deployment of an airbag. The inflator property defines the mass flow rate and temperature as a
    function of inflation time either directly or by entering tank test data. It also defines the mixture of
    gases entering the fluid cavity. The FluidInflatorProperty object is derived from the InteractionProperty
    object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactionProperties[name]
    ```

    The table data for this object are:

    * If **definition** = DUAL PRESSURE, the table data specify the following:

      > + Inflation time.
      > + Inflator pressure.
      > + Tank pressure.
    * If **definition** = PRESSURE AND MASS, the table data specify the following:

      > + Inflation time.
      > + Inflator pressure.
      > + Inflator mass flow rate.
    * If **definition** = TANK TEST, the table data specify the following:

      > + Inflation time.
      > + Inflator gas temperature.
      > + Tank pressure.
    * If **definition** = TEMPERATURE AND MASS, the table data specify the following:

      > + Inflation time.
      > + Inflator gas temperature.
      > + Inflator mass flow rate.

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * FLUID INFLATOR PROPERTY

    New in version 2019: The `FluidInflatorProperty` class was added.

    Note

    Check [FluidInflatorProperty on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-fluidinflatorpropertypyc.htm?contextscope=all).

                **definition** = DUAL PRESSURE or **definition** = PRESSURE AND MASS.

            dataTable=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidInflatorProperty.setValues.dataTable "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the items described in the “Table data”
                section below.

            numFluids=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidInflatorProperty.setValues.numFluids "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of gas species used for this inflator.

            mixtureType=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidInflatorProperty.setValues.mixtureType "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Symbolic constant specifying whether to use mass fraction or the molar fraction for a
                mixture of ideal gases. The default value is MASS FRACTION. The possible values are MASS
                FRACTION or MOLAR FRACTION.

            inflationTime=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidInflatorProperty.setValues.inflationTime "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the inflation time.

            fluidbehaviorName=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidInflatorProperty.setValues.fluidbehaviorName "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Strings specifying fluid behavior names.

            massFraction=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.FluidInflatorProperty.setValues.massFraction "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the mass fraction or the molar fraction
                corresponding to entered fluid behavior.

*class* FluidInflatorState[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/FluidInflatorState.py#L9-L38)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.FluidInflatorState.FluidInflatorState "Permalink to this definition")
:   Bases: [`InteractionState`](#abaqus.Interaction.XFEMCrackGrowthState.InteractionState "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionState.InteractionState (Python class)")

    The FluidInflatorState object stores the propagating data for a FluidInflator object. One instance of
    this object is created internally by the FluidInflator object for each step. The instance is also deleted
    internally by the FluidInflator object. The FluidInflatorState object has no constructor or methods. The
    FluidInflatorState object is derived from the InteractionState object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].steps[name].interactionStates[name]
    ```

    New in version 2019: The `FluidInflatorState` class was added.

    Note

    Check [FluidInflatorState on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-fluidinflatorstatepyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    Member Details:

    status : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.SymbolicConstant.SymbolicConstant`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/FluidInflatorState.py)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.FluidInflatorState.FluidInflatorState.status "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A **SymbolicConstant** specifying the propagation state of the InteractionState object.
        Possible values are:

        * NOT\_YET\_ACTIVE
        * CREATED
        * PROPAGATED
        * MODIFIED
        * DEACTIVATED
        * NO\_LONGER\_ACTIVE
        * TYPE\_NOT\_APPLICABLE
        * INSTANCE\_NOT\_APPLICABLE
        * BUILT\_INTO\_BASE\_STATE

definition")
:   Bases: [`Interaction`](#abaqus.Interaction.XFEMCrackGrowth.Interaction "abaqus.Interaction.Interaction.Interaction (Python class)")

    The IncidentWave object defines incident wave interactions for acoustic and coupled acoustic-structural
    analyses. The IncidentWave object is derived from the Interaction object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactions[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * INCIDENT WAVE INTERACTION

    Note

    Check [IncidentWave on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-incidentwavepyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    Member Details:

    amplitude : --is-rst--:py:class:`str` = `''`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py#L56-L62)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.IncidentWave.amplitude "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A String specifying the name of the Amplitude object that defines the fluid pressure
        time history at the standoff point, if **definition** = PRESSURE. If
        **definition** = ACCELERATION, then this string specifies the name of the Amplitude object
        that defines the fluid particle acceleration time history at the standoff point. This
        member can be specified only if **definition** = PRESSURE or ACCELERATION. The default value
        is an empty string.

    createStepName : --is-rst--:py:class:`str`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionModel.py)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionModel.IncidentWave.createStepName "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A String specifying the name of the step in which the IncidentWave object is created.

    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of incident wave to be defined. The value must be

        set to CONWEP. Possible values are PRESSURE, ACCELERATION, UNDEX, and CONWEP. The
        default value is PRESSURE.

    The IncidentWaveProperty object is an interaction property that defines the properties referred to by an
    IncidentWave object. The IncidentWaveProperty object is derived from the InteractionProperty object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactionProperties[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * INCIDENT WAVE INTERACTION PROPERTY
    * UNDEX CHARGE PROPERTY
    * CONWEP CHARGE PROPERTY

    Note

    Check [IncidentWaveProperty on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-incidentwavepropertypyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    Member Details:

    absoluteStepControl : --is-rst--float | None = `None`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionPropertyModel.py#L133-L136)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.absoluteStepControl "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Float specifying the absolute step size control parameter. The default value is
        1x10⁻¹¹.This argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL and
        **propagationModel** = UNDEX\_CHARGE.

    atmosphericPressure : --is-rst--float | None = `None`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionPropertyModel.py#L66-L68)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.atmosphericPressure "Permalink to this definition")
    :   None or a Float specifying the atmospheric pressure. The default value is None.This
        argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL and **propagationModel** = UNDEX\_CHARGE.

            maximumSteps=`1500`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.setValues.maximumSteps "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the maximum number of time steps for the bubble simulation. The
                default value is 1500.This argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL and
                **propagationModel** = UNDEX\_CHARGE.

            relativeStepControl=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.setValues.relativeStepControl "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the relative step size control parameter. The default value is
                1x10⁻¹¹.This argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL and
                **propagationModel** = UNDEX\_CHARGE.

            absoluteStepControl=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.setValues.absoluteStepControl "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the absolute step size control parameter. The default value is
                1x10⁻¹¹.This argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL and
                **propagationModel** = UNDEX\_CHARGE.

            stepControlExponent=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.setValues.stepControlExponent "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the step size control exponent. The default value is 0.2.This
                argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL and **propagationModel** = UNDEX\_CHARGE.

            genDecayA=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.setValues.genDecayA "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the constant A associated with the generalized decay propagation
                model. The default value is 0.0.This argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL
                and **propagationModel** = GENERALIZED\_DECAY.

            genDecayB=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.setValues.genDecayB "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the constant B associated with the generalized decay propagation
                model. The default value is 0.0.This argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL
                and **propagationModel** = GENERALIZED\_DECAY.

            genDecayC=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.setValues.genDecayC "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the constant C associated with the generalized decay propagation
                model. The default value is 0.0.This argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL
                and **propagationModel** = GENERALIZED\_DECAY.

            seedNumber=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.setValues.seedNumber "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the seed number (N) for the diffuse source calculation. N2 sources
                will be used in the simulation.This argument is valid only when **definition** = DIFFUSE.

            massTNT=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.setValues.massTNT "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the equivalent mass of TNT, in any preferred mass unit.This argument
                is valid only when **definition** = AIR\_BLAST or **definition** = SURFACE\_BLAST.

            massFactor=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.setValues.massFactor "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the multiplication factor to convert from the preferred mass unit to
                kilograms. The default value is 1.0.This argument is valid only when
                **definition** = AIR\_BLAST or **definition** = SURFACE\_BLAST.

            lengthFactor=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.setValues.lengthFactor "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the multiplication factor to convert from the analysis length unit to
                meters. The default value is 1.0.This argument is valid only when **definition** = AIR\_BLAST
                or **definition** = SURFACE\_BLAST.

            timeFactor=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.setValues.timeFactor "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the multiplication factor to convert from the analysis time unit to
                seconds. The default value is 1.0.This argument is valid only when
                **definition** = AIR\_BLAST or **definition** = SURFACE\_BLAST.

            pressureFactor=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.setValues.pressureFactor "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the multiplication factor to convert from the analysis pressure unit
                to pascals. The default value is 1.0.This argument is valid only when
                **definition** = AIR\_BLAST or **definition** = SURFACE\_BLAST.

    soundSpeed : --is-rst--float | None = `None`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionPropertyModel.py#L48-L50)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.soundSpeed "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Float specifying the speed of sound in the fluid.This argument is not valid when

    specificHeatRatio : --is-rst--float | None = `None`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionPropertyModel.py#L56-L59)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.specificHeatRatio "Permalink to this definition")
    :   None or a Float specifying the ratio of specific heats for gas. The default value is
        None.This argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL and
        **propagationModel** = UNDEX\_CHARGE.

    stepControlExponent : --is-rst--float = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionPropertyModel.py#L138-L140)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.stepControlExponent "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Float specifying the step size control exponent. The default value is 0.2.This
        argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL and **propagationModel** = UNDEX\_CHARGE.

    timeFactor : --is-rst--float = `1`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionPropertyModel.py#L175-L178)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.timeFactor "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Float specifying the multiplication factor to convert from the analysis time unit to
        seconds. The default value is 1.0.This argument is valid only when
        **definition** = AIR\_BLAST or **definition** = SURFACE\_BLAST.

    waveEffects : --is-rst--Boolean = `1`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/InteractionPropertyModel.py#L78-L81)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.InteractionPropertyModel.IncidentWaveProperty.waveEffects "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Boolean specifying whether or not to include wave effects in the fluid and gas. The
        default value is ON.This argument is valid only when **definition** = SPHERICAL and
        **propagationModel** = UNDEX\_CHARGE.

*class* IncidentWaveState[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/IncidentWaveState.py#L9-L30)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.IncidentWaveState.IncidentWaveState "Permalink to this definition")
:   Bases: [`InteractionState`](#abaqus.Interaction.XFEMCrackGrowthState.InteractionState "abaqus.Interaction.InteractionState.InteractionState (Python class)")

    The IncidentWaveState object stores the propagating data of an IncidentWave object in a step. One
    instance of this object is created internally by the IncidentWave object for each step. The instance is also
    deleted internally by the IncidentWave object. The IncidentWaveState object has no constructor or methods.
    The IncidentWaveState object is derived from the InteractionState object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].steps[name].interactionStates[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * INCIDENT WAVE INTERACTION

    Note

    Check [IncidentWaveState on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-incidentwavestatepyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    Member Details:

    status : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.SymbolicConstant.SymbolicConstant`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/IncidentWaveState.py)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.IncidentWaveState.IncidentWaveState.status "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the propagation state of the InteractionState object.
        Possible values
        are:NOT\_YET\_ACTIVECREATEDPROPAGATEDMODIFIEDDEACTIVATEDNO\_LONGER\_ACTIVETYPE\_NOT\_APPLICABLEINSTANCE\_NOT\_APPLICABLEBUILT\_INTO\_BASE\_STATE

"Permalink to this definition")
:   Bases: [`ContactControl`](#abaqus.Interaction.StdContactControl.ContactControl "abaqus.Interaction.ContactControl.ContactControl (Python class)")

    The StdContactControl object is used in Abaqus/Standard analyses to specify optional solution controls
    for problems involving contact between bodies. The StdContactControl object is derived from the
    ContactControl object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].contactControls[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * CONTACT CONTROLS

    Note

    Check [StdContactControl on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-stdcontactcontrolpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    Member Details:

    absolutePenetrationTolerance : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Optional`\[:py:class:`float`] = `None`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/StdContactControl.py#L60-L66)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.StdContactControl.StdContactControl.absolutePenetrationTolerance "Permalink to this definition")
    :   None or a Float specifying the allowable penetration. Only contact interactions defined
        with augmented Lagrangian surface behavior will be affected by this argument. The
        **absolutePenetrationTolerance** argument applies only when
        **penetrationTolChoice** = ABSOLUTE. The **relativePenetrationTolerance** and
        **absolutePenetrationTolerance** arguments are mutually exclusive. The default value is
        None.

    automaticTolerances : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Union`\[:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.AbaqusBoolean.AbaqusBoolean`, :py:class:`bool`] = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/StdContactControl.py#L77-L81)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.StdContactControl.StdContactControl.automaticTolerances "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Boolean specifying whether Abaqus/Standard should automatically compute an overclosure
        tolerance and a separation tolerance to prevent chattering in contact. The default value
        is OFF.The **automaticTolerances** argument cannot be used with the **maxchp**, **perrmx**,
        and **uerrmx** arguments.

    dampCoef : --is-rst--:py:class:`float` = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/StdContactControl.py#L112-L114)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.StdContactControl.StdContactControl.dampCoef "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Float specifying the damping coefficient. The default value is 0.0.This argument is
        only valid when **stabilizeChoice** = COEFFICIENT.

    dampFactor : --is-rst--:py:class:`float` = `1`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/StdContactControl.py#L107-L110)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.StdContactControl.StdContactControl.dampFactor "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Float specifying the value of the damping factor. This value is multiplied by the
        calculated damping coefficient. The default value is 1.0.This argument is only valid
        when **stabilizeChoice** = AUTOMATIC.

    enforceWithLagrangeMultipliers : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.SymbolicConstant.SymbolicConstant` = `'DEFAULT'`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/StdContactControl.py#L136-L139)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.StdContactControl.StdContactControl.enforceWithLagrangeMultipliers "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether to enforce the contact constraints with Lagrange
        multipliers. Possible values are DEFAULT, ENFORCEMENT\_OFF, and ENFORCEMENT\_ON. The
        default value is DEFAULT.

    eosFraction : --is-rst--:py:class:`float` = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/StdContactControl.py#L121-L124)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.StdContactControl.StdContactControl.eosFraction "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Float specifying the fraction of the damping that remains at the end of the step. The
        default value is 0.0.This argument is valid only if **stabilizeChoice** = AUTOMATIC or
        COEFFICIENT.

    frictionOnset : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.SymbolicConstant.SymbolicConstant`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/StdContactControl.py)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.StdContactControl.StdContactControl.frictionOnset "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying when the application of friction occurs. Possible values
        are:

        * IMMEDIATE, specifying the friction is included in the increment when contact occurs.
        * DELAYED, specifying the application of friction is delayed until the increment after

        contact occurs.

    maxchp : --is-rst--:py:class:`int` = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/StdContactControl.py#L83-L86)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.StdContactControl.StdContactControl.maxchp "Permalink to this definition")
    :   An Int specifying the maximum number of points that are permitted to violate contact
        conditions in any increment. The default value is 0.Either the **perrmx** or the **uerrmx**
        argument must be specified in conjunction with the **maxchp** argument.

    name : --is-rst--:py:class:`str`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/StdContactControl.py)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.StdContactControl.StdContactControl.name "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A String specifying the contact controls repository key.

    penetrationTolChoice : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.SymbolicConstant.SymbolicConstant` = `'RELATIVE'`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/StdContactControl.py#L46-L50)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.StdContactControl.StdContactControl.penetrationTolChoice "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether the allowable penetration is an absolute value or
        a value relative to the characteristic contact surface face dimension. Only contact
        interactions defined with augmented Lagrangian surface behavior will be affected by this
        argument. Possible values are RELATIVE and ABSOLUTE. The default value is RELATIVE.

    perrmx : --is-rst--:py:class:`float` = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/StdContactControl.py#L88-L92)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.StdContactControl.StdContactControl.perrmx "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Float specifying the maximum value of tensile stress (tensile force in GAP- or
        ITT-type contact elements) allowed to be transmitted at a contact point. The default
        value is 0.0.The **perrmx** argument must be specified in conjunction with the **maxchp**
        argument.

    relativePenetrationTolerance : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Optional`\[:py:class:`float`] = `None`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/StdContactControl.py#L52-L58)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.StdContactControl.StdContactControl.relativePenetrationTolerance "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Float specifying the ratio of the allowable penetration to the characteristic contact
        surface face dimension. The float values represent percentages (e.g.: 0.001=0.1%). Only
        contact interactions defined with augmented Lagrangian surface behavior will be affected
        by this argument. The default value is 10⁻³.The **relativePenetrationTolerance** argument
        applies only when **penetrationTolChoice** = RELATIVE. The **relativePenetrationTolerance**
        and **absolutePenetrationTolerance** arguments are mutually exclusive.

            :   A Float specifying the factor by which Abaqus/Standard will scale the default penalty

                interactions defined with augmented Lagrangian surface behavior will be affected by this

                a value relative to the characteristic contact surface face dimension. Only contact
                interactions defined with augmented Lagrangian surface behavior will be affected by this
                argument. Possible values are RELATIVE and ABSOLUTE. The default value is RELATIVE.

            relativePenetrationTolerance=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.StdContactControl.StdContactControl.setValues.relativePenetrationTolerance "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the ratio of the allowable penetration to the characteristic contact

                contact interactions defined with augmented Lagrangian surface behavior will be affected
                by this argument. The default value is 10⁻³.The **relativePenetrationTolerance** argument
                applies only when **penetrationTolChoice** = RELATIVE. The **relativePenetrationTolerance**
                and **absolutePenetrationTolerance** arguments are mutually exclusive.

            absolutePenetrationTolerance=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.StdContactControl.StdContactControl.setValues.absolutePenetrationTolerance "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the allowable penetration. Only contact interactions defined
                with augmented Lagrangian surface behavior will be affected by this argument. The
                **absolutePenetrationTolerance** argument applies only when
                **penetrationTolChoice** = ABSOLUTE. The **relativePenetrationTolerance** and
                **absolutePenetrationTolerance** arguments are mutually exclusive. The default value is
                None.

            frictionOnset=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.StdContactControl.StdContactControl.setValues.frictionOnset "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying when the application of friction occurs. Possible values
                are:

                * IMMEDIATE, specifying the friction is included in the increment when contact occurs.
                * DELAYED, specifying the application of friction is delayed until the increment after
                  contact occurs.

            automaticTolerances=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.StdContactControl.StdContactControl.setValues.automaticTolerances "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether Abaqus/Standard should automatically compute an overclosure
                tolerance and a separation tolerance to prevent chattering in contact. The default value
                is OFF.The **automaticTolerances** argument cannot be used with the **maxchp**, **perrmx**,
                and **uerrmx** arguments.

            maxchp=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.StdContactControl.StdContactControl.setValues.maxchp "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the maximum number of points that are permitted to violate contact
                conditions in any increment. The default value is 0.Either the **perrmx** or the **uerrmx**
                argument must be specified in conjunction with the **maxchp** argument.

            perrmx=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.StdContactControl.StdContactControl.setValues.perrmx "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum value of tensile stress (tensile force in GAP- or
                ITT-type contact elements) allowed to be transmitted at a contact point. The default
                value is 0.0.The **perrmx** argument must be specified in conjunction with the **maxchp**
                argument.

            uerrmx=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.StdContactControl.StdContactControl.setValues.uerrmx "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum overclosure distance allowed at a secondary node that is
                considered to be open. The default value is 0.0.The **uerrmx** argument must be specified
                in conjunction with the **maxchp** argument.

                Changed in version 2022: Slave node was changed to secondary node.

            stabilizeChoice=`abaqusConstants.NONE`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.StdContactControl.StdContactControl.setValues.stabilizeChoice "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether or not viscous damping will be specified, and if
                so, how it will be specified. Possible values are NONE, AUTOMATIC, and COEFFICIENT. The
                default value is NONE.

            dampFactor=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.StdContactControl.StdContactControl.setValues.dampFactor "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the value of the damping factor. This value is multiplied by the
                calculated damping coefficient. The default value is 1.0.This argument is only valid
                when **stabilizeChoice** = AUTOMATIC.

            dampCoef=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.StdContactControl.StdContactControl.setValues.dampCoef "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the damping coefficient. The default value is 0.0.This argument is
                only valid when **stabilizeChoice** = COEFFICIENT.

            tangFraction=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.StdContactControl.StdContactControl.setValues.tangFraction "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the tangential stabilization as a fraction of the normal
                stabilization (damping). The default value is 1.0.This argument is valid only if
                **stabilizeChoice** = AUTOMATIC or COEFFICIENT.

            eosFraction=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.StdContactControl.StdContactControl.setValues.eosFraction "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the fraction of the damping that remains at the end of the step. The
                default value is 0.0.This argument is valid only if **stabilizeChoice** = AUTOMATIC or
                COEFFICIENT.

            zeroDampingChoice=`abaqusConstants.COMPUTE`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.StdContactControl.StdContactControl.setValues.zeroDampingChoice "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying how the zero-damping clearance will be specified. Possible
                values are COMPUTE and SPECIFY. The default value is COMPUTE.This argument is valid only
                if **stabilizeChoice** = AUTOMATIC or COEFFICIENT.

            zeroDamping=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.StdContactControl.StdContactControl.setValues.zeroDamping "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the clearance at which damping becomes zero. This argument is
                valid only when **zeroDampingChoice** = SPECIFY. This argument is valid only if
                **stabilizeChoice** = AUTOMATIC or COEFFICIENT. The default value is None.

            enforceWithLagrangeMultipliers=`abaqusConstants.DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.StdContactControl.StdContactControl.setValues.enforceWithLagrangeMultipliers "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether to enforce the contact constraints with Lagrange
                multipliers. Possible values are DEFAULT, ENFORCEMENT\_OFF, and ENFORCEMENT\_ON. The
                default value is DEFAULT.

:   Bases: [`ContactInitialization`](#abaqus.Interaction.StdInitialization.ContactInitialization "abaqus.Interaction.ContactInitialization.ContactInitialization (Python class)")

    The StdInitialization object is used in conjunction with ContactStd in Abaqus/Standard analyses to
    specify contact initialization data. The StdInitialization object is derived from the ContactInitialization
    object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].contactInitializations[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * CONTACT INITIALIZATION DATA

    Note

    Check [StdInitialization on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-stdinitializationpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    Member Details:

    clearanceDistance : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Optional`\[:py:class:`float`] = `None`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/StdInitialization.py#L40-L43)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.StdInitialization.StdInitialization.clearanceDistance "Permalink to this definition")
    :   None or a Float specifying the initial clearance distance. This argument is valid only
        when **overclosureType** = CLEARANCE, and must be specified in that case. The default value
        is None.

    interferenceDistance : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Optional`\[:py:class:`float`] = `None`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/StdInitialization.py#L36-L38)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.StdInitialization.StdInitialization.interferenceDistance "Permalink to this definition")
    :   None or a Float specifying the interference distance. This argument is valid only when
        **overclosureType** = INTERFERENCE. The default value is None.

        undergo strain-free adjustments. This argument is not valid when
        **overclosureType** = INTERFERENCE unless a value has been specified for
        **interferenceDistance**. The default value is None.

    :   None or a Float specifying the distance tolerance within which initial overclosures will
        undergo strain-free adjustments.. The default value is None.

    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of overclosure to be defined. Possible values are

    contact stabilization. The StdStabilization object is derived from the ContactStabilization object.

    The ModelChange object defines model change interactions for element removal and reactivation. The
    ModelChange object is derived from the Interaction object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactions[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * MODEL CHANGE

    Note

    Check [ModelChange on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-modelchangepyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    The PressurePenetration object defines pressure penetration loading simulated with surface-to-surface
    contact. The PressurePenetration object is derived from the Interaction object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactions[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    The RadiationToAmbient object defines radiant heat transfer between a surface and its environment. The
    RadiationToAmbient object is derived from the Interaction object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactions[name]
    ```

    Note

    Check [RadiationToAmbient on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-radiationtoambientpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    Member Details:

    ambientTemperature : --is-rst--:py:class:`float` = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/RadiationToAmbient.py#L53-L55)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.RadiationToAmbient.RadiationToAmbient.ambientTemperature "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Float specifying the reference ambient temperature, θ0θ0. This argument applies only
        when **radiationType** = AMBIENT. The default value is 0.0.

    ambientTemperatureAmp : --is-rst--:py:class:`str` = `''`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/RadiationToAmbient.py#L57-L63)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.RadiationToAmbient.RadiationToAmbient.ambientTemperatureAmp "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A String specifying the name of the Amplitude object that gives the variation of the
        ambient temperature with time. Note: Use None in an Abaqus/Standard analysis to specify
        that the reference ambient temperature is applied immediately at the beginning of the
        step or linearly over the step. Use None in an Abaqus/Explicit analysis to specify that
        the reference ambient temperature is applied throughout the step. This argument applies
        only when **radiationType** = AMBIENT.

    createStepName : --is-rst--:py:class:`str`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/RadiationToAmbient.py)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.RadiationToAmbient.RadiationToAmbient.createStepName "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A String specifying the name of the step in which the RadiationToAmbient object is
        created.

    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying how the radiation is distributed. This argument applies

    The StdXplCosimulation object defines co-simulation behavior between Abaqus/Standard and Abaqus/Explicit.
    The StdXplCosimulation object is derived from the Interaction object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactions[name]
    ```

    Note

    Check [StdXplCosimulation on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-stdxplcosimulationpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        created.

    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether the analysis programs use the same time increments
        or one is allowed to use more time increments than the other before exchanging data.
        Possible values are ALLOW\_SUBCYCLING and LOCKSTEP. The default value is
        ALLOW\_SUBCYCLING.

            useReverseDatumAxis=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.setValues.useReverseDatumAxis "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to reverse the bolt clearance direction given by the datum
                axis. The default value is OFF.

            clearanceRegion=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.setValues.clearanceRegion "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Region object specifying the contact region for which clearance is specified.

    setValuesInStep(*[stepName](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.setValuesInStep.stepName "abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.setValuesInStep.stepName (Python parameter) — A String specifying the name of the step in which the interaction is modified.")*, *[interactionProperty](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.setValuesInStep.interactionProperty "abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.setValuesInStep.interactionProperty (Python parameter) — A String specifying the name of the ContactProperty object associated with this interaction.")=`''`*, *[contactControls](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.setValuesInStep.contactControls "abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.setValuesInStep.contactControls (Python parameter) — A String specifying the name of the ContactControl object associated with this interaction.")=`''`*)[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.py#L277-L294)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.setValuesInStep "Permalink to this definition")
    :   This method modifies the propagating data for an existing SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp object in the

        Check [SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.setValuesInStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-surfacetosurfacecontactexppyc.htm?contextscope=all#simaker-surfacetosurfacecontactexpsetvaluesinsteppyc).

    sliding : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.SymbolicConstant.SymbolicConstant`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.py)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.sliding "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the contact formulation. Possible values are FINITE and

    swapSurfaces()[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.py#L207-L215)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.swapSurfaces "Permalink to this definition")
    :   This method switches the main and secondary surfaces of a surface-to-surface contact pair. This
        command is valid only during the step in which the interaction is created.

    :   A Boolean specifying whether to reverse the bolt clearance direction given by the datum

    weightingFactor : --is-rst--:py:class:`float` = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.py#L71-L73)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.weightingFactor "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Float specifying the weighting factor for the contact surfaces when
        **weightingFactorType** = SPECIFIED. The default value is 0.0.

    weightingFactorType : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.SymbolicConstant.SymbolicConstant` = `'DEFAULT'`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.py#L67-L69)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.SurfaceToSurfaceContactExp.weightingFactorType "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the weighting for node-to-face contact. Possible values
        are DEFAULT and SPECIFIED. The default value is DEFAULT.
