"Permalink to this definition")
:   Bases: [`Interaction`](#abaqus.Interaction.XFEMCrackGrowth.Interaction "abaqus.Interaction.Interaction.Interaction (Python class)")

    The SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd object defines surface-to-surface contact during an Abaqus/Standard
    analysis. The SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd object is derived from the Interaction object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].interactions[name]
    ```

    Note

    Check [SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-surfacetosurfacecontactstdpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    Member Details:

    adjustMethod : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.SymbolicConstant.SymbolicConstant` = `'NONE'`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py#L128-L130)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.adjustMethod "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the adjust method. Possible values are NONE, OVERCLOSED,
        TOLERANCE, and SET. The default value is NONE.

    adjustSet : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Optional`\[:py:class:`~abaqus.Region.Region.Region`] = `None`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py#L135-L136)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.adjustSet "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Region object specifying the Set object to which the adjustment is to be applied.

    adjustTolerance : --is-rst--:py:class:`float` = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py#L132-L133)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.adjustTolerance "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Float specifying the adjust tolerance. The default value is 0.0.

    amplitude : --is-rst--:py:class:`str` = `''`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py#L107-L111)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.amplitude "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A String specifying the name of the amplitude curve that defines the magnitude of the
        prescribed interference during the step. Use None to specify that the prescribed
        interference is applied immediately at the beginning of the step and ramped down to zero
        linearly over the step.

    bondingSet : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Optional`\[:py:class:`~abaqus.Region.Region.Region`] = `None`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py#L192-L194)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.bondingSet "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Region object specifying the secondary node sub-set for bonding, used only when the
        contact property CohesiveBehavior option specifies use.

    clearanceRegion : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Optional`\[:py:class:`~abaqus.Region.Region.Region`] = `None`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py#L184-L185)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.clearanceRegion "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Region object specifying the contact region for which clearance is specified.

    contactControls : --is-rst--:py:class:`str` = `''`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py#L147-L150)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.contactControls "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A String specifying the name of the ContactControl object associated with this
        interaction. The empty string indicates that the default contact controls will be used.
        The default value is an empty string.

    contactTracking : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.SymbolicConstant.SymbolicConstant` = `'TWO_CONFIG'`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py#L40-L46)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.contactTracking "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the choice of contact tracking algorithm. The STATE
        tracking algorithm uses only normal projections and is specified by using ONE\_CONFIG.
        The PATH tracking algorithm uses crossing and normal projections and is specified by
        using TWO\_CONFIG. Possible values are ONE\_CONFIG and TWO\_CONFIG. The default value is
        TWO\_CONFIG.This argument is valid only when **sliding** = FINITE and
        **enforcement** = SURFACE\_TO\_SURFACE.

    createStepName : --is-rst--:py:class:`str`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.createStepName "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A String specifying the name of the step in which the SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd object
        is created.

    datumAxis : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Optional`\[:py:class:`~abaqus.Datum.DatumAxis.DatumAxis`] = `None`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py#L176-L178)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.datumAxis "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A DatumAxis object specifying the orientation of the bolt hole when specifying bolt
        clearance.

    direction : --is-rst--:py:class:`tuple` = `()`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py#L104-L105)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.direction "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A sequence of three Floats specifying the following:

        * XX-direction cosine of the interference direction vector.
        * YY-direction cosine of the interference direction vector.
        * ZZ-direction cosine of the interference direction vector.

        This argument is required only when **interferenceDirectionType** = DIRECTION\_COSINE.

    enforcement : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.SymbolicConstant.SymbolicConstant` = `'SURFACE_TO_SURFACE'`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py#L138-L140)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.enforcement "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the discretization method. Possible values are
        NODE\_TO\_SURFACE and SURFACE\_TO\_SURFACE. The default value is SURFACE\_TO\_SURFACE.

    extensionZone : --is-rst--:py:class:`float` = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py#L123-L126)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.extensionZone "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Float specifying a fraction of the end segment or facet edge length by which the main
        surface is to be extended to avoid numerical round-off errors associated with contact
        modeling. The value given must lie between 0.0 and 0.2. The default value is 0.1.

    halfThreadAngle : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Optional`\[:py:class:`str`] = `None`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py#L160-L162)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.halfThreadAngle "Permalink to this definition")
    :   None or a sequence of Floats specifying the half thread angle used for bolt clearance.
        The default value is None.

    handedness : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.SymbolicConstant.SymbolicConstant` = `'RIGHT'`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py#L199-L201)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.handedness "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the bolt handedness formulation. Possible values are RIGHT
        and LEFT. The default value is RIGHT.

        New in version 2019: The `handedness` attribute was added.

    hcrit : --is-rst--:py:class:`float` = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py#L118-L121)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.hcrit "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Float specifying the distance by which a secondary node must penetrate the main
        surface before Abaqus/Standard abandons the current increment and tries again with a
        smaller increment. The default value is 0.0.

    initialClearance : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Union`\[:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.SymbolicConstant.SymbolicConstant`, :py:class:`float`] = `'OMIT'`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py#L156-L158)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.initialClearance "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SymbolicConstant or a Float specifying the initial clearance at regions of contact.
        Possible values are OMIT and COMPUTED. The default value is OMIT.

    interactionProperty : --is-rst--:py:class:`str`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.interactionProperty "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A String specifying the name of the ContactProperty object associated with this
        interaction.

    interferenceDirectionType : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.SymbolicConstant.SymbolicConstant` = `'COMPUTED'`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py#L94-L96)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.interferenceDirectionType "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the method used to determine the interference direction.
        Possible values are COMPUTED and DIRECTION\_COSINE. The default value is COMPUTED.

    interferenceType : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.SymbolicConstant.SymbolicConstant` = `'NONE'`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py#L87-L88)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.interferenceType "Permalink to this definition")
    :   * NONE, specifying no allowable contact interference.
        * SHRINK\_FIT.
        * UNIFORM.

        The default value is NONE.

    main : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.Region.Region.Region`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.main "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Region object specifying the name of the main surface.

        Changed in version 2022: The `master` attribute was renamed to `main`.

    majorBoltDiameter : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Union`\[:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.SymbolicConstant.SymbolicConstant`, :py:class:`float`] = `'COMPUTED'`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py#L168-L170)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.majorBoltDiameter "Permalink to this definition")
    :   The SymbolicConstant COMPUTED or a Float specifying the major diameter of the bolt used
        for bolt clearance. The default value is COMPUTED.

    meanBoltDiameter : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Union`\[:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.SymbolicConstant.SymbolicConstant`, :py:class:`float`] = `'COMPUTED'`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py#L172-L174)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.meanBoltDiameter "Permalink to this definition")
    :   The SymbolicConstant COMPUTED or a Float specifying the mean diameter of the bolt used
        for bolt clearance. The default value is COMPUTED.

    normalAdjustment : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.SymbolicConstant.SymbolicConstant` = `'NONE'`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py#L199-L201)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.normalAdjustment "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the bolt normal adjustment formulation for all secondary
        nodes. Possible values are UNIFORM AXIAL COMPONENT and LOCATION DEPENDENT. The default
        value is UNIFORM AXIAL COMPONENT.

        New in version 2019: The `normalAdjustment` attribute was added.

    overclosure : --is-rst--:py:class:`float` = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py#L90-L92)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.overclosure "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Float specifying the maximum overclosure distance allowed. This argument applies only
        when **interferenceType** = UNIFORM. The default value is 0.0.

    pitch : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Optional`\[:py:class:`str`] = `None`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py#L164-L166)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.pitch "Permalink to this definition")
    :   None or a sequence of Floats specifying the pitch used for bolt clearance. The default
        value is None.

    :   A Region object specifying the name of the secondary surface.

        Changed in version 2022: The `slave` attribute was renamed to `secondary`.

"Permalink to this definition")
    :   This method modifies the data for an existing SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd object in the step where it
        is created.

        Note

        Check [SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValues on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-surfacetosurfacecontactstdpyc.htm?contextscope=all#simaker-surfacetosurfacecontactstdsetvaluespyc).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValues-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   interferenceType=`abaqusConstants.NONE`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValues.interferenceType "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of time-dependent allowable interference for
                contact pairs and contact elements. Possible values are:

                * NONE, specifying no allowable contact interference.
                * SHRINK\_FIT.
                * UNIFORM.

                The default value is NONE.

            overclosure=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValues.overclosure "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum overclosure distance allowed. This argument applies only
                when **interferenceType** = UNIFORM. The default value is 0.0.

            interferenceDirectionType=`abaqusConstants.COMPUTED`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValues.interferenceDirectionType "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the method used to determine the interference direction.
                Possible values are COMPUTED and DIRECTION\_COSINE. The default value is COMPUTED.

            direction=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValues.direction "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of three Floats specifying the following:

                * XX-direction cosine of the interference direction vector.
                * YY-direction cosine of the interference direction vector.
                * ZZ-direction cosine of the interference direction vector.

                This argument is required only when **interferenceDirectionType** = DIRECTION\_COSINE.

            amplitude=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValues.amplitude "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the amplitude curve that defines the magnitude of the
                prescribed interference during the step. Use None to specify that the prescribed
                interference is applied immediately at the beginning of the step and ramped down to zero
                linearly over the step.

            smooth=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValues.smooth "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the degree of smoothing used for deformable or rigid main surfaces
                involved when **enforcement** = NODE\_TO\_SURFACE. The value given must lie between 0.0 and
                0.5. The default value is 0.2.

            hcrit=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValues.hcrit "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the distance by which a secondary node must penetrate the main
                surface before Abaqus/Standard abandons the current increment and tries again with a
                smaller increment. The default value is 0.0.

            extensionZone=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValues.extensionZone "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying a fraction of the end segment or facet edge length by which the main
                surface is to be extended to avoid numerical round-off errors associated with contact
                modeling. The value given must lie between 0.0 and 0.2. The default value is 0.1.

            adjustMethod=`abaqusConstants.NONE`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValues.adjustMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the adjust method. Possible values are NONE, OVERCLOSED,
                TOLERANCE, and SET. The default value is NONE.

            adjustTolerance=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValues.adjustTolerance "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the adjust tolerance. The default value is 0.0.

            adjustSet=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValues.adjustSet "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Region object specifying the Set object to which the adjustment is to be applied.

            enforcement=`abaqusConstants.SURFACE_TO_SURFACE`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValues.enforcement "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the discretization method. Possible values are
                NODE\_TO\_SURFACE and SURFACE\_TO\_SURFACE. The default value is SURFACE\_TO\_SURFACE.

            thickness=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValues.thickness "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether shell/membrane element thickness is considered. The default
                value is ON.This argument is not valid when **sliding** = FINITE and
                **enforcement** = NODE\_TO\_SURFACE.

            contactControls=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValues.contactControls "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the ContactControl object associated with this
                interaction. The empty string indicates that the default contact controls will be used.
                The default value is an empty string.

            tied=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValues.tied "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the surfaces are to be “tied” together for the duration of
                the simulation. The default value is OFF.

            initialClearance=`abaqusConstants.OMIT`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValues.initialClearance "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant or a Float specifying the initial clearance at regions of contact.
                Possible values are OMIT and COMPUTED. The default value is OMIT.

            halfThreadAngle=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValues.halfThreadAngle "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a sequence of Floats specifying the half thread angle used for bolt clearance.
                The default value is None.

            pitch=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValues.pitch "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a sequence of Floats specifying the pitch used for bolt clearance. The default
                value is None.

            majorBoltDiameter=`abaqusConstants.COMPUTED`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValues.majorBoltDiameter "Permalink to this definition")
            :   The SymbolicConstant COMPUTED or a Float specifying the major diameter of the bolt used
                for bolt clearance. The default value is COMPUTED.

            meanBoltDiameter=`abaqusConstants.COMPUTED`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValues.meanBoltDiameter "Permalink to this definition")
            :   The SymbolicConstant COMPUTED or a Float specifying the mean diameter of the bolt used
                for bolt clearance. The default value is COMPUTED.

            datumAxis=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValues.datumAxis "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A DatumAxis object specifying the orientation of the bolt hole when specifying bolt
                clearance.

            useReverseDatumAxis=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValues.useReverseDatumAxis "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to reverse the bolt clearance direction given by the datum
                axis. The default value is OFF.

            clearanceRegion=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValues.clearanceRegion "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Region object specifying the contact region for which clearance is specified.

            surfaceSmoothing=`abaqusConstants.NONE`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValues.surfaceSmoothing "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether to use surface smoothing for geometric surfaces in
                SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd interactions. Possible values are AUTOMATIC and NONE. The
                default value is NONE.

            bondingSet=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValues.bondingSet "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Region object specifying the secondary node sub-set for bonding, used only when the
                contact property CohesiveBehavior option specifies use.

            handedness=`abaqusConstants.RIGHT`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValues.handedness "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the bolt handedness formulation. Possible values are RIGHT
                and LEFT. The default value is RIGHT.

                New in version 2019: The `normalAdjustment` argument was added.

            normalAdjustment=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValues.normalAdjustment "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the bolt normal adjustment formulation for all secondary
                nodes. Possible values are UNIFORM AXIAL COMPONENT and LOCATION DEPENDENT. The default
                value is UNIFORM AXIAL COMPONENT.

                New in version 2019: The `normalAdjustment` argument was added.

    setValuesInStep(*[stepName](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValuesInStep.stepName "abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValuesInStep.stepName (Python parameter) — A String specifying the name of the step in which the interaction is modified.")*, *[interactionProperty](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValuesInStep.interactionProperty "abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValuesInStep.interactionProperty (Python parameter) — A String specifying the name of the ContactProperty object associated with this interaction.")=`''`*, *[interferenceType](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValuesInStep.interferenceType "abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValuesInStep.interferenceType (Python parameter) — A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of time-dependent allowable interference for contact pairs and contact elements.")=`abaqusConstants.NONE`*, *[overclosure](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValuesInStep.overclosure "abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValuesInStep.overclosure (Python parameter) — A Float specifying the maximum overclosure distance allowed.")=`0`*, *[interferenceDirectionType](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValuesInStep.interferenceDirectionType "abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValuesInStep.interferenceDirectionType (Python parameter) — A SymbolicConstant specifying the method used to determine the interference direction. Possible values are COMPUTED and DIRECTION_COSINE.")=`abaqusConstants.COMPUTED`*, *[direction](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValuesInStep.direction "abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValuesInStep.direction (Python parameter) — A sequence of three Floats specifying the following:")=`()`*, *[amplitude](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValuesInStep.amplitude "abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValuesInStep.amplitude (Python parameter) — A String specifying the name of the amplitude curve that defines the magnitude of the prescribed interference during the step.")=`''`*, *[contactControls](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValuesInStep.contactControls "abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValuesInStep.contactControls (Python parameter) — A String specifying the name of the ContactControl object associated with this interaction.")=`''`*)[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py#L543-L598)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValuesInStep "Permalink to this definition")
    :   This method modifies the propagating data for an existing SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd object in the
        specified step.

        Note

        Check [SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValuesInStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-surfacetosurfacecontactstdpyc.htm?contextscope=all#simaker-surfacetosurfacecontactstdsetvaluesinsteppyc).

        :   stepName[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValuesInStep.stepName "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the step in which the interaction is modified.

            interactionProperty=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValuesInStep.interactionProperty "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the ContactProperty object associated with this
                interaction.

            interferenceType=`abaqusConstants.NONE`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValuesInStep.interferenceType "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of time-dependent allowable interference for
                contact pairs and contact elements. Possible values are:

                * NONE, specifying no allowable contact interference.
                * SHRINK\_FIT.
                * UNIFORM.

                The default value is NONE.

            overclosure=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValuesInStep.overclosure "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum overclosure distance allowed. This argument applies only
                when **interferenceType** = UNIFORM. The default value is 0.0.

            interferenceDirectionType=`abaqusConstants.COMPUTED`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValuesInStep.interferenceDirectionType "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the method used to determine the interference direction.
                Possible values are COMPUTED and DIRECTION\_COSINE. The default value is COMPUTED.

            direction=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValuesInStep.direction "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of three Floats specifying the following:

                * XX-direction cosine of the interference direction vector.
                * YY-direction cosine of the interference direction vector.
                * ZZ-direction cosine of the interference direction vector.

                This argument is required only when **interferenceDirectionType** = DIRECTION\_COSINE.

            amplitude=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValuesInStep.amplitude "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the amplitude curve that defines the magnitude of the
                prescribed interference during the step. Use None to specify that the prescribed
                interference is applied immediately at the beginning of the step and ramped down to zero
                linearly over the step.

            contactControls=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.setValuesInStep.contactControls "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the ContactControl object associated with this
                interaction. The empty string indicates that the default contact controls will be used.
                The default value is an empty string.

    sliding : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.SymbolicConstant.SymbolicConstant`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.sliding "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the contact formulation. Possible values are FINITE and
        SMALL.

    smooth : --is-rst--:py:class:`float` = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py#L113-L116)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.smooth "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Float specifying the degree of smoothing used for deformable or rigid main surfaces
        involved when **enforcement** = NODE\_TO\_SURFACE. The value given must lie between 0.0 and
        0.5. The default value is 0.2.

    supplementaryContact : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.SymbolicConstant.SymbolicConstant` = `'SELECTIVE'`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py#L48-L51)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.supplementaryContact "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the manner in which midface constraints are employed.
        Possible values are SELECTIVE, NEVER, and ALWAYS. The default value is SELECTIVE.This
        argument is not valid when **sliding** = FINITE and **enforcement** = SURFACE\_TO\_SURFACE.

    surfaceSmoothing : --is-rst--:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.SymbolicConstant.SymbolicConstant` = `'NONE'`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py#L187-L190)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.surfaceSmoothing "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether to use surface smoothing for geometric surfaces in
        SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd interactions. Possible values are AUTOMATIC and NONE. The
        default value is NONE.

    swapSurfaces()[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py#L390-L398)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.swapSurfaces "Permalink to this definition")
    :   This method switches the main and secondary surfaces of a surface-to-surface contact pair. This
        command is valid only for the step in which the interaction is created.

        Changed in version 2022: Master and slave were changed to main and secondary.

    thickness : --is-rst--:py:data:`~typing.Union`\[:py:class:`~abaqus.UtilityAndView.AbaqusBoolean.AbaqusBoolean`, :py:class:`bool`] = `1`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Interaction/SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.py#L142-L145)[¶](#abaqus.Interaction.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd.thickness "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Boolean specifying whether shell/membrane element thickness is considered. The default

    The PressurePenetrationState object stores the propagating data of a PressurePenetration object in a
    step. One instance of this object is created internally by the PressurePenetration object for each step. The
    instance is also deleted internally by the PressurePenetration object. The PressurePenetrationState object
    has no constructor or methods. The PressurePenetrationState object is derived from the InteractionState
    object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import interaction
    mdb.models[name].steps[name].interactionStates[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * PRESSURE PENETRATION

    Note

    Check [PressurePenetrationState on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-pressurepenetrationstatepyc.htm?contextscope=all).
